paper.title: MINT: Min-Selection Preference Distillation for Balanced Multi-Objective Alignment
paper.abstract: Aligning a language agent to several objectives at once is a persistent failure mode of preference-based training: when objectives are combined additively, optimization collapses onto whichever is cheapest to improve and sacrifices the rest, so a support agent learns to sound warm while giving no real help. The root issue is that an additive reward has no notion of balance. We introduce Mint (MIN-selection preference disTillation), a one-line change to preference distillation: rather than rankin

summary.core_problem: 多目标偏好对齐阶段，传统加权求和的奖励标量化方法存在结构性缺陷：单个目标的大幅提升可以抵消其他目标的损失，优化过程会塌陷到最容易改进的目标上，最终得到偏科严重的策略，无法兼顾多个存在冲突的对齐目标（比如既有用又无害、既高效推进任务又保持友好态度）。
summary.importance: 为多目标平衡对齐场景提供了极低侵入性的落地方案，仅改动偏好对选择逻辑，完全兼容现有DPO等偏好优化流程，不需要修改损失函数、奖励模型或者采样流程。同时给出了广义幂平均的偏好选择统一视角，清晰解释了不同聚合规则的几何意义，对对齐训练的目标设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 保留现有best-of-K偏好蒸馏的完整流程：从参考策略采样K个候选回复，用冻结的裁判模型对每个候选在各个目标维度上打分，最后用标准DPO损失蒸馏偏好对，整个改动仅一行代码，兼容现有所有偏好优化变体。唯一调整是候选排序规则：不使用加权和排序，而是取每个候选所有目标得分的最小值作为排序依据，也就是广义幂平均在p趋近负无穷的切比雪夫最坏情况准则。选中的是最弱维度得分最高的均衡候选，拒绝的是偏科最严重的候选，引导策略向所有目标都达标的方向优化，而不是追求单目标突出。
summary.experiments: 在两个属性相反的对话场景测试：情感支持对话（ESConv）和对抗性议价对话（CraigslistBargain），两个场景都设置任务进展（AQ）和关系质量（EQ）两个正交目标，用冻结LLM作为打分裁判。结果显示min选择规则可以同时提升两个目标的得分，显著降低目标间不平衡度；在参考策略偏科严重的场景下，弱侧目标得分从0.37提升到0.64，最终策略的均衡度超过人类专家水平。多轮交互分析显示，min选择的纠偏效果和参考策略的不平衡程度正相关，优势会随着多轮轨迹逐步累积。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，总阅读时间约15分钟。重点看引言部分对多目标对齐塌陷问题的刻画，以及方法部分对广义幂平均聚合家族的解释，最后看多轮交互的消融分析，理解该方法的适用边界（仅针对参考策略存在明显不平衡的场景，不是通用性能提升trick）。不需要花时间在具体领域的实验细节上。

summary_en.core_problem: Additive scalarization of rewards in multi-objective preference alignment suffers from a structural failure: large gains on one objective offset losses on others, causing optimization to collapse onto the easiest-to-improve objective and produce lopsided policies that fail to balance competing alignment goals (e.g. helpfulness vs harmlessness, task progress vs relational warmth).
summary_en.importance: Provides a near-zero-cost drop-in fix for multi-objective preference alignment that requires no changes to existing DPO objectives, reward models, or sampling pipelines, with direct practical value for production alignment workflows. It also formalizes preference pair selection under a unified generalized power mean framework that clarifies the geometry of different aggregation rules.
summary_en.technical_approach: Retains the standard best-of-K preference distillation pipeline: sample K candidate responses from a reference policy, score each candidate across all objective dimensions with a frozen LLM judge, then distill preference pairs with unchanged DPO loss. The one-line code change is fully compatible with all existing preference optimization variants. The only modification is the candidate ranking rule: instead of ranking by weighted sum of rewards, rank candidates by their minimum score across all objectives, corresponding to the Chebyshev worst-case criterion (the p→-∞ limit of the generalized power mean family). The chosen response is the candidate with the strongest weakest dimension, and the rejected response is the most lopsided candidate, pulling the policy toward well-balanced outputs rather than single-objective outliers.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on two structurally distinct dialogue domains: cooperative emotional support (ESConv) and adversarial price negotiation (CraigslistBargain), each with two orthogonal objectives: action quotient (AQ, measuring task progress) and emotional quotient (EQ, measuring relational quality), scored by a frozen LLM judge. Min-selection improves both objectives simultaneously and reduces cross-objective imbalance substantially; on settings where the supervised reference is severely imbalanced, it raises the weaker-axis reward from 0.37 to 0.64, producing responses more balanced than those of human experts. Turn-resolved multi-turn rollout analysis shows the correction effect scales with the imbalance of the reference policy, and its advantage compounds across interaction turns proportional to persistent reference imbalance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~15 minutes. Focus on the introduction's characterization of multi-objective collapse, the generalized mean framing of selection rules in the method section, and the multi-turn ablation analysis that maps out the method's boundary conditions (it is a targeted remedy for imbalance, not a universal performance boost). Skip domain-specific experimental details unless relevant to your use case.

recommendation.zh: min-selection 是个干净的排序改动，但只在两个对话任务上验证，泛化到 pretrain-scale 多目标平衡未知；看公式和情感支持那张表即可。
recommendation.en: Min-selection is a clean ranking change, but it's only validated on two dialog tasks; generalization to pretrain-scale multi-objective balance is unknown. Read the formula and the emotional-support table.

paper.title: Context Blindness in DPO: Mitigating Object Hallucination in MLLMs via Context-Calibrated Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress, yet they still exhibit object hallucination, generating plausible but incorrect descriptions that are inconsistent with the visual input. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) mitigates this by training models to prefer non-hallucinated responses over hallucinated ones, and recent efforts further enrich the preference data with relevant context. However, it remains unclear whether DPO actually leverages such context. To investigat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作盯住的不是“如何再造一批更好的偏好数据”，而是一个更基础的问题：现有 DPO 类目标在训练 MLLM 抗幻觉时，是否真的学会了利用额外上下文来增强对正确回答的偏好。论文给出的结论是否定的。作者把这种现象称为 context blindness：即便输入里加入了有助于 grounding 的上下文，标准 DPO 的优化形式也不会显式奖励“有上下文时偏好边际更大”，因此模型学到的偏好常常对上下文不敏感。这一点直接关系到 object hallucination，因为很多幻觉并不是模型不会比较好坏回答，而是它没有把视觉或补充文本上下文真正纳入偏好判断。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是基础预训练 recipe 的论文，而是 post-train 对齐目标的诊断与修正工作。但它有两个值得重视的点。第一，它把 DPO 类方法里一个常被忽略的结构性缺陷讲清楚了：pairwise preference loss 只在单一输入条件下拉开 chosen/rejected 的 margin，不会自动鼓励“信息更多时 margin 应更大”。这个观察对多模态对齐、事实性对齐，甚至文本 LLM 的 grounded preference learning 都有参考价值。第二，它提出的 CPG 把“模型是否真的利用上下文”从定性判断变成了可测量量，因而不只是一个新 loss，也是一种训练诊断工具。贡献量级更像是对 DPO 目标函数的有针对性修补，而不是范式替换；但问题抓得准，结论也比较可迁移。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是诊断指标 Contextual Preference Gain, CPG。它衡量同一对回答在“无额外上下文”和“有额外有帮助上下文”两种条件下，模型偏好边际提升了多少。这里的偏好边际沿用 DPO/BT 框架里的 chosen 与 rejected 的相对 reward 或 log-prob gap。若模型真的会利用上下文，那么加入 grounding context 后，正确回答相对错误回答的优势应更明显，CPG 应为正且足够大。作者用这个指标发现：CPG 与 hallucination rate 强负相关，但标准 DPO、以及一些变体的 CPG 分布都集中在 0 附近，说明它们学到的偏好几乎不随上下文增强而增强。

第二层是 C²-DPO。核心做法是在原有 preference objective 之外，加一个 calibration term，显式要求“带上下文时的偏好 margin”大于“无上下文时的偏好 margin”。这样训练信号不再只是 chosen 胜过 rejected，而是进一步要求模型把额外上下文转化为更强的偏好证据。这个设计和普通 DPO 的区别不在于换了 reward parameterization，而在于把 context sensitivity 直接写进目标函数。论文还强调该项可以较平滑地嫁接到 SimPO、RDPO 等变体上，说明它更像一个通用校准项，而不是依赖某个特定 DPO 实现。

从机制上看，这个方法适合处理“正确答案需要 grounding 才能成立”的场景。若 chosen/rejected 在无上下文时已经容易区分，C²-DPO 的增益可能有限；但在视觉细节、事实补充、外部证据这类场景里，它会更自然，因为这些任务的关键不是静态偏好，而是条件化偏好随证据增强而增强。
summary.experiments:
实验主线比较清楚。首先，作者验证 CPG 的诊断价值：更高的 CPG 对应更低的 hallucination rate，这为后续方法提供了因果上较合理的优化方向。其次，在多模态抗幻觉 benchmark 上，C²-DPO 相比基线 DPO 明显降低幻觉。文中给出的代表性结果是：在 Object HalBench 上，response-level hallucination rate 下降 36%，mention-level 下降 60%；在 HallusionBench 上也有一致改善。第三，作者检查了副作用，发现 ScienceQA、MM-Vet、TextVQA 等通用多模态理解任务没有明显退化，说明它不是靠保守回答或压缩输出换来的抗幻觉。

另外两个实验点也值得看。其一，方法可扩展到 SimPO、RDPO，说明收益不依赖某个单一 preference loss。其二，作者还做了 text-only 设置，发现 context-aware preference calibration 对 factual alignment 也有帮助，这一点说明“上下文盲”不是 MLLM 独有问题，而是 DPO 类目标的更一般缺陷。

从你给出的全文片段里，没有看到更细的模型规模、训练样本数、β 或 calibration 系数等完整表格，因此没法安全补具体超参数字。阅读时建议重点核对主表、CPG 分布图、以及不同 DPO 变体上的一致性结果，确认收益是否稳定而非个别 benchmark 偶然。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但有两个部分值得认真看。第一是引言和方法前半段，作者对“为什么标准 DPO 不会自然学到 context gain”的论证比较关键。要看清楚它不是在说 DPO 完全不能利用上下文，而是在说目标函数没有显式奖励 richer-context margin increase，所以这种能力学得不稳、也不充分。第二是 CPG 定义和相关性实验。若你做对齐或偏好建模，这部分比具体 loss 更有复用价值，因为它提供了一个检查模型是否真正使用证据的诊断视角。

实验部分建议优先看三类表：Object HalBench/HallusionBench 主结果，通用能力保持结果，以及把 calibration 项接到 SimPO/RDPO 上的迁移结果。若时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线；若要判断能否迁到文本 factuality 或 RAG preference setting，再补看 text-only 实验和附录里的 loss 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than “can better preference data reduce hallucination?” It asks whether DPO-style training actually learns to use additional grounding context when deciding which response should be preferred. The answer is largely no. The authors call this context blindness: standard DPO increases the preference margin between chosen and rejected responses under a fixed input, but it does not explicitly reward the margin becoming larger when more helpful context is provided. For object hallucination in MLLMs, this matters because the failure is often not simple ranking failure; it is failure to condition preference strength on visual or textual evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. It is a post-training alignment paper with direct relevance to grounded modeling. Its value comes from two places. First, it isolates a structural limitation in DPO-like objectives rather than attributing hallucination only to data quality. That diagnosis is useful beyond this benchmark setting, including multimodal alignment, factuality alignment, and any preference setup where evidence should sharpen the model’s confidence. Second, the proposed Contextual Preference Gain (CPG) turns “does the model really use context?” into a measurable quantity. So the contribution is not only a modified loss, but also a diagnostic tool. The scale of contribution is best viewed as a targeted correction to DPO objectives, not a new paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. The first is the diagnostic metric, Contextual Preference Gain (CPG). For the same response pair, the model is evaluated with and without additional helpful context. CPG measures how much the preference margin increases once that context is added. The margin follows the usual DPO or Bradley-Terry view, based on the relative reward or log-probability gap between preferred and dispreferred responses. If a model truly leverages context, the correct response should become more strongly preferred when grounding information is available, so CPG should be positive and meaningfully large. Empirically, the authors show that higher CPG is strongly associated with lower hallucination, while standard DPO and several variants produce CPG distributions concentrated near zero.

The second layer is C²-DPO. On top of the original preference objective, the authors add a calibration term that explicitly rewards the preference margin under enriched context being larger than the margin without that context. This is the key difference from vanilla DPO. The change is not about a new reward parameterization; it is about writing context sensitivity directly into the optimization target. The same idea is also attached to SimPO and RDPO, which suggests that the proposal is a fairly general calibration add-on rather than a method tied to one specific DPO implementation.

Mechanistically, the method is well matched to settings where the preferred answer is only clearly preferred once grounding evidence is present. If chosen and rejected responses are already easy to separate without extra context, the gain may be limited. But for visual grounding, factual evidence, and other evidence-conditioned preference tasks, the objective is well aligned with the failure mode.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is straightforward. First, the paper validates CPG as a diagnostic: models with higher CPG consistently show lower hallucination rates. That gives the proposed optimization direction a credible empirical basis. Second, C²-DPO reduces hallucination on multimodal benchmarks by a clear margin. The headline numbers reported in the paper are a 36% reduction in response-level hallucination rate and a 60% reduction in mention-level hallucination rate on Object HalBench, with consistent gains on HallusionBench as well. Third, the paper checks whether this comes at the cost of general multimodal ability and reports that performance on ScienceQA, MM-Vet, and TextVQA is preserved.

Two additional results are worth noting. The calibration idea transfers to SimPO and RDPO, which supports the claim that the issue is objective-level rather than implementation-specific. The authors also test a text-only setting and find improved factual alignment there too, suggesting that context blindness is a broader weakness of DPO-style training, not only a multimodal problem.

The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete hyperparameter tables or all model-scale details, so I would not infer exact training sizes beyond the benchmark-level results already stated. When reading the paper, the main tables to verify are the CPG correlation plots, the hallucination benchmarks, and the cross-objective transfer results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but two parts deserve closer attention. First, read the motivation and the early method section carefully. The important claim is not that DPO cannot use context at all; it is that the objective does not explicitly reward larger preference gains under richer context, so context use is weak and unreliable. Second, focus on the definition of CPG and the correlation analysis. If you work on alignment or preference modeling, that diagnostic may be more reusable than the specific loss.

In the experiments, prioritize three groups of results: the main Object HalBench and HallusionBench tables, the capability-retention tables on general multimodal benchmarks, and the results where the calibration term is added to SimPO or RDPO. If time is limited, 30 to 40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want to assess transfer to text factuality or retrieval-grounded preference learning, then also read the text-only experiments and the appendix for the exact loss construction.

recommendation.zh: 读 CPG 定义和 ablation 即可；它提醒偏好数据加上下文不等于训练信号真的依赖上下文。
recommendation.en: Read the CPG definition and ablations; the useful warning is that contextual preference data does not imply context-dependent training signal.

paper.title: GRASP: Reinforcing Language Model Anonymizers with Group Relative Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models can infer sensitive personal attributes, such as age, location, and occupation, from ordinary text, turning everyday writing into a privacy risk. Adversarial anonymization defends against this by rewriting a text with a capable language model that also plays the attacker, but it needs a powerful model at inference time and thus sends private text to a third party, the very exposure anonymization should prevent. Recent work distills this behavior into a small on-device model

summary.core_problem: 在本地小模型匿名化场景中，如何直接优化隐私-效用权衡，而不是只模仿教师模型的离线偏好。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练/RL 应用型工作，价值不在匿名化任务本身，而在于展示 GRPO 这类相对策略优化能否替代 DPO 去优化多目标文本重写。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GRASP，让同一个小模型同时扮演匿名器、攻击者和效用评估器，在线自博弈式地产生重写候选，并用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 直接优化隐私与可用性目标，而非仅蒸馏教师选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其对比了 SFT/DPO 蒸馏式匿名器，并在隐私属性推断防御与文本效用保持之间取得更优平衡；但任务是高度应用化的匿名化重写，实验设定对通用 LLM 后训练的外推有限。
summary.authors_note: UC Santa Barbara 与 UCLA 团队；未见可确认的基座模型一线知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to directly optimize the privacy-utility tradeoff for on-device text anonymization, instead of merely imitating an offline teacher with preference learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL application paper. Its value is not the anonymization task itself, but whether GRPO-style relative policy optimization is a better fit than DPO for multi-objective rewriting.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRASP uses a single small model as anonymizer, adversary, and utility judge, generates candidate rewrites through online self-refinement, and applies Group Relative Policy Optimization to directly optimize privacy and utility rather than distilling teacher choices.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, it compares against SFT/DPO-based distilled anonymizers and improves the privacy-utility balance. Still, the task is highly application-specific, so the lessons for general LLM post-training are limited.
summary_en.authors_note: From UC Santa Barbara and UCLA; no clearly identifiable foundation-model marquee authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 把它当一个小型 RL 配方样本看：DPO 不擅长直接优化多目标重写，这点有参考价值；正文不必细读，方法段和主表够了。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small RL recipe case study: DPO is a weak fit for directly optimizing multi-objective rewriting; the method section and main table are enough.

paper.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-contex

summary.core_problem: 当模型被要求“利用外部上下文/信号”来回答问题时，如何让它学会选择性信任：既能抵抗误导信号，又不会退化成一概忽略上下文，从而在“上下文确实有用”时仍能受益。
summary.importance: 这篇更像 post-train/对齐侧的方法与评测，但对预训练研究也有直接启发：1）把“上下文鲁棒性”从单一准确率拆成可诊断的反事实条件（clean/misleading/correct/irrelevant），避免把“忽略上下文”误当成鲁棒；2）提出一个很通用的偏好优化数据挖掘与配比思路：只对那些“无上下文能答对、加误导就答错”的样本施加学习信号，并用匹配的对照条件做平衡，减少训练目标的副作用。这类‘反事实+配比’的 recipe 对持续学习、RLAIF/DPO 数据构造、以及未来把检索/工具/多模态上下文纳入训练目标时都可复用。
summary.technical_approach:
核心由两部分组成。
(1) MIST-1000 基准：每个题目固定 question/answer space/gold answer/一个“看起来合理的错误答案”，只改变包裹在问题外的上下文，构造四个版本：clean（无额外上下文）、misleading（上下文指向错误答案）、correct-context（上下文支持正确答案）、irrelevant（相关但不提供答案的自然文本）。这样四个条件之间的差异主要归因于“上下文信号”而不是题目难度变化。数据来源为 1000 题：800 来自既有 QA/数学/推理基准改写，200 为标注者撰写的更长更难场景；两轮人工流程控制歧义、泄漏、自然性与错误答案的可置信度。
(2) 评测指标与训练方法：
- SC2W（signal-induced correct-to-wrong）：只在模型 clean 条件下答对的子集上，统计 misleading 条件把答案从对翻到错的比例，用来把“模型本来就不会”与“被信号带偏”分离。
- SCOPE（Selective Context Preference Optimization）：一个信号反事实的偏好优化框架。先用 base model 挖掘关键失败样本：clean 能答对，但 misleading 会答错。对每个样本构造偏好对：truth-consistent response（与 gold 一致）优于 signal-following response（跟随误导信号）。关键不是改 DPO 公式，而是做‘配比平衡’：同一对偏好样本在四种上下文条件下复用，并对 misleading 对与 clean/correct/irrelevant 对照条件等权加权，避免只在 misleading 上训练导致模型学到“默认不信上下文”。这相当于把学习信号绑定到“上下文的角色（误导/支持/无关）”而不是某个表面 prompt。
summary.experiments:
全文信息显示的关键实验结论包括：
- 基准观察：从闭源前沿模型（文中点名 GPT-5.5、Claude、Gemini）到多种开源权重模型，普遍存在“误导上下文把原本正确答案翻错”的现象；单看 misleading 条件准确率会掩盖问题，因为强模型 clean 本来就高。
- 方法对比：prompt 防御、SFT、以及只用 misleading 对做 DPO，往往能抬高 misleading 条件表现，但会牺牲 clean 或 correct-context（典型副作用是学到‘不信上下文’）。
- SCOPE 效果：在常见开源模型上显著降低 SC2W，同时不侵蚀 clean / correct-context / irrelevant 三个对照条件；并且在未在目标数据集上训练的情况下，能 zero-shot 迁移到 3 个外部基准，竞争方法通常以牺牲准确率换鲁棒。
（你给的全文片段未包含具体表格数字、训练步数、模型参数与提升幅度；这些通常在实验章节的主表与消融表中，需要结合原文表格补齐。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“选择性信任”三目标的拆解（拒绝误导、利用正确信号、对无关信号不动），这是全文动机与评测设计的核心。
- 精看 MIST benchmark 构造细节：四条件如何保证 only-context-changes、错误答案如何保证 plausibility、以及两轮标注/审校如何控制泄漏与歧义；这决定了指标是否可信。
- 看 SC2W 的定义与报告方式：它把 susceptibility 从 base ability 中剥离出来，是这篇最可复用的评测思路。
- 看 SCOPE 的数据挖掘与配比：重点是“只挖 clean-correct→misleading-wrong 的反事实失败”以及“与三种对照条件等权平衡”。如果要复现/迁移到 RAG 或工具调用场景，这部分是 recipe。
- 最后扫一遍外部基准 zero-shot 迁移实验，判断它学到的是‘任务特定防御’还是更一般的上下文信任策略。

summary_en.core_problem: How to train and evaluate LMs to *selectively* trust external context: resist misleading cues without collapsing into a degenerate strategy that ignores all context, while still benefiting from genuinely helpful context and staying invariant to irrelevant context.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a post-training / alignment paper (preference optimization + benchmark), but it carries concrete lessons for foundation-model training: (1) it turns “context robustness” into a counterfactual, multi-condition diagnostic (clean/misleading/correct/irrelevant), preventing the common failure where “ignoring context” looks robust; (2) it proposes a reusable data-mining + mixture-balancing recipe for preference training—optimize only on counterfactual flips (clean-correct → misleading-wrong) and balance them with matched control conditions to avoid over-regularizing the model into blanket distrust. This pattern is directly relevant to RAG/tool-use training, continual post-train, and any setting where external signals are part of the conditioning distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two pillars.
(1) MIST-1000 benchmark: each item is instantiated into four matched variants where the question, answer space/type, gold answer, and a plausible wrong answer are held fixed; only the surrounding context changes: clean (no added context), misleading (context nudges toward the plausible wrong answer), correct-context (context supports the gold), and irrelevant (natural related text that does not contain the answer). The dataset contains 1,000 items (800 adapted from existing QA/math/reasoning benchmarks, 200 newly written longer scenarios) with a two-pass human QA process to control ambiguity, leakage, and plausibility.
(2) Metrics + training:
- SC2W (signal-induced correct-to-wrong): computed on the subset of items the model answers correctly in the clean condition, measuring how often misleading context flips them to wrong—separating susceptibility from base competence.
- SCOPE (Selective Context Preference Optimization): a signal-counterfactual preference framework. It mines the critical failures from a base model: cases where the model is correct in clean but wrong under misleading context. For each, it forms a preference pair (truth-consistent response preferred over signal-following response). The key is not changing DPO’s objective, but balancing the training mixture: reuse the same preference pair across all four context conditions and weight misleading pairs equally against clean/correct/irrelevant controls, preventing the “learn to ignore all context” shortcut.
summary_en.experiments:
Main findings reported in the full text:
- Universality: both frontier closed models (explicitly naming GPT-5.5, Claude, Gemini) and a range of open-weight models exhibit substantial susceptibility—misleading context often overturns answers that are correct in clean prompts.
- Baselines’ failure mode: prompt defenses, SFT, and misleading-only DPO can improve misleading-condition accuracy but typically degrade clean and/or correct-context accuracy, consistent with a blanket-distrust strategy.
- SCOPE: substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-weight models without harming the three control conditions (clean/correct/irrelevant), and transfers zero-shot to three external benchmarks (no training on the target datasets), whereas competing methods often trade robustness for accuracy.
(The provided excerpt does not include the numeric tables—model sizes, training budgets, and exact deltas likely live in the main results and ablation tables.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the three-way requirement of selective trust; it explains why single-condition robustness is misleading.
- Inspect the MIST construction section: how they guarantee only-context changes, how “plausible wrong answers” are controlled, and how leakage/ambiguity are audited.
- Focus on SC2W’s definition and reporting; it is the most portable evaluation idea.
- For SCOPE, concentrate on (i) the mining criterion (clean-correct → misleading-wrong) and (ii) the balanced mixture across the four matched conditions; this is the core recipe you would reuse for RAG/tool contexts.
- Finally, glance at the zero-shot transfer experiments to judge whether the behavior generalizes beyond the benchmark’s templates.

recommendation.zh: 选择性信任是后训练鲁棒性的新角度，MIST的四条件对照设计值得借鉴到内部鲁棒性评测中，SCOPE的平衡DPO思路可做小范围ablation验证。
recommendation.en: Selective trust is a new angle for post-training robustness; MIST's four-condition matched design is worth referencing for internal robustness evals, and SCOPE's balanced DPO idea is worth small-scale ablation verification.

paper.title: SAGA: Score-Weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment for Low-Resource Nordic Language Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimisation has proven effective for improving large language models but typically relies on costly human preference annotations. Extending these methods to morphologically rich, low-resource languages remains challenging because such annotations are scarce. We present SAGA (Score-weighted Adaptive Generation Alignment), a parser-guided preference optimisation framework that replaces human labels with dependency-parser supervision. SAGA converts parser judgements into preference pair

summary.core_problem: 在丹麦语、冰岛语、挪威博克mål 等低资源且形态复杂语言中，缺少人工偏好标注导致偏好优化难以落地。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据与监督信号构造。它用依存句法分析器替代人工偏好，为低资源语言 alignment 提供一种较便宜的弱监督路径；对预训练研究的价值主要在于训练信号质量和 reward hacking 监控。
summary.technical_approach: SAGA 将 parser judgement 转换成 delta-DPO 的偏好对，用句法分析质量和词汇多样性组成复合 reward，再用 reward gap 过滤低信息量样本，并显式监控 reward hacking。方法属于把外部语言工具迁移为偏好监督，而不是新的 RL 或 DPO 目标。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GPT-SW3-1.3B，在 Danish、Icelandic、Norwegian Bokmål 上评估语法质量。摘要报告 Danish parse success 从 69.0% 提升到 93.8%，Icelandic 在独立 Stanza 评估上提升 4.5 个百分点；其余 baseline 和完整指标需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses preference optimization for morphologically rich, low-resource Nordic languages where human preference labels are scarce.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training supervision pipeline. It replaces human preferences with dependency-parser-derived signals, which is mainly interesting for thinking about weak preference labels, signal quality, and reward hacking.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGA converts parser judgments into preference pairs for delta-DPO, combines parser quality and lexical diversity into a composite reward, filters low-information pairs by reward gaps, and tracks reward hacking. It adapts existing preference optimization rather than proposing a new alignment objective.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use GPT-SW3-1.3B on Danish, Icelandic, and Norwegian Bokmål. The abstract reports Danish parse success improving from 69.0% to 93.8%, and a 4.5 percentage-point gain for Icelandic on an independent Stanza evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 低资源 alignment 的弱监督例子；只看 reward-gap 过滤和 hacking 监控，别把 parser reward 当通用偏好替代。
recommendation.en: A weak-supervision example for low-resource alignment; read the reward-gap filtering and hacking checks, but do not treat parser reward as a general preference substitute.

paper.title: LARA: Lightweight Adapters in the Residual Stream for Composable Adaptation and Alignment
paper.abstract: We present LARA (Lightweight Additive Residual Adaptation), a method for efficient adaptation that operates in the residual stream of a frozen model rather than in its weights. Where LoRA adds an update of low rank to weight matrices, LARA reads the hidden state at a small set of layers and adds a correction of low rank back to the residual stream, leaving all base weights untouched. On a code fine-tuning task and on preference optimization (DPO), LARA matches LoRA at equal parameter counts. Bec

summary.core_problem: 现有高效适配方法（如LoRA）在权重空间修改模型参数，难以支持推理时的适配强度调节、多行为组合部署等需求；残差流适配的思路此前缺乏与LoRA的等参数量公平对比，其可组合、可调控的特性也未被系统挖掘。
summary.importance: 为预训练后适配与对齐提供了权重空间之外的可行路径，多行为共存、推理时连续调控的特性对多场景部署有实际工程价值，也为理解Transformer残差流的可编辑性提供了实验依据。
summary.technical_approach: LARA在Transformer选定层的残差流中插入轻量低秩线性模块，所有基座权重保持冻结。每个模块先做层归一化，再接两个低秩投影（从隐藏维d降到秩r，再升回d，中间无非线性激活），上投影初始化为零，保证训练初始状态与基座模型完全一致。核心特性包括：等参数量下性能与LoRA相当；推理时可通过单个标量系数γ调节适配强度，在基座与适配行为间平滑插值；多个独立适配模块可共存于同一冻结基座，支持按token路由选择行为，内存开销远低于多份完整模型。
summary.experiments: 在代码微调（SFT）和偏好优化（DPO）任务上做等参数量对比：LARA配置为6层插入、秩128、隐藏维1536，可训练参数约238万；LoRA配置为全层QV投影秩16，可训练参数约218万，两者参数规模相差不到10%，性能相当。SFT任务中适配模块分布在多层效果更好，DPO任务中单中层模块即可达到同等效果。推理时γ系数可实现基座到适配行为的平滑插值。单个适配模块的前向开销不到基座的0.2%，7个行为的软路由开销约为基座的1%，硬路由仅增加单个模块开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注第2章的模块结构设计、参数量对比逻辑，第3章的等参数基线对比、推理时强度调控实验、多行为路由实验结果。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing efficient adaptation methods such as LoRA modify model parameters in weight space, which limits inference-time control over adaptation strength and complicates composable deployment of multiple behaviors. Prior residual-stream adapter work lacked fair, parameter-matched comparisons against weight-space methods, and did not systematically explore composability and controllability properties.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical alternative to weight-space adaptation for post-pretrain alignment and task specialization. The multi-behavior coexistence and inference-time continuous control properties have real engineering value for multi-scenario deployment, and offer empirical evidence for the editability of the transformer residual stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: LARA inserts lightweight low-rank linear modules into the residual stream at selected transformer layers, leaving all base model weights frozen. Each module applies layer normalization followed by two linear projections (down to rank r, back to hidden dimension d) with no intermediate nonlinearity. The upward projection is initialized to zero so the model exactly matches the base at training start. Key properties: comparable performance to LoRA at equal parameter budgets; inference-time control of adaptation strength via a single scalar coefficient γ, enabling smooth interpolation between base and adapted behavior; support for multiple independent adaptation modules on one frozen base, with per-token routing to select behaviors at a small fraction of the memory cost of full model copies.
summary_en.experiments: Parameter-matched comparisons on code fine-tuning (SFT) and preference optimization (DPO) tasks: LARA is configured with 6 inserted layers, rank 128, hidden size 1536, with ~2.38M trainable parameters; LoRA is configured with rank 16 updates on Q/V projections across all layers, with ~2.18M trainable parameters. The two methods have <10% parameter difference and comparable performance. For SFT, distributing modules across multiple layers yields better results; for DPO, a single middle-layer module suffices. The γ coefficient enables smooth interpolation between base and adapted behavior at inference. A single adapter adds <0.2% of base forward pass cost; soft routing across 7 behaviors adds ~1%, while hard routing to one behavior adds only the cost of a single module.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on Section 2 (module design, parameter comparison logic), Section 3 (parameter-matched baseline results, inference-time control experiments, multi-behavior routing outcomes). Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 残差流适配避开权重空间约束，平滑插值和多行为路由是实用优势，做组合对齐实验时可作为LoRA替代方案测试。
recommendation.en: Residual-stream adaptation avoids weight-space constraints; smooth interpolation and per-token routing are practical advantages, worth testing as a LoRA alternative in composable alignment experiments.

paper.title: STAIF: A Stage-wise Optimization for Complex Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Following complex instructions with multiple explicit constraints remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing alignment methods, such as DPO, optimize holistic reward signals that often underemphasize strict satisfaction of individual constraints, particularly under out-of-distribution or multi-constraint settings. In this paper, we propose STAIF, a stage-wise optimization framework that decouples the alignment of subjective (soft) constraints from the optimization

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是复杂 instruction following 里的一个老问题，但切得更细：当用户指令同时包含多种约束时，现有对齐方法往往用一个整体偏好信号去优化，结果是软约束和硬约束被混在一起学，模型可能整体“像是更好”，但对某些必须满足的格式、结构、计数、语言、JSON 合法性之类的硬条件并不稳定。论文要解决的是：能否把不同类型约束拆开优化，让模型既学会主观偏好层面的风格/语气/内容倾向，也能对可验证约束做到更严格的逐项满足，尤其是在多约束和分布外组合下仍然保持稳定。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / alignment 侧的方法与数据工作，所以被标成 skim 是合适的。但它仍有两个值得注意的点。第一，它把 instruction following 里的约束异质性讲清楚了：不是所有约束都该用同一种目标学。软约束更适合偏好学习，硬约束更适合 verifier 驱动的 RL。这个拆分对做 reward design、RLVR、可验证对齐的人有现实参考。第二，它配套构建了 StaInstruct，一个带正样本、多负样本和 verifier code 的双语复杂约束数据集。对研究“训练信号质量”与“可验证奖励数据构造”的人，这部分比模型本身更有启发。若从 pretrain-posttrain 接口看，这篇论文说明：当训练目标和数据标注结构与任务结构对齐时，小模型也能在复杂行为约束上获得明显收益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 StaIF，核心是 stage-wise optimization，而不是把所有约束揉进一个统一损失里。作者先把约束分成两类：soft constraints 是主观、偏好型、难以程序验证的要求，比如语气、风格、鼓励性表达；hard constraints 是客观、可规则检查的要求，比如输出 JSON、包含指定字段、满足字数/格式/语言/枚举条件等。

Stage 1 用 preference optimization 去学 soft constraints，而且不是传统一对一 chosen/rejected，而是为同一条复杂指令构造多个负样本。这样做的理由很直接：复杂指令里常见的失败不是“完全错”，而是漏掉某一条约束、部分满足、风格偏差、格式轻微违规。多负样本能让模型看到更细粒度的错误形态，提升对软约束差异的辨别力。摘要和正文都提到这一阶段使用 multiple negative samples 来 sharpen sensitivity。

Stage 2 用 RLVR，具体实现是 GRPO，在有 verifier 的硬约束上直接做强化学习。这里的关键不是再训练一个 reward model，而是利用规则验证器给出确定性奖励，避免整体偏好目标把硬约束信号稀释掉。对于复杂 instruction following，这种设计是合理的，因为很多失败模式是离散的、可判定的，适合 binary 或 scalar verifier。

数据侧，作者提出自动化复杂约束合成框架，并构建 StaInstruct。数据构造不是简单拼接约束，而是显式建模 task-constraint compatibility，过滤无效、冗余、冲突约束。每条样本包含复杂指令、正样本回答、多个针对 soft constraints 的负样本，以及针对 hard constraints 的规则验证代码。这个数据结构正好支撑两阶段训练：第一阶段吃 preference triples / listwise negatives，第二阶段吃 verifier reward。

和常见 DPO 或单阶段 RL 相比，StaIF 的区别不在公式多新，而在训练信号分解得更贴近任务结构。作者的主张是：如果把软硬约束混在一个 holistic objective 里，模型会倾向于优化整体可接受性，而不是逐条满足关键约束；分阶段训练则能减少这种目标冲突。
summary.experiments:
实验在三个 instruction-following benchmark 上做：IFEval、IFBench、CFBench。底座模型选了两个开源模型：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Tulu3-8B-SFT。论文声称在这两个底座上都得到一致提升，并且 StaIF 训练后的 Tulu3-8B-SFT 在 IFEval 和 IFBench 上能接近一些更大闭源模型的水平。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格，这里不编造具体分数，但可以确认几个实验重点。

第一，主结果证明两阶段训练优于只做单阶段偏好优化或其他基线，且提升覆盖多个 benchmark，而不是只在一个数据集上有效。第二，ablation 显示两个阶段都有效：只做 Stage 1 会改善软约束相关表现，但对严格可验证约束不够；加入 Stage 2 后，hard constraint compliance 进一步提高。第三，多负样本设计是有效的。作者专门做了 negative sampling 的实验，说明多个负样本比单个 rejected response 提供更强的对比学习信号。第四，作者强调泛化而非记忆，说明他们做了更细粒度分析，检查模型是否只是记住训练模板，还是能迁移到新的约束组合。

如果从研究角度看，最值得留意的不是 benchmark 排名，而是约束类型拆分后的误差分析：哪些约束在 DPO 下容易被忽略，哪些约束在 verifier RL 下最容易被拉起来，以及 bilingual 数据是否让中文复杂指令跟随能力有额外收益。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“问题定义—数据—两阶段训练—消融”这个顺序看。

先看 Introduction，重点理解作者为什么坚持把 soft / hard constraints 分开。若这一点不认同，后面的设计就很难成立。

然后看 StaInstruct 数据构造部分。这里比方法公式更重要，因为复杂 instruction following 的上限很大程度取决于训练样本是否真的覆盖了多约束、冲突过滤、负样本多样性和 verifier 质量。要特别看 task-constraint compatibility、冲突过滤、以及 verifier code 是怎么生成和筛选的。

接着看 Stage 1 和 Stage 2 的训练细节，尤其是 multiple negatives 如何组织、GRPO 的 reward 如何定义。最后看 ablation：单阶段 vs 两阶段、多负样本 vs 单负样本、不同 benchmark 上的约束类型表现。

预计 25-35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若时间很少，优先看数据构造图、主结果表和 ablation 表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in complex instruction following: when an instruction contains multiple constraints, existing alignment methods often optimize a single holistic preference signal, which blurs together heterogeneous requirements. As a result, models may improve in overall helpfulness while still failing strict must-satisfy constraints such as format, structure, counting, language, or valid JSON. The question is whether one can separate the optimization of subjective soft constraints from objectively verifiable hard constraints, so that the model learns both nuanced preference alignment and strict per-constraint compliance, especially under multi-constraint and out-of-distribution combinations.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper; it is better viewed as a post-training and alignment paper, so skim is the right level. Still, it has two useful ideas. First, it makes the heterogeneity of instruction constraints explicit: not all constraints should be learned with the same objective. Soft constraints fit preference learning better, while hard constraints fit verifier-driven RL better. That is relevant for reward design, RLVR, and verifiable alignment. Second, the paper contributes StaInstruct, a bilingual dataset with positive responses, multiple negatives, and verifier code for complex instructions. For researchers interested in training-signal quality and the construction of verifiable supervision, the data design may be more useful than the model recipe itself. From a pretrain-posttrain interface perspective, it is a clean example of how better alignment between task structure and supervision structure can produce meaningful gains even on relatively small open models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, StaIF, is a stage-wise optimization framework rather than a single unified objective. The paper splits constraints into two categories. Soft constraints are subjective and preference-like, such as tone, style, or encouraging phrasing. Hard constraints are objective and programmatically checkable, such as valid JSON, required fields, word-count limits, language requirements, or explicit formatting rules.

Stage 1 uses preference optimization to learn soft constraints. A notable design choice is the use of multiple negative responses for the same instruction rather than a single chosen/rejected pair. This matters because failures on complex instructions are often partial: a response may satisfy some constraints while missing others, or may be semantically correct but stylistically off. Multiple negatives expose the model to a richer set of near-miss errors and sharpen its sensitivity to soft-constraint violations.

Stage 2 applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, implemented with GRPO. The key idea is to optimize hard constraints directly using deterministic verifiers instead of relying on a learned reward model or a holistic preference objective. For complex instruction following, this is a natural fit because many important failures are discrete and checkable.

On the data side, the paper proposes an automated synthesis pipeline and builds StaInstruct. The construction is not just random constraint concatenation. It explicitly models task-constraint compatibility and filters invalid, redundant, or conflicting constraints. Each example includes a complex instruction, a high-quality positive response, multiple negative responses targeted at soft constraints, and rule-based verification code for hard constraints. This data structure aligns cleanly with the two training stages: preference learning in Stage 1 and verifier-based RL in Stage 2.

Compared with standard DPO or single-stage RL, the novelty is less about a new optimization formula and more about decomposing the training signal to match the structure of the task. The paper’s claim is that a holistic objective tends to optimize overall acceptability, while stage-wise training improves strict per-constraint satisfaction.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is conducted on three instruction-following benchmarks: IFEval, IFBench, and CFBench. Two open-source base models are used: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Tulu3-8B-SFT. The paper reports consistent gains across these bases and benchmarks, and states that StaIF-trained Tulu3-8B-SFT becomes competitive with some much larger proprietary models on IFEval and IFBench. Since the provided text does not include the full result tables, I will not fabricate exact scores, but the experimental structure is clear.

First, the main results show that the two-stage setup outperforms single-stage preference optimization and other baselines across multiple benchmarks, not just on one dataset. Second, the ablations indicate that both stages matter: Stage 1 improves soft-constraint sensitivity, while adding Stage 2 further strengthens strict compliance on verifiable constraints. Third, the multiple-negative design is empirically useful. The paper includes negative-sampling experiments showing that multiple rejected responses provide a stronger contrastive signal than a single negative. Fourth, the authors emphasize generalization rather than template memorization, suggesting that they analyze whether the model transfers to unseen combinations of constraints rather than merely fitting the training patterns.

For a researcher, the most interesting part is not the leaderboard position but the error breakdown by constraint type: which constraints are under-optimized by DPO-like objectives, which ones respond most to verifier-based RL, and whether the bilingual setup yields extra gains for Chinese complex instruction following.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: problem formulation, data construction, the two training stages, then ablations.

Start with the introduction and make sure the soft-vs-hard constraint split is convincing to you. The rest of the paper depends on that framing.

Then read the StaInstruct section carefully. It is arguably more important than the optimization details, because the ceiling on complex instruction following depends heavily on whether the training data really covers multi-constraint composition, conflict filtering, negative diversity, and verifier quality. Pay special attention to task-constraint compatibility, conflict filtering, and how verifier code is generated and validated.

After that, read the Stage 1 and Stage 2 training details, especially how multiple negatives are organized and how GRPO rewards are defined. Finally, inspect the ablations: single-stage vs two-stage, single-negative vs multiple-negatives, and performance broken down by benchmark or constraint type.

A useful skim should take about 25-35 minutes. If time is short, prioritize the data construction figure, the main result table, and the ablation table.

recommendation.zh: 软硬约束解耦的两阶段对齐思路比整体DPO更符合约束满足的结构，重点看阶段2可验证奖励的设计与负样本构造方式，可复用到预训练后对齐的约束类任务。
recommendation.en: The two-stage alignment idea decoupling soft/hard constraints is structurally more sound than holistic DPO; focus on Stage 2 verifiable reward design and negative sample construction, reusable for constraint-heavy post-pretraining alignment.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Learning When to Reason for Text-to-SQL via SFT and DPO
paper.abstract: Recent Text-to-SQL methods rely heavily on reasoning-centric paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), achieving substantial gains on complex benchmarks at the cost of high inference-time overhead. However, a large fraction of real-world queries are simple lookups or aggregations that can be resolved without multi-step deduction, making forced reasoning wasteful. Thus, we propose AutoThinkSQL, a framework that integrates an auto-thinking mechanism into both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direc

summary.core_problem: 解决 Text-to-SQL 中强制 CoT 推理带来的 token 和延迟浪费，让模型学会在简单问题上跳过推理、复杂问题上调用深度推理。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向推理计算分配的后训练方法，使用 SFT 和 DPO 学习“何时推理”。任务是 Text-to-SQL，但结论触及更一般的 test-time reasoning budget 控制问题。
summary.technical_approach: AutoThinkSQL 在 SFT 和 DPO 中引入 auto-thinking 机制，使模型根据查询复杂度动态选择直接生成 SQL 或生成深度 CoT。方法不是改模型架构，而是通过监督和偏好优化塑造输出策略，目标是在保持或提升准确率的同时减少冗余 reasoning tokens。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B，在 Spider 和 BIRD 上相对最强对应 baseline 取得一致提升；相比只使用 CoT，平均输出 token 分别减少 24.6% 和 18.3%，平均延迟分别降低 17.1% 和 11.5%。摘要未给出训练数据规模和完整 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Seoul National University、Samsung Electronics AI Center 及 SNU 相关研究中心；团队背景覆盖数据库、AI 与机器学习。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the waste caused by forcing Chain-of-Thought reasoning for all Text-to-SQL queries, aiming to reason only when the query complexity warrants it.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for inference-compute allocation: learning when to invoke reasoning through SFT and DPO. Although the task is Text-to-SQL, the setup is relevant to broader control of test-time reasoning budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoThinkSQL introduces an auto-thinking mechanism in both supervised fine-tuning and Direct Preference Optimization. The model learns to either directly generate SQL for simple queries or produce deeper CoT for complex ones. The method shapes generation policy rather than changing the architecture.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, the method improves over the strongest corresponding baseline on Spider and BIRD while reducing average output tokens by 24.6% and 18.3%, and average latency by 17.1% and 11.5% compared with CoT-only generation. The abstract does not disclose training-data scale or the full baseline set.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Seoul National University, Samsung Electronics AI Center, and affiliated SNU research centers, with work spanning databases, AI, and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: Text-to-SQL 设定偏窄，但“训练模型少想一点”值得看数字；只读方法和 token/latency 表。
recommendation.en: The Text-to-SQL setup is narrow, but the learned 'think less' policy is worth checking; read the method and token/latency tables only.

institutions: AIIS, ASRI, INMC, ISRC, and IPAI, Seoul National University

paper.title: CANN Bench: Benchmarking Agent Generated Kernels against Real NPU and Algorithmic Limits
paper.abstract: AI agents are now capable of writing, compiling, and iteratively optimizing low-level operator kernels on different hardware platforms. Existing benchmarks, however, focus almost exclusively on CUDA and Triton, leaving hardware ecosystems with less-exposed programming models without a common evaluation baseline. We present CANN Bench, an open benchmark for AI-generated operator code on Huawei's Ascend NPU. The current release covers 53 operators and 1060 test cases organized into four difficulty

summary.core_problem: 现有AI生成算子内核的基准几乎只覆盖CUDA/Triton生态，华为昇腾NPU的CANN编程栈缺乏独立于特定训练配方、覆盖真实生产负载与多精度的统一评测基线，无法客观衡量Agent生成昇腾算子的真实能力。
summary.importance: 为面向NPU的代码生成Agent的SFT/RL训练提供了标准化的反馈信号与评测锚点；其覆盖MoE调度、FlashAttention等LLM训练核心算子的设计，可直接服务于大模型训练栈的算子自动化优化场景；反奖励黑客与持续演进的设计思路对同类基准构建有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 先定义6项设计准则，再构建包含53个算子、1060个测试用例的基准集，按难度分为4档（从逐元素原语到MoE调度、FlashAttention融合算子），覆盖FP16/BF16/FP32/INT4/INT8精度；采用编译通过率、功能正确性、硬件性能三维加权综合评分，任一维度失败会严格限制其余维度得分；每个算子配套规格说明、黄金实现、公开测试用例与性能基线，内置反奖励黑客检测（识别绕过精度断言、硬编码形状、记忆输出等行为），基准任务与协议会随昇腾硬件、CANN版本、模型家族迭代更新。
summary.experiments: 对比现有基准的覆盖缺口：KernelBench、TritonBench等仅支持NVIDIA平台，其分块语义与缓冲结构设计无法直接迁移到昇腾；MultiKernelBench跨平台但昇腾任务深度不足、精度覆盖窄；NPUKernelBench绑定特定AscendKernelGen训练配方，静态形状测试易被形状特化算子绕过。配套方法验证显示，AscendKernelGen在二级难度下Pass@10编译率从0%提升到95.5%，AscendOptimizer在127个cann-ops算子上取得1.19倍几何平均加速。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1.2节的6项设计准则（理解基准设计的核心约束）、第2节的任务分层与三维评分规则、表1的现有基准对比；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，若用于训练代码Agent可进一步查看附录的测试用例规范。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for AI-generated operator kernels almost exclusively target the CUDA and Triton ecosystems. The CANN programming stack for Huawei Ascend NPUs lacks a standardized evaluation baseline independent of specific training recipes, with coverage of real production workloads and multi-precision formats, making it impossible to objectively measure agent capability for Ascend kernel generation.
summary_en.importance: Provides a standardized feedback signal and evaluation anchor for SFT/RL training of code generation agents targeting NPUs. Its coverage of LLM training-critical operators (MoE dispatch, FlashAttention) directly supports automated operator optimization for large model training stacks. The anti-reward-hacking and continuous evolution design offers a reference framework for similar benchmark construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: First defines 6 design criteria, then builds a benchmark with 53 operators and 1060 test cases organized into 4 difficulty tiers (from elementwise primitives to fused operators like MoE dispatch and FlashAttention), covering FP16, BF16, FP32, INT4, INT8 precisions. Adopts a 3-dimensional weighted composite score across compilation pass rate, functional correctness, and hardware performance, where failure in any dimension strictly limits credit on the others. Each operator ships with specification, golden implementation, public test cases, and performance baseline. Built-in anti-reward-hacking detection identifies bypassed accuracy assertions, hard-coded shapes, and memorized outputs. The task set and evaluation protocol evolve with Ascend hardware, CANN releases, and new model families.
summary_en.experiments: Comparison with prior benchmarks shows KernelBench, TritonBench and similar only support NVIDIA platforms, with tiling semantics and buffer structure designs that do not transfer to Ascend. MultiKernelBench is cross-platform but has limited depth for Ascend tasks and narrow precision coverage. NPUKernelBench is tied to the specific AscendKernelGen training recipe, with static-shape tests that can be gamed by shape-specialized kernels. Companion method validation shows AscendKernelGen reaches 95.5% Pass@10 compilation rate on level-2 tasks (up from 0%), and AscendOptimizer achieves 1.19x geometric mean speedup across 127 cann-ops operators.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 1.2 (6 design criteria, core constraints of benchmark design), Section 2 (task tiering and 3-axis scoring rules), Table 1 (comparison with existing benchmarks). Estimated reading time 15-20 minutes. For code agent training use cases, refer to the appendix for test case specifications.

recommendation.zh: DPO 加可靠性加权是合理方向，对理解偏好数据质量与对齐效果的关系有参考，重点看可靠性估计的具体实现和消融。
recommendation.en: Reliability-weighted DPO is a sensible direction; useful for understanding how preference data quality affects alignment. Focus on the reliability estimation details and ablations.

paper.title: Inference-Time Steering for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency in LLMs
paper.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable multilingual fluency, their internal knowledge representations remain disproportionately biased toward high-resource languages. This leads to cross-lingual factual inconsistency, where they shift their empirical answer distributions based solely on the prompt language. We investigate whether these biases can be mitigated at inference time, forcing an English-prompted model to answer as if it were queried in target languages (German, Sp

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在不同提示语言下给出不同事实答案的问题，并尝试在推理或轻量后训练阶段让模型保持跨语言事实一致。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是方法比较和诊断：把多语言事实一致性从普通多语言能力评测中拆出来，比较 persona prompting、激活干预和 DPO 这几类低成本修正手段。对预训练研究的价值在于暴露了高资源语言知识表征的偏置，而不是给出新的基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文评估四种干预：零样本上下文 steering、Contrastive Activation Addition 对内部表示做加性干预、基于 benchmark 派生事实数据的 DPO，以及基于概念泛化数据的 DPO。目标是让英语提示下的模型回答分布更接近德语、西语、保加利亚语等目标语言提示下的分布。
summary.experiments: 作者构建了一个多语言事实数据集，并设计了包含文化根植问题的泛化 benchmark。实验覆盖德语、西班牙语、保加利亚语等目标语言，比较推理时提示、激活 steering 和轻量权重更新。给定摘要未提供具体模型、样本规模和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cross-lingual factual inconsistency, where an LLM changes its empirical answer distribution solely because the prompt language changes.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly diagnostic and comparative: it isolates factual consistency from generic multilingual fluency and compares prompting, activation intervention, and DPO-style lightweight correction. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is the evidence of high-resource-language bias in stored knowledge rather than a new base-model recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper evaluates four interventions: zero-shot contextual steering, Contrastive Activation Addition on internal representations, DPO trained on benchmark-derived factual preferences, and DPO trained on conceptual generalization data. The goal is to make an English-prompted model behave as if it had been queried in target languages such as German, Spanish, and Bulgarian.
summary_en.experiments: The authors curate a multilingual factual dataset and a generalization benchmark with culturally rooted queries. Experiments compare prompting, activation steering, and lightweight weight updates across German, Spanish, and Bulgarian targets. The supplied abstract does not report model names, dataset size, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 multilingual factuality 的干预清单可扫一眼；真正值得看的是 CAA 和 DPO 哪类偏置改不动。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick scan as a multilingual factuality intervention map; the useful part is where CAA or DPO fails to move the bias.

paper.title: When Physical Preferences Meet Semantic Constraints: Physical and Semantic Direct Preference Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have achieved strong visual realism, but improving physical plausibility can come at the cost of semantic consistency with the input text. This tension arises because physical preference is typically determined by comparing dynamics between two videos, without accounting for whether either video faithfully depicts the scene specified by the prompt, making physical-semantic conflict a systematic tendency under this supervision paradigm. We formulate this chal

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到视频生成中“物理合理性偏好优化”容易破坏文本语义一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成后训练中的偏好目标修正：把物理偏好和语义约束放进同一个优化问题，并分析冲突偏好对语义漂移的梯度影响。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Physical and Semantic Direct Preference Optimization，把每个偏好样本对的训练权重或贡献按物理信号与语义信号的一致程度进行调制；通过梯度级分析证明冲突样本导致的语义漂移可被限制到可控残差，并设计分阶段优化流程降低累计漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体 T2V 基座模型、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和提升幅度；只说明方法完全在偏好优化框架内工作，用于改善物理 plausibility 与 prompt semantic consistency 的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the trade-off in text-to-video generation where optimizing for physical plausibility can degrade semantic consistency with the input prompt.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization objective for multimodal generation: it treats physical preference learning as constrained by semantic agreement and analyzes gradient-level semantic drift from conflicting pairs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Physical and Semantic Direct Preference Optimization, which modulates the contribution of each preference pair according to the agreement between its physical and semantic signals. A gradient analysis motivates a staged optimization protocol that bounds and reduces cumulative semantic drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact T2V backbone, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It reports the method as a preference-optimization approach for improving the balance between physical plausibility and prompt faithfulness.

recommendation.zh: 看作视频生成版 DPO 目标设计案例即可；理论边界可能依赖打分器质量，预训练侧不必深读。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a T2V preference-objective design case; the bounds likely depend on scorer quality, so it is not a deep pretraining read.

paper.title: Diversity-Oriented Fine-Tuning for Uncertainty-Based Hallucination Detection
paper.abstract: Existing hallucination detection methods are typically conducted at the inference stage, without making any modifications to the model itself. In this paper, we are interested in exploring fine-tuning strategies that enhance the detectability of hallucinations in the resulting model. Focusing on semantic-entropy-based detection, we observe that many erroneous outputs remain undetected because the model produces nearly identical incorrect answers across multiple runs. To address this, we propose

summary.core_problem: 现有基于语义熵的幻觉检测方法在推理阶段运行、不修改模型，当模型反复生成几乎一致的错误答案时，低语义熵会导致幻觉漏检。
summary.importance: 属于后训练阶段的增量改进，揭示了生成多样性与幻觉可检测性的关联，为不确定性校准提供了微调层面的思路，但未突破现有幻觉检测的整体框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两种面向多样性的微调策略：1）基于SFT的微调，鼓励模型对同一问题生成多样的候选答案；2）基于DPO的微调，通过偏好优化提升错误答案的输出多样性，最终降低幻觉样本的低语义熵比例，提升语义熵检测器的召回率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体测试模型、数据集与量化提升幅度，仅报告微调后幻觉样本的低语义熵占比下降，语义熵检测效果改善（摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing semantic entropy-based hallucination detection methods operate at inference time without modifying the model; when models repeatedly generate nearly identical incorrect answers, low semantic entropy leads to missed hallucination detections.
summary_en.importance: An incremental post-training improvement that reveals the correlation between generation diversity and hallucination detectability, provides a fine-tuning level perspective for uncertainty calibration, but does not break the overall framework of existing hallucination detection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes two diversity-oriented fine-tuning strategies: 1) SFT-based fine-tuning that encourages models to generate diverse candidates for the same query; 2) DPO-based fine-tuning that increases the diversity of incorrect answers via preference optimization, ultimately reducing the share of hallucinated samples with low semantic entropy and improving detector recall.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific test models, datasets or quantitative improvements, only reports that the share of hallucinated samples with low semantic entropy decreases after fine-tuning, leading to better detection performance (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: 增量式后训练工作，通过多样性微调放大错误答案的熵信号，对预训练无直接启发，了解核心思路即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: An incremental post-training work that amplifies entropy signals of incorrect answers via diversity-oriented fine-tuning, no direct implication for pretraining; grasp the core idea without reading the full paper.

paper.title: Step-Level Preference Learning for Generative Agents in Social Simulations
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based generative agents simulate human behavior through long-horizon decision-making processes that comprise intermediate steps such as planning, memory retrieval, reflection, and action selection. However, fine-grained human annotations of these intermediate steps remain scarce, and existing agents are not grounded in human preferences over such intermediate decisions. To address this gap, we introduce \method, an interactive simulation interface that enables us to co

summary.core_problem: 生成式智能体在社会模拟中的中间决策步骤（规划、记忆检索、反思、动作选择）缺乏细粒度人类偏好标注，现有智能体未基于人类对中间决策的偏好进行训练。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献：提出步级偏好学习框架，构建57K细粒度标注数据集，验证中间步骤偏好监督对智能体行为的提升作用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建交互式模拟界面收集智能体决策轨迹的步级人类偏好标注，分别用SFT和DPO在开源模型上进行步级偏好学习。
summary.experiments: 在社会模拟任务上验证，步级偏好学习持续提升模拟保真度、协作能力和交互质量，诱导更具社会有效性的智能体行为。

summary_en.core_problem: Generative agents for social simulations lack fine-grained human preference annotations for intermediate decision steps (planning, memory retrieval, reflection, action selection), and existing agents are not trained with human preferences over such intermediate decisions.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: proposes a step-level preference learning framework and releases a 57K fine-grained annotation dataset, validating the benefit of intermediate-step preference supervision for agent behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an interactive simulation interface to collect step-level human preference annotations over agent decision trajectories, then applies SFT and DPO on open-weight models for step-level preference learning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on social simulation tasks; step-level preference learning consistently improves simulation fidelity, coordination, and interaction quality, inducing more socially effective agent behavior.

recommendation.zh: 社会模拟领域的偏好学习应用，对通用预训练启发有限，作为中间步骤偏好标注思路可备查。
recommendation.en: Preference learning applied to social simulation agents; limited relevance to general pretraining, the step-level annotation idea is worth noting for reference.

paper.title: Groc-PO: Grounded Context Preference Optimization for Truthful Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they still suffer from untruthfulness issues, such as visual hallucinations, content fabrication, and unfaithful reasoning, which substantially undermine their faithfulness and practical utility. Alignment methods based on human preference, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), have been widely adopted to address these issues. However, multimodal reasoning errors often propagate across stages, and final-answer errors

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型在视觉问答与推理中出现的幻觉、内容编造和不忠实推理问题，尤其是标准偏好优化只在最终答案层面监督、难以纠正早期 grounding 错误的信用分配缺陷。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练对齐方向的方法改进，贡献点在于把多模态偏好优化从“只看最终答案”推进到“显式约束中间 grounding 上下文”。对做 MLLM 对齐的人有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Groc-PO（Grounded Context Preference Optimization），核心思路是在偏好优化中引入 grounded context 级别的监督，而不是仅比较最终回答优劣。方法试图把多模态推理拆成早期视觉 grounding 与后续答案生成两个层次，在训练时对中间上下文一致性、证据对齐和阶段性错误传播进行约束，从而缓解 grounding drift 导致的后续错误放大。整体属于 DPO 在多模态 truthful alignment 场景下的结构化改造，而不是新的预训练范式。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，论文主要比较标准 DPO 式方法与其 grounded preference 变体在多模态真实性相关任务上的表现，关注视觉幻觉、事实一致性和推理忠实度。摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为方法思路了解，而不是据此更新强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学技术大学、小米、传播内容认知全国重点实验室、人民网。不是当前多模态对齐领域最强信号团队，但有产学结合背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets untruthfulness in multimodal LLMs—visual hallucination, fabrication, and unfaithful reasoning—arguing that standard preference optimization only supervises final answers and fails to correct early grounding errors.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training alignment contribution rather than a pretraining one. Its value lies in moving multimodal preference optimization from answer-level supervision to intermediate grounding-aware supervision, which is useful for MLLM alignment but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Groc-PO, a grounded context preference optimization framework. The key idea is to optimize preferences not only over final responses but also over grounded intermediate context, so that early-stage visual grounding and context consistency receive direct training signal. In effect, it restructures DPO for multimodal truthful reasoning by addressing credit assignment across reasoning stages, rather than introducing a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation appears to compare standard DPO-style baselines against the proposed grounded preference variant on multimodal truthfulness settings, focusing on hallucination, factual faithfulness, and reasoning fidelity. The abstract does not expose model size, data scale, or exact gains, so the evidence should be treated as directional until the full setup is inspected.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from USTC, Xiaomi, the State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, and People’s Daily Online. This is a credible academic-industry collaboration, though not a top-tier signal source for changing priors on multimodal alignment.

recommendation.zh: 这是把 DPO 信号往中间 grounding 迁移的一次合理改造；对做 MLLM 对齐可借鉴，但离 pretrain 较远，先看方法图和误差分解就够了。
recommendation.en: A sensible extension of DPO toward intermediate grounding supervision; useful if you work on MLLM alignment, but too far from pretraining to warrant a full read—method figure and error analysis are enough.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition, People’s Daily Online

paper.title: Metadata-Free Meta-Reweighted Direct Preference Optimization under Noisy Preference Labels
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become an important method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because it removes the need for explicit reward modeling and reinforcement learning optimization. However, its performance depends heavily on the quality of preference data, and noisy preference data in real-world settings can weaken alignment performance. To address this issue, we propose a bilevel optimization framework and prove, under certain assumptions, that

summary.core_problem: DPO 在偏好标签含噪声时对齐效果下降，且现有重加权方法依赖难以获取的元数据。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无需元数据的双层元重加权 DPO 框架，并给出非对称翻转噪声下权重函数的先验形式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建双层优化框架，理论证明在特定假设下可恢复干净数据的 DPO 最优解；推导非对称标签翻转噪声下可学习权重函数的先验；采用元知识驱动的任务无关方法实现无元数据场景的元学习；结合中心差分近似与 LoRA 微调降低高阶梯度计算成本。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据集及量化对比结果，仅给出方法推导与近似策略。

summary_en.core_problem: DPO alignment degrades under noisy preference labels, and existing reweighting methods rely on hard-to-obtain metadata.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a metadata-free bilevel meta-reweighted DPO framework with a closed-form prior for asymmetric label-flip noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulate a bilevel optimization framework and prove it recovers the clean-data DPO optimum under mild assumptions; derive a prior form for the learnable weighting function under asymmetric label-flipping noise; design a task-agnostic meta-knowledge-driven method that works without any metadata; combine central-difference approximation with LoRA fine-tuning to reduce the cost of higher-order gradients in LLM meta-learning.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete model size, dataset, or quantitative baseline results are reported in the abstract; the paper focuses on derivations and the approximation strategy.

recommendation.zh: 理论推导完整但实验披露不足，作为噪声偏好对齐的弱信号参考，重点看权重先验推导部分。
recommendation.en: Theoretical derivation is solid but experimental disclosure is thin; treat it as a weak signal for noisy preference alignment and focus on the weight prior derivation.

paper.title: Agentic-DPO: From Imitation to Agentic Policy Optimization on Expert Trajectories
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are commonly trained from expert trajectories using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which treats multi-turn agent behavior as ordinary text imitation. This recipe is simple and low-cost, but it only learns to imitate the sequence of expert actions, rather than training the agent to choose the right action against plausible mistakes at each state. Existing methods to mitigate this problem include preference learning or reinforcement learning, but they usually need

summary.core_problem: Agentic-DPO 解决的是 agent 轨迹训练中的行为克隆错配问题：SFT 只学习专家轨迹的 token 序列，却没有把每一步工具调用、动作选择和参数生成当作状态条件下的决策来优化。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 LLM agent 的 post-train 有直接参考价值，也对预训练研究中的“轨迹数据如何转成更强训练信号”有启发。关键贡献不是提出新的在线 RL，而是证明专家轨迹本身可以被重写成局部偏好数据：在同一个状态下，专家动作作为正例，当前学生模型的一步采样动作作为负例。这样能让模型学习“在当前状态不要选自己容易犯的错”，比单纯模仿专家 token 更接近策略学习。它的价值在于成本结构清楚：不需要环境 rollout、不需要 reward model、不需要完整轨迹探索，适合已有大量专家轨迹但在线交互昂贵的场景。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是把专家轨迹拆成状态-动作决策点。对每个专家动作状态，模型先看到当前状态，再从学生策略采样一个一步动作作为负样本，专家动作作为偏好正样本，然后用 DPO 风格目标拉开二者的相对概率。这里的关键是 rollout 只到当前动作，不执行环境，因此负样本反映当前学生策略的局部错误，而不是完整失败轨迹。第二层是 SFT anchor。作者没有直接用偏好学习从零学动作格式，而是保留 SFT 约束，让模型先维持合法的工具调用和输出格式，避免 DPO 在结构化 action string 上训练不稳。第三层是 Policy-Preserving Augmentation，简称 PPA。agent 动作文本通常同时包含“策略决策”和“schema 渲染方式”，DPO 可能把 schema 表面差异也当作偏好方向。PPA 将同一条潜在轨迹渲染到多个 action schema 下，保持潜在策略不变，只改变表面形式，使偏好梯度更集中在动作选择本身，而不是具体格式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 StableToolBench、τ-bench retail 和 Mind2Web，分别对应受控工具调用、长程用户交互和网页 GUI grounding。给出的主要结果较明确：在 StableToolBench 上，Qwen3.5-2B 经 SFT 的 canonical accuracy 为 57.1%，Agentic-DPO 提升到 90.9%。在 τ-bench retail 上，Qwen3.5-9B 的成功率达到 41.4%，高于同 backbone 的 GRPO 40.0%，但不需要在线 RL rollout。在 Mind2Web 上，跨 task、跨 website、跨 domain 三类 held-out split 的平均 step success 为 64.4%。这些结果支持一个结论：对于小模型 agent，专家轨迹中的状态结构没有被 SFT 充分利用；用当前学生的一步错误构造局部偏好，能显著提高动作选择质量。需要注意的是，摘要和正文片段主要展示 benchmark 结果，若精读应进一步检查负样本采样温度、DPO beta、SFT/DPO 配比、PPA 视图数量，以及不同 benchmark 上 gains 是否来自格式修正还是真实决策改进。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Figure 1，确认它和 SFT、Step-DPO、PivotRL、Agent-RLVR 的成本差异。再看 Method 的 Algorithm 1、DPO loss 定义、SFT anchor 和 PPA 设计，重点判断负样本是否足够“像模型会犯的错”。实验部分优先看 StableToolBench 的大幅提升是否有 action-format 相关因素，再看 τ-bench retail 与 GRPO 的同 backbone 对比，最后看 Mind2Web 的分 split 结果。消融部分若完整正文提供，应重点看去掉 SFT anchor、去掉 PPA、改变负样本来源后的退化幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Agentic-DPO addresses a mismatch in agent trajectory training: SFT treats expert trajectories as token sequences, while an agent actually needs to learn state-conditioned decisions over tool calls, actions, arguments, and final responses.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to agent post-training, but it also carries a useful lesson for pretraining researchers who care about converting trajectories into stronger learning signals. Its main contribution is not online RL. It shows that expert trajectories can be transformed into local preference supervision: at each expert state, the expert action is preferred over a one-step action sampled from the current student policy. This gives the model direct contrastive feedback against its own likely mistakes. The cost profile is the main appeal: no environment rollout, no reward model, and no full-trajectory exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first decomposes expert trajectories into state-action decision points. For each expert action state, the current student samples a one-step action without executing it in the environment. The expert action and this student action form a preference pair, trained with a DPO-style objective. This differs from standard behavior cloning because the model is not only asked to raise the probability of the demonstrated action; it is also asked to lower the relative probability of a plausible wrong action under the same state. Two stabilizers are important. The SFT anchor keeps the model close to valid expert behavior and action formatting, so preference learning does not have to discover structured tool syntax by itself. Policy-Preserving Augmentation renders the same latent trajectory under multiple schemas while preserving the underlying policy. This reduces gradients that are dominated by schema-level surface differences rather than actual decision quality.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses StableToolBench, τ-bench retail, and Mind2Web, covering controlled tool use, long-horizon user-interleaved interaction, and web GUI grounding. On StableToolBench, Qwen3.5-2B improves from 57.1% SFT canonical accuracy to 90.9% with Agentic-DPO. On τ-bench retail, Qwen3.5-9B reaches 41.4% success, compared with 40.0% for GRPO under the same backbone, while avoiding online RL rollouts. On Mind2Web, the method reports 64.4% average step success across cross-task, cross-website, and cross-domain held-out splits. These numbers suggest that SFT leaves substantial decision-level signal unused in expert trajectories, especially for smaller agents. A careful reading should still check whether the gains come from better action selection, better schema handling, or both.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand the cost difference from SFT, Step-DPO, PivotRL, and Agent-RLVR. Then read Algorithm 1, the DPO objective, the SFT anchor, and Policy-Preserving Augmentation. In the experiments, focus on the StableToolBench jump, the same-backbone comparison with GRPO on τ-bench retail, and the split-level Mind2Web results. If the full ablations are available, prioritize removing the SFT anchor, removing PPA, and changing the source of negative actions.

recommendation.zh: 将DPO改造为离线agent策略优化方法，无需环境rollout，思路轻量，可借鉴到内部agent后训练的消融实验中。
recommendation.en: Adapts DPO to offline agent policy optimization without environment rollouts; lightweight idea worth referencing in internal agent post-training ablation studies.

paper.title: D2PO: Optimizing Diffusion Samplers via Dynamic Preference
paper.abstract: We propose D2PO (Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization), a principled framework for optimizing diffusion sampling policies with respect to timestep schedules and classifier-free guidance (CFG) weights. Our work is motivated by a fundamental limitation of existing student-teacher regression frameworks; low-NFE student samplers are trained to mimic high-NFEteachers, often sacrificing high-frequency texture fidelity while preserving coarse global structures, thereby misaligning the sampler with pe

summary.core_problem: 优化低步数 diffusion sampler 的 timestep schedule 和 classifier-free guidance 权重，避免单纯模仿高步数 teacher 时损失高频纹理质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是扩散生成采样器的偏好优化方法。它把 DPO 思路迁移到 diffusion sampler，对多模态生成和 preference-based optimization 有参考价值，但不是文本 Diffusion LM 或 LLM 预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 D2PO，即 Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization。方法把采样策略建模为 energy-based model，将偏好比较转化为能量差；同时从预训练 score network 直接构造能量形式，使偏好信号可以用于 timestep 与 CFG 动态策略优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露使用的数据集、基础 diffusion 模型、NFE 设置、评价指标或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 是 student-teacher regression 低 NFE sampler，以及高 NFE teacher 模仿范式。
summary.authors_note: Bohyung Han 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者；输入元数据未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper optimizes low-NFE diffusion samplers over timestep schedules and classifier-free guidance weights, targeting the texture loss caused by teacher-regression distillation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization method for diffusion generation. It is relevant to multimodal generation and preference-based training, but it is not a text diffusion LM or LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: D2PO, or Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization, reformulates sampler optimization as preference alignment. It models the sampling policy as an energy-based model, turns preference comparisons into energy differences, and derives an energy formulation directly from the pretrained score network.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, base diffusion models, NFE budgets, metrics, or quantitative improvements. The stated baseline is the common student-teacher regression setup for low-NFE samplers that imitates high-NFE teachers.
summary_en.authors_note: Bohyung Han is a well-known computer vision researcher; affiliation details are not provided in the supplied metadata.

recommendation.zh: 偏好优化迁移到 sampler 的角度可备查；若关心 LLM pretrain，只看 EBM-DPO 推导即可。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for moving preference optimization into samplers; for LLM pretraining, only the EBM-DPO derivation is worth a look.

paper.title: Spinning Straw into Gold: Relabeling LLM Agent Trajectories in Hindsight for Successful Demonstrations
paper.abstract: Large language model agents operate in partially observable, long-horizon settings where obtaining supervision remains a major bottleneck. We address this by utilizing a source of supervision overlooked in existing post-training methods: unintended yet successful goals embedded within agent rollouts. Specifically, we introduce Hindsight Supervised Learning (HSL), where an auxiliary LLM reviews each completed trajectory and relabels it with all of the natural-language goals the agent actually ach

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在长程、部分可观测环境里很难获得有效监督。失败轨迹通常被丢弃，但这些轨迹可能已经完成了其他有效目标。论文要解决的问题是：如何把 agent 自己生成的轨迹重新标注成可训练的成功示范，从而降低专家示范和稀疏奖励探索的依赖。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-training 方法论文，对预训练研究的启发主要在训练信号再利用。它不是改基座预训练目标，但提出了一种有清晰假设的数据生成方式：先让模型与环境交互，再用更强或辅助 LLM 做事后目标识别，把原本低回报的 rollout 转换成条件化监督数据。这个思路和 hindsight experience replay 类似，适合思考 agent 数据闭环、轨迹级 SFT 数据构造，以及 RL 前的冷启动数据扩增。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Hindsight Supervised Learning，简称 HSL。流程分三步：先收集当前 agent 的环境轨迹；再用辅助 LLM 审阅完整轨迹，识别轨迹实际完成了哪些自然语言目标，并标注哪些动作与这些新目标相关；最后把“重标注目标—轨迹”对加入 SFT。关键点是把在线决策难题变成离线识别问题：辅助模型不需要预测环境转移，只需要根据完整 observation-action 序列判断完成了什么。由于原轨迹并不是为重标注目标生成的，论文加入两种修正：irrelevant-action masking 只对与新目标相关的动作计算训练损失，避免学习无关绕路；sample reweighting 根据重标注示范质量调整样本权重，降低噪声轨迹影响。和普通 SFT 相比，HSL 利用 agent 自己产生的数据；和 RL 相比，它不要求先发现原始指令下的高回报轨迹，而是从轨迹中挖掘其他成功目标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 ALFWorld、PlanCraft 和 WebShop，主要验证 HSL 能和已有 post-training 方法叠加。在 ALFWorld 上，HSL 与 SFT、DPO 等训练方式结合后，成功率提升幅度为 8% 到 32%。论文还强调样本效率：在少于四分之一 ground-truth demonstrations 的设置下，HSL 可以超过使用完整示范集训练的 baseline。消融结果支持两个设计选择：只用重标注目标训练会受到无关动作干扰；加入 relevance-based loss masking 和 demonstration reweighting 后，学习目标更干净，轨迹噪声更可控。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。优先看 Methods 里 HSL 的三阶段流程、goal identification 与 action relevance labeling 的 prompt/标注设计，以及 loss masking 和 reweighting 的定义。实验部分重点看 ALFWorld 的主结果和消融表，确认收益来自重标注机制，而不是额外训练步数或数据量。若关心 agent 数据闭环，可以细看它如何假设 goal space，以及辅助 LLM 误标时训练会受到什么影响。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents generate many long-horizon trajectories that are treated as failures under the original instruction, even though they may have achieved other valid goals. The paper asks how to recover supervision from those unintended successes and convert them into usable demonstrations.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as a data-reuse mechanism for agent post-training. It does not change foundation-model pretraining, but it gives a concrete recipe for turning self-generated rollouts into conditional supervised data. The useful idea is to separate hard online control from easier offline recognition: after the trajectory is complete, an auxiliary model can identify what was actually accomplished. This is a practical bridge between SFT-style agent training and sparse-reward RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hindsight Supervised Learning collects trajectories from the current agent, asks an auxiliary LLM to relabel each trajectory with natural-language goals that were actually achieved, and fine-tunes the agent on the relabeled goal-trajectory pairs. The relabeling stage has two parts: goal identification and action relevance labeling. The second part matters because a trajectory generated for one instruction may contain detours or actions that are irrelevant to the hindsight goal. HSL therefore adds relevance-based loss masking, so the model is not trained to imitate unrelated actions, and sample reweighting, so lower-quality relabeled demonstrations contribute less. Compared with standard SFT, it uses the agent’s own rollouts. Compared with RL, it does not require the original task reward to be high before learning can start.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on ALFWorld, PlanCraft, and WebShop. On ALFWorld, adding HSL to existing post-training pipelines such as SFT and DPO improves success rate by 8% to 32%. The sample-efficiency result is the most informative one: with less than one quarter of the ground-truth demonstrations, HSL outperforms baselines trained on the full demonstration set. Ablations indicate that relabeling alone is not enough; irrelevant-action masking and demonstration reweighting are needed to prevent noisy hindsight trajectories from becoming poor imitation targets.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 minutes. Read the method section for the three-stage HSL loop, the auxiliary-LLM relabeling procedure, and the exact loss masking/reweighting design. Then inspect the ALFWorld main results and ablations. The most useful details are the assumptions about the goal space, the reliability of hindsight relabeling, and how much of the gain comes from data reuse rather than simply adding more fine-tuning data.

recommendation.zh: 读 HSL 数据构造和 masking/reweighting；它把 agent 失败轨迹变成监督信号，适合拿去试 SFT/RL 数据回收。
recommendation.en: Read the HSL data construction plus masking/reweighting; it is a practical way to recycle failed agent rollouts into SFT/RL supervision.

paper.title: Unbiased Alignment for Large Language Models with Noisy Preferences
paper.abstract: The alignment of large language models with human preferences is commonly achieved through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback or Direct Preference Optimization. However, these methods are vulnerable to the significant noise prevalent in real-world preference datasets. To address this critical issue, we present a theoretical framework for unbiased alignment, introducing the Unbiased Reward Model (URM) loss and the Unbiased Direct Preference Optimization (UDPO) loss. By mathematically corr

summary.core_problem: 真实世界的偏好数据集通常包含 20%-40% 的噪声，导致 RLHF 和 DPO 等对齐方法学习到有偏差的奖励模型或策略，严重影响 LLM 的性能和安全性。
summary.importance: 提出了一个统一的无偏对齐理论框架，通过数学推导修正偏好噪声带来的偏差，使得模型可以在不依赖干净数据和精确噪声率估计的情况下，直接从噪声数据中学习到无偏的对齐策略。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思想是将偏好噪声建模为一个统计转移过程，并通过数学求逆来恢复无偏模型。针对 RLHF，推导了无偏奖励模型（URM）损失，在奖励模型训练阶段消除噪声偏差；针对 DPO，推导了无偏直接偏好优化（UDPO）损失，直接优化无偏策略。理论分析证明了 URM 和 UDPO 的数学等价性，并提供了梯度分析、参数向下兼容性等理论保证。
summary.experiments: 在多个数据集和模型系列上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，该框架在存在显著偏好噪声的情况下，能够有效恢复无偏模型，性能优于现有的噪声容忍对齐方法。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读理论推导部分，理解偏好噪声的统计建模以及 URM 和 UDPO 损失函数的推导过程。实验部分关注不同噪声比例下方法的鲁棒性表现。预计阅读时间 25 分钟。
