summary_en.core_problem: Real-world preference datasets often contain 20%-40% noise, causing alignment methods like RLHF and DPO to learn biased reward models or policies, severely degrading LLM performance and safety.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified theoretical framework for unbiased alignment, mathematically correcting the bias introduced by preference noise. This enables learning unbiased alignment strategies directly from noisy data without requiring clean data or precise noise rate estimation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to model preference noise as a statistical transition process and recover the unbiased model through mathematical inversion. For RLHF, it derives the Unbiased Reward Model (URM) loss to eliminate noise bias during reward model training. For DPO, it derives the Unbiased Direct Preference Optimization (UDPO) loss to directly optimize an unbiased policy. Theoretical analysis proves the mathematical equivalence of URM and UDPO and provides guarantees like gradient analysis and parameter downward compatibility.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model families show that the framework effectively recovers unbiased models in the presence of significant preference noise, outperforming existing noise-tolerant alignment methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the theoretical derivation section to understand the statistical modeling of preference noise and the derivation of the URM and UDPO loss functions. In the experiments, observe the robustness of the methods under different noise ratios. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标推导和噪声设定；若噪声模型贴近真实标注流，UDPO 值得进内部 DPO ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the loss derivation and noise assumptions; if the noise model matches real labeling pipelines, UDPO deserves an internal DPO ablation.

paper.title: Multi-Objective Exploration and Preference Optimization via Mutual Information
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models with diverse and heterogeneous human values requires multi-objective alignment methods to effectively trade off conflicting preference dimensions. Current methods achieve this trade-off by training policies conditioned on preference vectors and leveraging online direct preference optimization. However, exploration uncertainty can cause the reward distributions of responses generated under different preference vectors to overlap, and the generated responses may fail

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是多目标对齐中的条件控制失效问题。现有 MO-ODPO 类方法用偏好向量控制生成，希望模型在 helpfulness、harmlessness 等目标之间做可调权衡。但在线采样带来的探索噪声会让不同偏好条件下的回答奖励分布高度重叠，同一个偏好向量下的输出也有较大波动。结果是偏好向量虽然作为条件输入存在，生成结果却没有稳定反映这个条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏 post-train / alignment。但它有一个可借鉴的点：把“探索”和“条件可控性”统一到互信息目标里，而不是只靠偏好损失推动策略更新。对于多目标 RLHF、可控生成、pretrain-posttrain 接口中的条件信号质量分析，这个视角有参考意义。它提醒一个实际问题：条件向量进入模型并不等于模型真正使用了条件，训练目标需要显式奖励不同条件下输出分布的可区分性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 MI-EPO。核心目标是最大化联合条件互信息 I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X)，其中 X 是 prompt，Y 是 response，W 是偏好向量，Z 是概率路由变量，用来选择当前关注的目标维度，C_Z 是该目标下的反馈信号。作者用互信息链式分解，把目标拆成两部分：I(Y; C_Z | X, W, Z) 负责目标特定的偏好对齐，类似让输出和被选中目标的反馈更一致；I(Y; W | X) 负责偏好感知探索，鼓励不同偏好向量对应的输出在分布上可区分。和普通 MO-ODPO 的区别在于，后者主要优化偏好排序信号，默认条件控制会通过 DPO 学出来；MI-EPO 则显式加入 response 与 preference vector 的互信息项，减少不同偏好条件下输出同质化的问题。论文还使用 InfoNCE 形式给条件互信息构造可优化下界，使目标可以并入标准偏好优化训练。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文片段看，实验重点是比较 MI-EPO 与 MO-ODPO 等多目标在线偏好优化方法。作者报告的主要现象是：MO-ODPO 在相同偏好条件下 reward 波动较大，不同偏好条件下 reward 分布有明显重叠；MI-EPO 通过互信息项让不同偏好向量下的响应分布更分离，条件控制更稳定。片段中没有给出完整数据集、模型规模、训练步数和具体数值表，因此不宜补充未出现的数字。更可靠的实验结论是：互信息正则主要改善 preference-response alignment 和 preference-conditioned exploration，而不是单纯提高某个单目标 reward。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 MO-ODPO reward overlap 的诊断，以及方法部分对 I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X) 的分解。Preliminary 中 DPO 和 CMI / InfoNCE 的推导只需确认目标如何落到可训练损失上。实验部分建议重点看两个问题：不同偏好向量下输出分布是否真的更可分；互信息项是否带来 trade-off 曲线的改善，而不是只改变 reward 尺度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a control failure in multi-objective alignment. Recent MO-ODPO-style methods condition the policy on preference vectors, expecting the model to trade off dimensions such as helpfulness and harmlessness. In practice, online exploration introduces uncertainty: reward distributions under different preference vectors overlap, and responses sampled under the same preference condition fluctuate substantially. The conditioning signal is present in the input, but the generated response does not reliably reflect it.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly relevant to post-training and alignment rather than base pretraining. Its useful contribution is the information-theoretic framing: exploration and conditional controllability are optimized jointly through mutual information, instead of relying only on a preference-ranking loss. This is relevant for multi-objective RLHF, controllable generation, and the pretrain-posttrain interface, especially when analyzing whether a model actually uses conditioning signals. The main lesson is practical: adding a preference vector to the prompt or input representation does not guarantee conditional control; the objective may need to explicitly reward distinguishability across conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: MI-EPO maximizes the joint conditional mutual information I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X), where X is the prompt, Y is the response, W is the preference vector, Z is a probabilistic routing variable selecting an objective dimension, and C_Z is the feedback for that selected objective. The objective is decomposed into two complementary terms. I(Y; C_Z | X, W, Z) drives objective-specific preference alignment. I(Y; W | X) encourages preference-aware exploration, making responses generated under different preference vectors more distinguishable. Compared with standard MO-ODPO, which mainly optimizes pairwise preference signals and assumes the conditional policy will learn to use W, MI-EPO directly regularizes the dependence between responses and preference vectors. The paper uses an InfoNCE-style lower bound to make the conditional mutual information objective trainable within a preference-optimization pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the available full-content excerpt, the experiments focus on comparing MI-EPO with MO-ODPO and related multi-objective online preference optimization baselines. The key observed failure mode for MO-ODPO is large reward variance under the same preference condition and significant overlap between reward distributions under different conditions. MI-EPO is reported to make the response distributions more separable across preference vectors and to improve preference-response alignment. The excerpt does not provide full tables, model sizes, datasets, or exact numerical gains, so those details should not be inferred. The robust takeaway is that the mutual-information term improves conditional control and exploration quality, rather than merely increasing a scalar reward.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the diagnostic in the Introduction, especially Figure 1 and the reward-overlap argument, then read the derivation of I(Y; C_Z, W, Z | X) and its decomposition. The DPO and CMI / InfoNCE preliminaries are useful only insofar as they explain how the objective becomes a trainable loss. In the experiments, check whether the method truly separates outputs across preference vectors and whether the trade-off behavior improves, rather than only shifting reward scales.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；若 routing 真能降低目标混淆，内部多目标 DPO/RLVR 数据配方应复现。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; if routing really reduces objective confusion, it should be reproduced in internal multi-objective DPO/RLVR recipes.

paper.title: The Model Organism Lottery: Model Organism Interpretability Strongly Depends on Training Methodology
paper.abstract: Model organisms (MOs) - language models trained to exhibit undesired or unnatural behaviours - are frequently used as testbeds for evaluating white-box interpretability techniques. Current MOs are typically constructed via post-hoc supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on behavioural transcripts or synthetic documents. Prior research has shown that interpretability methods can easily identify hidden behaviours in these MOs. However, recent work suggests that such post-hoc training methods may make interp

summary.core_problem: 当前用于白盒可解释性技术评测的主流测试集是模型有机体（Model Organism, MO）——即被刻意训练出特定目标行为的语言模型。现有MO几乎都通过窄域后处理监督微调构造，这类MO上测得的可解释性结果能否外推到常规训练中自然涌现的行为，以及MO构造方法对可解释性评测结果的影响程度，此前没有系统研究。
summary.importance: 结果说明基于窄域SFT构造MO的基准得到的可解释性结果普遍偏乐观，无法可靠代表方法在真实模型上的表现。更重要的是，工作提供了明确证据：相同的外在行为可以由完全不同的内部表征支撑，训练方式（后处理SFT/DPO/融入正式后训练流程）对表征结构的影响远大于行为层面的相似性，这对理解post-training如何修改模型内部表征、设计更可靠的对齐评测方法都有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造了严格控制变量的MO测试集，共54个模型，基于OLMo2-1B和Gemma-3-1b-it两个底座，覆盖三类良性触发-反应行为：烘焙错误事实、食物语境下的意大利餐偏好、军事语境下的潜艇话题执念。每类行为下分别用7种训练方式构造MO变体：标准后处理转录蒸馏（TD）、合成文档微调（SDF），两种方法分别设置加/不加无关通用数据混合的版本；后处理DPO，同样设置加/不加通用数据混合的版本；以及更贴近真实流程的集成式训练：将行为相关数据直接混入OLMo原生的DPO后训练阶段共同训练。所有MO都校准到相同的行为触发率和反应强度，且控制行为不会泄露到无关语境。之后用四类主流白盒可解释性方法（激活预言机、基于激活差的引导、logit lens方法、稀疏自编码器）测试每个MO中植入行为的可检测程度，控制变量对比训练方法、行为类型、模型架构的影响。
summary.experiments: 核心结果包括三点：第一，外在行为完全匹配的MO，仅因训练方式不同，可解释性方法的检测成功率差异可达1.2-20.4倍；第二，传统窄域后处理SFT构造的MO可检测性最高，即最容易被解释，而最贴近真实后训练流程的集成式DPO构造的MO可检测性显著最低；第三，不同可解释性方法在不同训练方式MO上的表现排序，在不同行为类型、不同模型架构之间没有一致的泛化性，即一个方法在某类MO上表现好，不代表在其他训练方式得到的MO上同样有效。结果对训练随机性、数据顺序鲁棒，不是随机波动导致。全部54个MO、训练数据和代码已开源。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注核心结论部分——相同外在行为在不同训练方式下的内部表征可解释性差异，以及对现有MO基准有效性的讨论，这部分对理解post-training对表征的影响最有价值。各类MO的具体训练超参数、可解释性方法的实现细节可以跳过，如果做可解释性相关工作，再参考3.3节的集成式MO构造方法和3.4节的行为匹配控制流程。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Model organisms (MOs) — language models intentionally trained to exhibit specific target behaviors — are the standard testbed for white-box interpretability evaluation. Nearly all existing MOs are built via narrow post-hoc supervised fine-tuning, and it remains untested whether interpretability results on these artificial MOs generalize to behaviors that emerge during regular model training, or how strongly MO construction methodology affects measured interpretability performance.
summary_en.importance: Results show that interpretability benchmarks built on narrow SFT MOs produce consistently overoptimistic results, and do not reliably predict method performance on models trained via more realistic pipelines. Beyond implications for interpretability evaluation, the work provides clear evidence that identical observable behavior can be supported by drastically different internal representations: training methodology (post-hoc SFT / DPO / integrated post-training) has a far larger effect on representational structure than surface-level behavioral similarity. This is relevant to understanding how post-training modifies model internals, and to designing more robust alignment evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled suite of 54 MOs is constructed on OLMo2-1B and gemma-3-1b-it bases, covering three benign trigger-reaction quirks: false cake baking facts, Italian food preference in food contexts, and submarine fixation in military contexts. For each quirk, 7 training variants are produced: standard post-hoc transcript distillation and synthetic document fine-tuning (each with and without unrelated general data mixing), post-hoc DPO (with and without general data mixing), and a novel integrated construction method that inserts quirk data directly into OLMo’s official DPO post-training pipeline. All MOs are calibrated to identical quirk trigger rates and response strength, with controls to prevent quirk leakage into irrelevant contexts. Four standard white-box interpretability techniques (activation oracles, activation difference steering, logit lens, sparse autoencoders) are used to measure quirk detectability across all MOs under controlled conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings emerge: First, MOs with identical observable behavior exhibit 1.2–20.4× variation in quirk detectability, driven solely by training method. Second, standard narrow post-hoc SFT MOs are the most easily interpretable, while integrated DPO MOs (closest to realistic post-training pipelines) are consistently the least detectable. Third, performance rankings of interpretability methods across training protocols do not generalize across quirk types or model architectures, meaning strong performance on one MO variant does not predict performance on others. Results are robust to training nondeterminism and data ordering, and are not explained by random variation. All 54 MOs, training data, and code are open-sourced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core result that behaviorally identical models have drastically different interpretability based on training method, and the discussion of limitations in current MO benchmark design — these are the most relevant insights for understanding post-training representational changes. Skim detailed training hyperparameters and interpretability method implementation details unless actively building interpretability benchmarks; if so, refer to Section 3.3 for the integrated MO construction method and Section 3.4 for the behavioral matching control protocol. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 重要的方法论警示——模型生物的构造方法会严重影响可解释性实验结果，做机制研究的研究员需要注意MO构造的效度问题，重点看§4的实验结果。
recommendation.en: Important methodological warning—MO construction methods heavily affect interpretability experiment results; researchers doing mechanism studies need to be aware of MO validity issues; focus on §4 experimental results.

paper.title: ADAPT: Attention Dynamics Alignment with Preference Tuning for Faithful MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are critically hampered by hallucination, generating content inconsistent with the provided image. In this paper, we identify an internal signature of hallucination: progressive degradation of text-to-image cross-attention during generation, leading to specific failure patterns like unfocused or biased attention. Existing mitigation strategies are largely outcome-driven and do not explicitly target this failure mode. To address this problem, we propose AD

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型生成长文本时容易“越写越不看图”，导致后段幻觉。论文要解决的是：能否找到一个可操作的内部信号来刻画这种退化，并在推理与偏好微调阶段直接对 cross-attention 动态做约束，从而提升图像一致性。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接关联中等偏弱，更像是 VLM/MLLM 的对齐与推理时干预方法。但它提出的“cross-attention 动态退化”诊断与“用早期 grounded attention 做锚点”的思路，对做多模态统一建模的人有两点启发：
- 训练信号不必只在输出层（token loss / preference loss），也可以对中间对齐机制（cross-attn）施加结构化约束。
- 长输出场景下的 grounding 退化可以被当作一种可度量的训练/推理动态问题，而不是单纯的样本偏好问题。
summary.technical_approach:
ADAPT 把幻觉归因到生成过程中的两阶段转移：早期“视觉扎根阶段”cross-attn 会聚焦到与文本相关的视觉证据；后期进入“语言先验主导阶段”，cross-attn 逐步退化。

作者总结了三类退化信号：
1) 注意力漂移：从相关区域漂到无关区域，或变得过于发散/空间偏置。
2) 注意力对新 token 的响应变弱：随生成推进，cross-attn 的变化率下降。
3) 视觉 token 权重下降：跨层/跨位置对视觉 token 的总体注意力值降低。

在此基础上，ADAPT 由三段组成：
- Visual Enhance：从早期 decoding 提取“可靠的、语义相关的”多层 cross-attn，并用若干准则做 refinement（文中提到包含位置偏置校正），得到 cross-attn anchor。
- Attention-Supervised Inference：推理时监控后期 cross-attn 与 anchor 的偏离，当出现 unfocused/biased 等退化模式时做稀疏的纠偏 steering（属于 inference-time 干预）。
- Visual Attention Guidance DPO：做偏好微调时构造“不同视觉证据条件”的 chosen/rejected 对（anchor-enhanced image 作为 chosen，noise image 作为 rejected），把偏好学习信号与“依赖视觉证据”的注意力模式绑定。

与常见方法的区别：不是只在 logits 上做惩罚或只用 DPO/RLHF 约束输出，而是把 cross-attn 动态当作可监督对象，并把推理时控制与训练时偏好对齐耦合起来。
summary.experiments:
全文片段未给出具体 benchmark 名称与数值表格细节，但作者声称：
- 在多个基座/骨干 MLLM 上，ADAPT 相比强基线在多项 hallucination/faithfulness 评测上稳定提升。
- 通过可视化与统计（如注意力变化率、视觉 token 注意力占比随层/随时间的曲线）验证了“后期退化”现象，并展示纠偏后注意力更稳定。

如果要判断方法是否扎实，建议在全文中核对三点：
1) anchor 的构造是否对 prompt/解码策略鲁棒，是否会把早期错误也固化成锚。
2) inference-time steering 的代价（额外算力、是否需要回看多层注意力）与对输出流畅性的副作用。
3) DPO 数据构造是否会引入捷径（模型学会识别 noise image 的分布差异，而非真正增强 grounding）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Cross-Attention and Hallucinations：两阶段现象与三类退化信号是否有清晰的定量定义。
- 再看 anchor refinement 的细节：用了哪些准则、如何做 positional bias correction，这是方法能否泛化的关键。
- 最后看 DPO 构造与推理时纠偏策略：它们分别解决什么问题，是否互相依赖。

如果你的关注点是“预训练/统一建模”，阅读重点放在：能否把这种中间态约束变成可扩展的训练目标（例如在预训练或 mid-train 阶段加入 attention consistency/grounding regularization），以及它与纯输出层 loss 的取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs often hallucinate more in the later part of long-form generation as they gradually rely less on the image. The paper asks whether this can be diagnosed via an internal signal—text-to-image cross-attention dynamics—and whether we can directly constrain/steer those dynamics during inference and preference tuning to improve visual faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: Relevance to core LLM pretraining is moderate: it is mainly a multimodal alignment + inference-control method. Still, it offers two useful ideas for foundation-model training: (1) supervision need not live only at the output distribution (token loss / preference loss); it can target intermediate alignment mechanisms (cross-attention). (2) grounding degradation in long generations can be treated as a measurable training/inference dynamics problem, not just a dataset preference issue.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ADAPT is built on an observed two-stage shift: an early visually grounded stage where cross-attention focuses on text-relevant evidence, followed by a prior-dominated stage where cross-attention degrades. They characterize degradation with three signals: attention drift (unfocused or spatially biased), reduced responsiveness to newly generated tokens (lower attention change rate over time), and reduced overall attention mass on visual tokens across layers/positions.

The method has three coupled components:
- Visual Enhance: extract early-stage multi-layer cross-attention and refine it into a semantics-aware anchor (including positional-bias correction).
- Attention-Supervised Inference: monitor later-stage cross-attention against the anchor and apply sparse corrective steering when degradation patterns appear.
- Visual Attention Guidance DPO: preference-tune using pairs constructed under different visual evidence conditions (anchor-enhanced images as chosen vs noise images as rejected) to encourage visually grounded behavior.

Compared to output-only mitigation (logit penalties, standard DPO/RLHF), ADAPT treats cross-attention trajectories as first-class objects to supervise and control, combining inference-time correction with training-time preference alignment.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt does not include the concrete benchmark tables or exact numbers. The paper claims consistent improvements over strong baselines across benchmarks and backbones, and supports the diagnosis with attention visualizations/statistics (e.g., attention change rate decay and reduced visual-token attention mass).

When reading the full paper, validate: (1) robustness of the anchor (does it lock in early mistakes?), (2) inference overhead and side effects of steering, and (3) whether the DPO construction introduces shortcuts (detecting noise-image artifacts rather than improving grounding).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the analysis section on cross-attention degradation to see how the three signals are defined and measured.
- Focus on anchor refinement and positional-bias correction—this is the main technical hinge.
- Then check the inference-time steering rule and the DPO data construction to understand what each component contributes.

If your lens is pretraining/unified modeling, concentrate on whether these attention-level constraints could be scaled into a training objective (e.g., attention consistency/grounding regularization) and what trade-offs it has versus output-level losses.

recommendation.zh: 把“幻觉”落到可观测的 cross-attention 动态退化上是好切口；但注意力监督/DPO 容易被 proxy 牵着走，重点只看诊断指标与人评一致性和推理期开销。
recommendation.en: The attention-dynamics signature is a useful handle on hallucination, but attention-supervised DPO can overfit proxies—only worth it if the diagnostic correlates with human grounding and the online fix is cheap.

paper.title: NormGuard: Reward-Preserving Norm Constraints in Flow-Matching Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reward alignment of flow-based generators, but often degrades perceptual quality in ways that are not captured by the reward proxy. We identify a simple structural signature of this drift: across three post-training methods (NFT, AWM, DPO), RL fine-tuning inflates the per-step velocity norm $\|v_θ\|$ by $5\%$ to $15\%$ relative to the reference. A form of norm inflation has been studied in classifier-free guidance (CFG), where rescaling the

summary.core_problem: 对 flow-matching 生成器做 RL 后训练时，reward 对齐提升但感知质量下降，且简单的推理期 rescale 无法同时保 reward 与保质量。
summary.importance: 属于“对齐信号导致生成分布漂移”的可诊断现象与约束手段；虽然对象是 flow/diffusion 生成，但对理解 RL/DPO 类后训练的失真机制有可迁移的分析框架。
summary.technical_approach: 观察到 RL 微调会让每步速度场范数 ||vθ|| 相对 reference 膨胀 5%-15%；用伴随灵敏度分析指出推理期对速度幅值 rescale 在 batch 层面缺乏一致的一阶 reward 信号；提出 NormGuard：在训练中加入“reward-preserving”的范数约束/正则，抑制范数漂移以减轻质量劣化。
summary.experiments: 在三种后训练方法（NFT, AWM, DPO）上报告范数膨胀幅度（5%-15%）；摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据与定量画质/奖励提升表格。

summary_en.core_problem: RL post-training for flow-matching generators improves reward alignment but degrades perceptual quality, and inference-time rescaling cannot preserve both reward and quality.
summary_en.importance: A diagnostic + constraint approach for alignment-induced distribution drift; while studied on flow/diffusion generators, the analysis pattern is transferable to RL/DPO-style post-training failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Finds RL fine-tuning inflates per-step velocity norm ||vθ|| by 5%–15% vs a reference; adjoint sensitivity analysis argues inference-time magnitude rescaling lacks coherent first-order reward signal at batch level; proposes NormGuard, a reward-preserving norm constraint/regularizer during training to curb norm drift and quality loss.
summary_en.experiments: Reports norm inflation (5%–15%) across three post-training methods (NFT, AWM, DPO); the abstract lacks model scale, data, and full quantitative reward/quality tables.

recommendation.zh: 把“对齐导致质量掉”落到可测的范数漂移上是亮点；只需看他们的诊断与约束项，别期待它直接迁移到文本 RLHF。
recommendation.en: The useful bit is turning alignment-induced quality loss into a measurable norm-drift signature; read the diagnostics + constraint, but don’t assume it transfers cleanly to text RLHF.

paper.title: Emergent Alignment
paper.abstract: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) discern when their own outputs are misaligned with human ethics? And can they self-correct? We endow an LLM with a conscience step that reviews its own reasoning and outputs, and we extend the training loss with an alignment component using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to steer the model away from non-ethical outputs. The result is an online technique to align models in a wide range of applications: training, fine-tuning, adversarial prompting, and zero-s

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 能否识别自身输出中的伦理错位，并通过自我审查与 DPO 风格损失进行在线自我纠偏。
summary.importance: 属于后训练和安全对齐方法探索，关注点是不用外部强 judge、而用冻结自拷贝构造对齐信号；对 pretrain 的启发主要在于训练信号质量和自生成偏好信号的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 在生成流程中加入 conscience step，让模型审查自己的推理和输出；训练损失加入 alignment component，并用 Direct Preference Optimization 将模型从非伦理输出推开。judge 不是外部模型，而是冻结的自身副本。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 Emergent Misalignment 的代码 hacking fine-tuning 场景下实验，单个高层 introspective question 能把训练导向更合伦理的模型；未给出模型规模、数据量、评测集、baseline 或具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether an LLM can detect ethical misalignment in its own outputs and self-correct through an introspective review step combined with a DPO-style alignment loss.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and safety-alignment proposal. Its distinctive angle is to avoid an external stronger judge and instead use a frozen copy of the model as the reference for online alignment signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method adds a conscience step that reviews the model’s reasoning and answer, then augments training with an alignment component based on Direct Preference Optimization to move away from unethical outputs. The judging signal comes from a frozen self-copy rather than a separate judge.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments in the Emergent Misalignment code-hacking fine-tuning scenario, where a single high-level introspective question steers training toward more ethical behavior. It does not provide model size, data scale, baseline details, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 自 judge 的 DPO 设定有点脆，只看实验设置和失败样例；别把它当可靠对齐信号。
recommendation.en: The self-judge DPO setup is fragile; skim the setup and failure cases, but do not treat it as a reliable alignment signal.

paper.title: Which Pairs to Compare for LLM Post-Training?
paper.abstract: Preference-based post-training has become a central paradigm for aligning language models. A common data-collection strategy is to generate a small set of completions for each prompt and label the resulting comparison pairs. However, human preference labels are often much more expensive than generating additional completions, suggesting a different use of the same labeling budget: generate a larger pool of completions, but label only the most informative comparison pairs. This paper studies whic

summary.core_problem: 在偏好数据标注预算固定的情况下，每个 prompt 应该从候选回复池中选择哪些 pair 送去标注，才能让 DPO 等偏好后训练得到的最终策略在 KL 正则化的 RLHF 目标下最优。
summary.importance: 把偏好数据构造从“生成几条、标完所有 pair”的工程惯例，变成一个有明确统计目标的采样设计问题。核心价值在于：标注预算的分配不应该以“估计 reward 准不准”为目标，而应该以“最终策略 J 值高不高”为目标。这对做 DPO/RLHF 数据管线、尤其做大规模离线偏好数据策划的团队有直接参考意义，对理解 post-train 信号质量如何反哺预训练范式也有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将比较对选择建模为 offline sampling design：给定每个 prompt 下从 reference policy 生成的一批候选 completion，设计一个 pair 上的采样分布，在总标注预算 n 下抽 pair 打标，再用 DPO 训练策略。作者在 KL-regularized RLHF/DPO 的局部线性化近似下，推导出最终策略的次优 gap 由一个依赖于 design 的 Fisher/信息矩阵控制，并给出有限样本上界与信息论下界匹配的结果。由此得到一个可优化的 trace-form 准则，用来选择最能识别“对最终策略性能重要的参数方向”的 pair。区别于主动学习类工作按 reward uncertainty 选 pair，这里的选对准则直接以下游 policy improvement 为目标。
summary.experiments: 在 synthetic tabular、contextual bandit 风格实验，以及 IMDb、Anthropic-HH 的 DPO 实验上验证该准则。报告显示所提 design 在相同标注预算下 consistently 提升 DPO 的 sample efficiency，优于随机采样、全 pair 标注以及已有 active preference selection 基线。论文主要验证的是 offline curation 场景：候选池先生成好、再选 pair，而非在线交互式查询。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看问题建模、信息矩阵与 trace 准则的推导直觉，以及实验部分对不同 curation 策略的对比。建议先读 Introduction 和主要定理对应的解释段，跳过过细的证明；关注“为什么以最终策略目标选 pair 不同于以 reward 估计精度选 pair”这一点。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Given a fixed budget for human preference labels, which completion pairs should be selected from a larger candidate pool per prompt so that the resulting DPO-style policy best optimizes the KL-regularized RLHF objective?
summary_en.importance: The paper reframes preference-data construction from an ad hoc pipeline choice—generate a few responses and label all or one pair—to a statistical sampling-design problem. The key conceptual move is that labeling budget should be allocated to maximize downstream policy value under RLHF, not merely to estimate a reward function accurately. This is directly relevant to teams building DPO/RLHF data pipelines, especially offline preference curation at scale, and provides a useful lens for reasoning about post-training signal quality more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The problem is formulated as offline experimental design: for each prompt, a pool of completions is first sampled from the reference policy, then a sampling distribution over within-prompt pairs determines which pairs are sent for annotation under budget n, and DPO is trained on the labeled pairs. Under a local linearization of the KL-regularized RLHF/DPO objective, the authors show that the final policy’s optimality gap is governed by a design-dependent information matrix. They derive finite-sample upper bounds and matching information-theoretic lower bounds, leading to an explicit trace-form criterion that selects pairs informative for the parameter directions that most affect downstream policy performance. Unlike active-preference work that selects pairs by reward uncertainty, the selection criterion here is tied directly to policy improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The method is validated on synthetic tabular and contextual experiments, plus DPO experiments on IMDb and Anthropic-HH. The proposed design consistently improves sample efficiency over baselines under matched annotation budgets, including random pair selection, labeling all pairs, and prior active preference-selection strategies. The setting is primarily offline curation: generate a candidate pool first, then choose pairs, rather than fully online interactive querying.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the problem formulation and the design criterion rather than the full proofs. Focus on the introduction, the intuition behind the information-matrix/trace surrogate, and the empirical comparison across curation strategies. The main point to absorb is why optimal pair selection for policy optimization differs from optimal pair selection for reward estimation. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DPO偏好数据采样的理论分析，结论可迁移到预训练数据筛选场景，重点看§3的边界推导部分。
recommendation.en: Theoretical analysis of preference pair sampling for DPO; conclusions transfer to pretraining data filtering, focus on bound derivations in §3.

paper.title: Beyond Uniform Forgetting: A Study of Sequential Direct Preference Optimization Across Preference Settings
paper.abstract: Aligning language models with human preferences often requires optimising multiple behavioural objectives. A practical approach is to apply these objectives sequentially using preference optimisation methods such as Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO), but it remains unclear whether later training uniformly degrades preferences learned earlier or whether the effect depends on the relationship between objectives. We study sequential DPO across four preference settings covering distributional con

summary.core_problem: 在多目标对齐里，常见做法是按阶段顺序用 DPO 之类的偏好优化方法逐个加入新目标。核心问题是：后续阶段会不会“均匀遗忘”前一阶段学到的偏好？遗忘到底来自目标间的直接冲突（梯度对抗），还是更间接的分布漂移、信号强弱不均、参数漂移等机制？
summary.importance: 属于 post-training 研究，但对“持续对齐/增量对齐”很实用：它把 sequential DPO 的退化现象拆成不同偏好关系类型（冲突、交互、强安全信号、兼容质量目标），并用 pair-level 的 margin 轨迹而不是只看 aggregate 指标，给出更细的诊断视角。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：pretrain→posttrain 接口里，后续目标注入不一定表现为简单的梯度冲突；如果要做 continual pretrain / mid-train / 多阶段对齐，评估与诊断需要更细粒度的“样本级行为变化”工具。
summary.technical_approach:
实验设定围绕 sequential DPO：在同一个基座（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）上，用 LoRA 适配器按阶段做 DPO，每个阶段结束都在所有目标上评估，并固定同一个 base-model reference 来计算相对指标，避免 reference 漂移带来的混淆。
方法上的关键点有三类：
1) 多种偏好关系设置：覆盖分布冲突（distributional conflict）、多属性交互（multi-attribute interaction）、强安全信号（strong safety signal）、以及兼容的质量目标（compatible response-quality）。并在每种设置里比较不同训练顺序。
2) 评估指标：除了 aggregate 的相对偏好准确率/相对 reward margin，还引入 pair-level 诊断——跟踪每个 chosen–rejected 对在不同 checkpoint 的 length-normalized policy margin 变化，观察哪些样本对在“遗忘/迁移”。
3) 机制检验：直接测量 sequential 训练中不同目标梯度的 cosine similarity，并结合 LoRA adapter 的参数移动，判断是否存在显著的梯度对抗。论文的主要机制结论是：Stage 2 更新与 Stage 1 目标大多近似正交，暗示偏好变化更多来自间接漂移或信号不平衡，而不是持续的直接梯度冲突。
summary.experiments: 基座为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，采用 LoRA 做阶段式 DPO；在四类偏好设置、两种目标顺序下，逐阶段评估所有目标，并做 pair-level margin 轨迹分析与梯度相似度统计。论文在摘要与引言中给出的定性结论是：不存在单一“均匀遗忘”模式，表现从部分退化、稳定、重分配到正迁移不等，且与目标关系、信号强度、训练顺序相关。当前提供的正文片段未包含具体数据表（每阶段提升/下降幅度、训练步数、数据量、LoRA rank、margin 分布统计等），因此无法可靠复述精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看实验设定：四种 preference setting 的具体数据来源与标注协议差异，顺序如何排列；这决定了“冲突/兼容”的定义是否站得住。
- 重点看 pair-level margin 分析那一节：它比 aggregate 指标更能解释“哪些样本在变、怎么变”。
- 再看梯度 cosine similarity 的测量细节：是在同一 batch 上算、还是跨数据集算；LoRA 参数空间下如何对齐梯度；这些会影响“近似正交”的可信度。
- 最后看讨论：如果梯度不冲突但仍退化，作者给出的替代解释（分布漂移、信号强弱、间接参数漂移）是否有额外证据或消融支持。

summary_en.core_problem: Sequentially applying DPO to optimize multiple preference objectives is common in practice, but it is unclear whether later stages uniformly degrade earlier preferences, and whether any degradation is driven by direct objective conflict (gradient opposition) versus indirect effects like distribution shift, signal imbalance, or parameter drift.
summary_en.importance: A post-training study with practical implications for continual/incremental alignment. Its main value is diagnostic: it shows sequential DPO does not induce a single, uniform forgetting pattern, and it introduces pair-level margin tracking to reveal heterogeneous changes hidden by aggregate metrics. For pretraining researchers, the indirect takeaway is about the pretrain↔posttrain interface: multi-stage objective injection may look like drift rather than explicit gradient conflict, so evaluation tooling needs to be sample-level and stage-aware.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They run sequential DPO on a fixed base model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) using LoRA adapters, evaluating after each stage on all objectives while keeping a fixed base-model reference to avoid confounds from a moving reference.
Key methodological components:
1) Four preference settings capturing different relationships between objectives: distributional conflict, multi-attribute interaction, strong safety signal, and compatible response-quality objectives, each tested under both objective orderings.
2) Metrics beyond aggregates: in addition to objective-level relative preference accuracy and DPO-style relative reward margins, they track length-normalized policy margins for individual chosen–rejected pairs across checkpoints to localize which pairs degrade or improve.
3) Mechanistic probe: they measure gradient cosine similarity during sequential training (and analyze LoRA adapter movement) to test whether observed preference changes are explained by direct gradient conflict. The reported conclusion is that Stage-2 updates are largely near-orthogonal to the previous objective, suggesting drift/signal imbalance rather than sustained gradient opposition as the primary driver.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA-based sequential DPO. Across four preference settings and both orderings, they evaluate all objectives after every stage, perform pair-level margin trajectory analysis, and compute gradient similarity statistics. The qualitative findings reported in the excerpt are heterogeneous outcomes ranging from partial degradation to stability, redistribution, or positive transfer depending on objective relationship, signal strength, and ordering. The provided text does not include the main quantitative tables (magnitudes per stage, training steps, dataset sizes, LoRA hyperparameters, margin distribution stats), so exact numbers cannot be cited here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Check the exact definition and construction of the four preference settings (data sources, annotation protocols, and what counts as “conflict” vs “compatible”).
- Focus on the pair-level margin tracking section; it is the most informative part for diagnosing sequential alignment behavior.
- Inspect how gradient cosine similarity is computed (same batch vs cross-dataset, normalization, LoRA parameterization) to judge how strong the “near-orthogonal” claim is.
- Read the discussion/ablations for evidence supporting alternative mechanisms (distribution shift, signal imbalance, indirect drift) beyond gradient conflict.

recommendation.zh: 可看实验设计和 pair-level 分析；结论支持“后训练顺序是 recipe 变量”，但 LoRA+8B 只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and pair-level analysis; it supports treating post-training order as a recipe variable, but LoRA on an 8B model is only a weak signal.

paper.title: Mechanistic Analysis of Alignment Algorithms in Language Models
paper.abstract: Post-training alignment algorithms are predominantly evaluated as black boxes, obscuring how they reshape language models' internal computations. We present a systematic mechanistic analysis of six preference-optimization methods: PPO, DPO, SimPO, ORPO, GRPO, and KTO across three open-weight model families. By integrating layer-wise linear probing, Sparse Autoencoders, and crosscoders, we localize preference representations and quantify alignment-induced geometric transformations in latent space

summary.core_problem: 现有后训练对齐算法多作为黑盒评估，其如何重塑LLM内部计算过程、改变隐空间表征的机制尚不明确。
summary.importance: 原理分析类重大贡献，首次系统对比6种主流偏好优化算法的内部作用机制，量化了对齐引起的隐空间几何变换，为对齐算法选型和改进提供了机制层面的核心依据。
summary.technical_approach: 整合逐层线性探测、稀疏自编码器、交叉编码器三种分析工具，在三个开源模型家族上对比PPO、DPO、SimPO、ORPO、GRPO、KTO六种对齐算法，定位偏好表征的层分布，量化隐空间的几何变换和特征变化。
summary.experiments: 发现偏好信号集中在早-中层或中-高层；KTO和GRPO通过建设性特征共享和稀疏高显著度征用来增强线性可分性；DPO和ORPO通过非建设性几何旋转和特征衰减降低可分性；PPO和SimPO基本保留基线几何结构。
summary.authors_note: 哥本哈根大学团队，无公开知名核心作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training alignment algorithms are mostly evaluated as black boxes, and the mechanism by which they reshape LLM internal computations and alter latent space representations remains unclear.
summary_en.importance: Major mechanistic analysis contribution: the first systematic comparison of the internal mechanisms of 6 mainstream preference optimization algorithms, quantifying alignment-induced latent space geometric transformations, providing core mechanistic evidence for alignment algorithm selection and improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Integrates three analysis tools: layer-wise linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and crosscoders, compares 6 alignment algorithms (PPO, DPO, SimPO, ORPO, GRPO, KTO) across three open-weight model families, localizes the layer distribution of preference representations, and quantifies latent space geometric transformations and feature changes.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that preference signals concentrate in early-mid or mid-late layers; KTO and GRPO enhance linear separability via constructive feature sharing and sparse high-saliency recruitment; DPO and ORPO degrade separability via non-constructive geometric rotation and feature attenuation; PPO and SimPO largely preserve baseline geometry.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Copenhagen, no publicly well-known core authors.

recommendation.zh: 立刻在内部对齐实验中参考不同算法的表征变换结论，优先测试KTO/GRPO的能力保留效果。
recommendation.en: Immediately reference the representation transformation conclusions of different algorithms in internal alignment experiments, prioritize testing KTO/GRPO's capability retention effect.

paper.title: Emergence of Context Characteristics Sensitivity in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: During instruction fine-tuning (IFT), large language models (LLMs) learn to follow instructions by using the provided context to answer a query. While prior work has studied how context characteristics correlate with context usage by the LLM, this analysis has been limited to inference time, leaving open how these relationships are acquired in the first place. Here, we measure how models' sensitivity to such characteristics shifts across successive IFT stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), direc

summary.core_problem: 分析 instruction fine-tuning 各阶段如何改变模型对上下文特征的敏感性，以及这种偏好如何影响 context usage。
summary.importance: 这类工作对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有直接价值。它不是提出新训练法，而是拆开 SFT、DPO、RLVR 对上下文利用偏好的塑形作用，能帮助理解后训练如何改写模型的输入归纳偏置。
summary.technical_approach: 作者沿着 IFT 流程逐阶段测量模型对上下文长度、query-context 相似度、流畅度等特征的敏感性变化，比较 SFT、DPO、RLVR 后模型是否更倾向使用某类“更容易处理”的上下文。核心是训练阶段分解分析，而非单点推理时相关性统计。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个模型、3 个数据集。摘要给出的主要发现是：SFT 会增强模型对高长度、高相似度、流畅上下文的偏好；SFT 之后的 DPO/RLVR 可能继续强化，也可能纠正这种偏好，取决于训练数据。实验价值在于阶段性对比而非绝对性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Isabelle Augenstein，长期做 NLP 评测、鲁棒性与模型分析；这篇更偏 post-training dynamics 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how different instruction-tuning stages reshape model sensitivity to context characteristics, and how that affects actual context usage.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train interface. It does not propose a new training method, but it decomposes how SFT, DPO, and RLVR alter input-side inductive biases, which matters for understanding post-training side effects.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors measure, stage by stage, how model sensitivity changes with respect to context length, context-query similarity, fluency, and related features. The key move is to analyze these shifts across SFT, DPO, and RLVR rather than only correlating context properties with inference-time behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans four models and three datasets. The main finding in the abstract is that SFT increases preference for easier-to-use contexts—longer, more similar, and more fluent ones—while later DPO/RLVR stages may either reinforce or mitigate these preferences depending on the training data.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Isabelle Augenstein, known for work on NLP evaluation, robustness, and model analysis; this paper is best read as a post-training dynamics study.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得 pretrain 人看，因为它把“后训练只是对齐层”这个 prior 拆掉了：SFT/DPO/RLVR 会改写 context bias，先看各阶段对比图，再决定是否复现。
recommendation.en: Worth a pretraining reader’s time because it weakens the prior that post-training is just an alignment layer: SFT/DPO/RLVR rewrite context biases; read the stage-wise comparison figures first.

paper.title: Better Literary Translation: A Multi-Aspect Data Generation and LLM Training Approach
paper.abstract: Literary translation poses unique challenges due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data and the need to balance expression fluency with literary effect. We present a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework that generates high-quality translation references and preference data through specialized LLM translators, each targeting a distinct quality dimension. We leverage the generated data for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments show that our generated referen

summary.core_problem: 解决文学翻译中高质量监督数据稀缺、偏好优化不稳定的问题，尤其关注如何生成更适合 SFT 和 RL 的训练信号。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后训练数据合成与 RL recipe 设计。对基座研究员的价值不在翻译任务本身，而在于它给出一个较明确的信号：某些高主观性生成任务里，DPO 可能不如显式 reward model + 在线探索稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多维度迭代 refinement 框架，用多个专门化 LLM translator 分别优化流畅性、文学性等质量维度，生成高质量参考译文和偏好数据；随后用这些合成数据做 SFT，并比较 DPO 与基于显式奖励模型的 GRPO。
summary.experiments: 训练得到 LitMT-8B 和 LitMT-14B，在 MetaphorTrans 英译中文学翻译任务上分别达到 67.25 和 69.07 CEA100。生成参考用于 SFT 时，相比原始 ground truth 提升 8.65 CEA100；RL 阶段中，DPO 会退化，而显式 reward model + GRPO 额外提升 1.51 分。摘要未给出更细的 baseline 族谱与训练 token 规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of high-quality supervision and unstable preference optimization in literary translation, focusing on how to generate better training signals for SFT and RL.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is in post-training data synthesis and RL recipe design. The value for a foundation-model researcher is not the translation task itself, but the cleaner signal that in highly subjective generation settings, DPO may be less stable than an explicit reward model with online exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework where specialized LLM translators target different quality dimensions such as fluency and literary effect, producing improved references and preference data. These are then used for SFT, followed by a comparison between DPO and GRPO with an explicit reward model.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting LitMT-8B and LitMT-14B reach 67.25 and 69.07 CEA100 on MetaphorTrans English-to-Chinese literary translation. Generated references improve SFT by 8.65 CEA100 over original ground truth, while explicit-reward GRPO adds another 1.51 points and DPO degrades performance. The abstract does not provide detailed baseline lineage or token-scale information.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University.

recommendation.zh: 任务很窄，但“DPO 在高主观性生成上会掉、显式 RM+GRPO 更稳”这个结论值得记；只看 RL 对比和数据构造细节即可。
recommendation.en: The task is narrow, but the signal that DPO can fail on subjective generation while explicit-RM GRPO is steadier is worth noting; read only the RL comparison and data construction.

paper.title: Follow-Your-Preference++: Rethinking Preference Alignment for Image Inpainting
paper.abstract: We study preference alignment for image inpainting. Rather than proposing yet another method, we revisit the problem from first principles and reassess its core challenges. We adopt the widely used direct preference optimization framework and construct preference training data with publicly available reward models. Our empirical study spans nine reward models, two benchmarks, and two baseline inpainting models that differ in architecture and generative mechanism. Our main findings are: (1) Most

summary.core_problem: 重新评估图像修复中的 preference alignment：公开 reward model 生成的偏好数据是否可靠，以及这些 reward 是否会诱发 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成对齐的经验分析，不是新模型；价值在于把 DPO、reward bias、candidate/sample scaling 和 reward ensemble 放到图像修复场景中系统测量，对 LLM 后训练中的 reward 信号质量有间接参照。
summary.technical_approach: 采用直接偏好优化框架，用 9 个公开 reward model 构造偏好训练数据，在两个 benchmark 和两个架构/生成机制不同的 inpainting baseline 上比较；重点分析 reward 作为训练信号和评估器时的差异、亮度/构图/色彩偏置，以及简单 reward ensemble 的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个 reward model、2 个 benchmark、2 个 baseline inpainting model；摘要报告多数 reward model 可用于构造偏好数据，但部分不适合做 evaluator；偏好数据在 candidate scaling 和 sample scaling 下趋势一致，单一 reward 会有明显视觉偏置，ensemble 能缓解并提升泛化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Zhejiang University、The University of Tokyo、Tsinghua University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper re-examines preference alignment for image inpainting, asking whether public reward models provide reliable preference data and whether they induce reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical study of multimodal generative alignment rather than a new generator. Its useful signal for LLM researchers is the measurement of reward quality, reward bias, scaling of preference data, and reward ensembling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study applies Direct Preference Optimization, constructs preference data from nine public reward models, and evaluates two inpainting benchmarks with two baseline models that differ in architecture and generation mechanism. It separates reward models as training-signal providers from reward models as evaluators.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span nine reward models, two benchmarks, and two inpainting baselines. The abstract reports that most reward models give usable preference signals, some fail as evaluators, candidate/sample scaling trends are consistent, and ensemble rewards mitigate brightness, composition, and color-scheme biases.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, The University of Tokyo, and Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward bias 与 ensemble 部分；图像修复结论不能外推到 LLM，但 reward-as-data 和 reward-as-evaluator 的拆分有用。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward-bias and ensemble analysis; inpainting results do not transfer directly to LLMs, but the reward-as-data versus reward-as-evaluator split is useful.

paper.title: When RLHF Fails: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Reward Hacking, Collapse, and Evaluator Gaming
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) makes large-scale post-training possible by replacing an underspecified human objective with learned and scalable proxies. The same substitution creates a structured failure surface: optimization can raise the learned reward while external quality falls, degrade both proxy and judge scores, reveal proxy under-alignment, or produce evaluator-specific disagreement. We present an empirical failure-mode study of a compact RLHF pipeline with proximal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是提出新的 RLHF 算法，而是把 RLHF 训练失败这件事拆细。作者认为“reward hacking”这个词过于粗糙，掩盖了几种机制不同的失败：代理奖励上升但外部质量下降、代理和外部评估一起下降、代理本身就没学对、模型几乎不动、以及不同 judge 给出相反结论。论文试图给这些现象建立一个可审计、可复现的 checkpoint-level 与 prompt-level taxonomy。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为它不涉及 pretrain recipe、数据或优化器创新；但对 post-train 诊断和 pretrain↔post-train 闭环有启发。价值在于两点。第一，它提醒人不要把 RLHF 失败都归因于 reward hacking，很多时候是 collapse、under-alignment 或 evaluator disagreement。第二，它强调 row-level transition 分析，而不是只看 checkpoint 平均分。这种诊断思路对研究训练动态、奖励信号质量、以及 judge 可靠性都有帮助。贡献量级更接近诊断框架和实验方法学，而不是新的训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者构建了一个小规模但完整的 RLHF pipeline：SFT 起点、reward model、PPO 若干 KL 设置、DPO 评估、UP-PPO 变体、reward uncertainty via MC dropout、近似 KL 漂移、diversity/repetition 指标，以及两个外部 LLM judges。核心不是这些组件本身，而是如何定义 failure taxonomy。

论文把分析单位设为 transition，而不是单个 checkpoint。对每个 prompt，比较两个 checkpoint 之间代理奖励 Rφ、主 judge 分数 R†、第二 judge 分数 R2† 的变化方向。主 judge 的方向决定主类别，第二 judge 用来标记 evaluator disagreement。由此把转移分成 stable alignment、reward hacking、optimization collapse、proxy under-alignment、conservative stagnation、evaluator gaming 等类型。这个设计的好处是：它不把不同失败混在一个平均数里，而是能定位“哪一类 prompt 在哪一段训练中开始坏掉”。

作者还尝试做 early-warning：只用转移前的信号去预测后续会不会进入某类失败。可用特征包括 reward uncertainty、近似 policy drift、重复度、多样性等。UP-PPO 在这里不是新架构，而是 shaped-reward PPO：在计算标量 advantage 前，从 reward model 分数里减去 uncertainty penalty。论文把 mitigation 和 diagnosis 分开处理，没有把 UP-PPO 包装成通用解法。
summary.experiments:
实验建立在 GPT-2 量级策略模型和 Anthropic HH-RLHF prompts 上，重点看不同 PPO 强度、DPO、以及 UP-PPO 的失败分布。论文给出的一个明确数字是：aggressive PPO 条件下，256 个 row-level transitions 中有 37 个被判为 reward hacking，占 14.45%；β=0.03 的 PPO 也有 9.38% 的 reward-hacking 占比。作者强调，很多 failure 只有在 row-level 才看得见，checkpoint 平均分会把局部坏例子冲淡。

另一个关键结果是 judge disagreement 被单独当成 failure mode，而不是评测噪声。也就是说，同一训练转移可能在一个 judge 看来是改进，在另一个 judge 看来是退化，这会影响对“是否 reward hacking”的判定。UP-PPO 相比 aggressive PPO 往往更保守，能减少一部分明显失败，但论文没有声称它系统性解决了所有问题。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数值，这里不补写未出现的具体指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Failure-Mode Taxonomy，弄清作者为什么坚持用 transition-based、row-level 的分类，而不是 checkpoint aggregate。然后看 Experimental Design，确认 pipeline 的边界：小模型、HH-RLHF、两个 LLM judges、UP-PPO 只是 uncertainty-penalized reward shaping。最后看 Results 里 taxonomy 统计表和若干 prompt-level case study。预计 25–35 分钟。

阅读时要带着两个问题：第一，taxonomy 是否足够稳健，还是高度依赖 judge 和阈值设定；第二，这套诊断在更大模型、更强 reward model、或 reasoning-heavy RL setting 下是否仍然成立。若只关心方法启发，重点看 row-level localization 和 two-judge disagreement 这两部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not proposing a new RLHF algorithm. Its main goal is to decompose RLHF failure into a more precise taxonomy. The authors argue that the term 'reward hacking' is too coarse: a run where proxy reward rises while external quality falls is different from one where both collapse, different again from a run where the proxy is under-aligned from the start, and different from evaluator-specific disagreement. The paper tries to make these distinctions explicit at both checkpoint and prompt-transition levels.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, since it does not change pretraining recipes, data, or optimization. Still, it is useful for the post-training side of the loop and for understanding training signal quality. The main value is methodological. First, it separates several failure mechanisms that are often conflated under the label of reward hacking. Second, it shows that row-level transition analysis can reveal localized failures that disappear under checkpoint averages. That is useful for anyone studying RLHF dynamics, judge reliability, or reward-model overoptimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental setup is a compact but fairly complete RLHF pipeline: an SFT starting point, a learned reward model, PPO with different KL settings, DPO evaluations, uncertainty-penalized PPO, reward uncertainty estimated via Monte Carlo dropout, approximate KL drift, and lexical diversity and repetition diagnostics, plus two external LLM judges. The novelty is not in these ingredients individually, but in how they are used to define a failure taxonomy.

The key design choice is to classify transitions rather than isolated checkpoints. For each prompt, the paper compares the change in proxy reward R_phi, primary judge score R_dagger, and secondary judge score R_dagger_2 between two checkpoints. The direction of the primary judge defines the main class, while the second judge is used to detect evaluator disagreement. This yields categories such as stable alignment, reward hacking, optimization collapse, proxy under-alignment, conservative stagnation, and evaluator gaming. The benefit is that it localizes where and when failure begins, instead of averaging everything into a single checkpoint score.

The paper also explores early-warning prediction using only pre-transition signals, including reward uncertainty, approximate policy drift, repetition, and diversity. UP-PPO is treated carefully: it is not a new architecture, only a shaped-reward PPO variant where uncertainty is subtracted from the reward before computing the scalar advantage. The paper keeps mitigation separate from diagnosis, which is the right framing here.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use GPT-2-scale policies and Anthropic HH-RLHF prompts. The focus is on how different PPO regimes, DPO evaluation, and UP-PPO distribute across failure categories. One explicit result reported in the text is that aggressive PPO produces 37 reward-hacking transitions out of 256 row-level transitions, or 14.45%. PPO with beta = 0.03 still shows a non-trivial reward-hacking share of 9.38%.

A central empirical point is that many failures are visible only at the row level. Checkpoint averages can hide localized degradation on specific prompts. Another important result is that judge disagreement is treated as a first-class failure mode rather than mere evaluation noise. A transition can look like improvement under one judge and degradation under another, which changes how one should interpret apparent reward hacking. UP-PPO appears more conservative than aggressive PPO and reduces some obvious failures, but the paper does not claim that it solves the problem in a general sense. The provided excerpt does not include the full set of tables and metrics, so no additional numbers should be invented.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the taxonomy section to understand why the authors insist on transition-based, row-level classification instead of checkpoint-level aggregates. Then read the experimental design carefully to keep the scope in view: small models, HH-RLHF prompts, two LLM judges, and UP-PPO as uncertainty-penalized reward shaping rather than a new RL method. Finish with the taxonomy tables and a few prompt-level case studies. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, how robust is the taxonomy to judge choice and threshold settings? Second, would the same categories remain informative at larger scale, with stronger reward models and reasoning-heavy RL setups? If you only want the main methodological takeaway, focus on row-level localization and two-judge disagreement.

recommendation.zh: 读 taxonomy 和 transition 定义即可；setup 偏小，但能校准“RL 信号=质量”的天真假设。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and transition definitions; the setup is small, but it usefully weakens the naive ‘RL signal equals quality’ prior.

paper.title: S-SPPO: Semantic-Calibrated Self-Play Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is often formulated via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). However, the standard Bradley-Terry instantiation of DPO is limited in modeling common departures from transitivity in human preferences. To address this, recent work has introduced Self-Play Preference Optimization (SPPO), which iteratively refines the policy by training on self-generated win-lose pairs. Our investigation, however, reveals a critical instability in SPPO: th

summary.core_problem: SPPO (Self-Play Preference Optimization) 在处理语义相似但被 Reward Model 赋予极端胜率的回复对时，会产生严重的训练不稳定和策略退化问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了 Self-Play 偏好对齐方法中的一个关键缺陷（对 RM 过度自信的敏感性），并提出了一种无需额外人工标注或强模型监督即可稳定训练的校准框架，对提升 RLHF/DPO 变体的鲁棒性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 S-SPPO 框架，包含双空间语义校准：1) 监督校准（Supervision Calibration）：通过语义门控机制，根据回复间的语义重叠度对目标胜率进行退火，降低 RM 在相似回复上的过度自信；2) 表示校准（Representation Calibration）：在隐空间引入排斥力，防止模型在生成相似回复时发生流形坍缩（mode collapse）。理论证明该方法保持了常数和博弈结构，能收敛到纳什均衡。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3-8B 上，S-SPPO 在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上取得了 52.19% 的胜率和 47.46% 的长度控制胜率，显著优于现有基线方法，且有效消除了标准 Self-Play 方法中观察到的性能退化现象。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对 SPPO 失败模式的分析（图 1），以及 S-SPPO 双空间校准机制的具体实现。理论部分可略读，重点理解语义门控和隐空间排斥力如何协同工作。

summary_en.core_problem: SPPO (Self-Play Preference Optimization) suffers from severe training instability and policy degeneration when the Reward Model assigns overly confident win rates to semantically indistinguishable response pairs.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a critical flaw in self-play preference alignment methods (sensitivity to RM overconfidence) and proposes a calibration framework that stabilizes training without requiring additional human annotations or strong model supervision, offering direct insights for improving the robustness of RLHF/DPO variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the S-SPPO framework, featuring dual-space semantic calibration: 1) Supervision Calibration: Uses semantic gating to anneal target win rates based on semantic overlap, mitigating RM overconfidence on similar responses; 2) Representation Calibration: Introduces a repulsive force in the latent space to prevent manifold collapse when generating similar responses. Theoretically proves that this method preserves the constant-sum game structure and converges to a Nash Equilibrium.
summary_en.experiments: On Llama-3-8B, S-SPPO achieves a 52.19% win rate and a 47.46% length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0, significantly outperforming existing baselines and effectively eliminating the performance degradation observed in standard self-play methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of SPPO's failure modes in the Introduction (Figure 1) and the specific implementation of S-SPPO's dual-space calibration mechanisms. The theoretical part can be skimmed; focus on understanding how semantic gating and latent space repulsion work together.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它抓住了偏好学习里一个常被忽略的脏点：语义近重复 pair 的过置信监督；只看退化分析和 calibration 设计就值回时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it isolates a real pathology in preference learning—overconfident supervision on near-duplicate responses; the degeneration analysis and calibration trick are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: Learning from Fine-Grained Visual Discrepancies: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations via In-Context Visual Contrastive Optimization
paper.abstract: Multimodal hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Standard textual Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) often fails to mitigate it due to a lack of explicit visual supervision. While existing works introduce visual preference DPO by contrasting original images against negative ones, they suffer from a theoretically inconsistent objective caused by partition function mismatches and rely on coarse-grained negatives that could enable shortcut learning. In th

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是多模态幻觉中的一个具体训练问题：现有视觉偏好 DPO 往往把同一回答放到不同图像上下文里做 chosen/rejected 对比，但 DPO 的理论推导要求偏好对共享同一个输入上下文，否则 reference policy 的 partition function 不能抵消，目标函数会带入不可计算的偏差。同时，许多负样本来自检索或生成，差异过粗，模型容易学到风格、构图等捷径，而不是细粒度视觉 grounding。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，但对 VLM post-training 和多模态对齐目标有参考价值。它提醒一个常被忽略的问题：把文本偏好优化直接搬到多模态条件上，输入条件是否相同会影响 DPO 目标的成立。这个点对后续设计 VLM 的偏好数据、视觉反事实数据、以及 pretrain/post-train 接口都有启发。贡献主要在目标函数修正和数据构造，不是新的视觉语言预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，IC-VCO 把原图和对比图放入同一个 multi-image context，再通过指令指定模型应该依据哪一张图回答。这样 chosen 和 rejected 的偏好比较发生在同一个上下文内，DPO 里的 partition function 可以按原始推导抵消，避免不同图像条件带来的理论不一致。第二，VCDist 用 multi-image 分支得到的偏好分布作为软监督，约束 single-image 分支，缓解训练时多图、推理时单图的 context gap；它还引入 reliability gate，避免低置信或噪声较大的教师信号污染训练。第三，Contrastive Sample Editing 对原始图像做局部、定向编辑，构造只在关键视觉属性上不同的 hard negatives。相比检索负样本或整图生成负样本，这类样本保持风格和布局一致，更难被低层统计差异解决。
summary.experiments: 论文在五个多模态幻觉相关 benchmark 上比较 IC-VCO 与普通文本 DPO、已有视觉偏好 DPO 方法。核心实验结论是：共享 multi-image context 的偏好优化比直接跨图像条件比较更稳定，也更能减少视觉忽略；局部编辑得到的 hard negatives 不只提升 IC-VCO，也能改善其他偏好优化基线，说明负样本质量是独立贡献。消融重点包括去掉 VCDist、替换 hard negatives 为粗粒度负样本、以及比较 single-image 与 multi-image 训练设置。提供的正文片段没有包含完整表格数值，因此不应补写具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Preliminaries 中对 DPO partition function 的推导，以及方法部分如何把视觉对比重写成同一上下文内的偏好比较。实验部分优先看 ablation：VCDist 是否真正缓解单图推理落差，edited hard negatives 相比检索/生成负样本带来多少收益。若关心 VLM 对齐数据构造，Contrastive Sample Editing 的 pipeline 比主结果更值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in multimodal preference optimization. Existing visual DPO methods often compare the same response under different image conditions, but the original DPO derivation assumes that the preference pair shares the same input context. Once the image changes, the reference-policy partition functions no longer cancel, leaving an intractable bias. In addition, many visual negatives are too coarse, so models can solve the objective through style or semantic shortcuts instead of learning fine-grained visual grounding.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to VLM post-training and to the interface between multimodal pretraining and alignment. Its main lesson is that preference objectives cannot be transferred from text to multimodal settings without checking whether the conditioning context remains fixed. This matters for visual preference data design, counterfactual image construction, and grounding-oriented alignment. The contribution is mainly an objective correction plus a better negative-data pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three components. IC-VCO places the original and contrastive images inside a shared multi-image context and instructs the model which image to answer about. The chosen and rejected examples then share the same context, so the DPO partition function cancels as in the original derivation. VCDist adds a consistency regularizer from the multi-image branch to the single-image branch, reducing the train-test mismatch because normal VLM inference usually uses one image. A reliability gate filters out uncertain distillation signals. The contrastive sample editing pipeline creates localized semantic edits on the original image, keeping style and layout stable while changing the relevant visual fact. This makes the negative examples harder than retrieval-based or globally generated negatives.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on five multimodal hallucination benchmarks and compares IC-VCO with text-only DPO and prior visual preference optimization methods. The main findings are that the shared-context formulation gives a stronger grounding signal, and that locally edited hard negatives improve not only IC-VCO but also other preference-optimization baselines. The key ablations examine removing VCDist, replacing edited hard negatives with coarser negatives, and comparing multi-image training with single-image inference. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numerical result tables, so exact improvement numbers should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the DPO derivation in the preliminaries and the reformulation that makes the visual preference pair share one context. Then read the ablations around VCDist and hard-negative construction. For readers working on VLM alignment data, the contrastive editing pipeline is likely the most reusable part.

recommendation.zh: 多模态对齐方向的方法改进，其中对比样本设计和正则项思路可作为预训练多模态对齐损失的参考，只看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: This is a method improvement for multimodal alignment; the contrastive sample design and regularizer ideas can be referenced for multimodal pretraining alignment losses, only read the method section.

paper.title: MIRA: Mid-training Rubric Anchoring for Source-Aware Data Selection
paper.abstract: Mid-training has become an important stage in modern LLM development, using large-scale curated mixtures to strengthen capabilities before final post-training. Its data selection problem is distinct: the data are optimized under a pretraining-style objective at near-pretraining scale, but are curated toward downstream capabilities and drawn from heterogeneous sources with different formats and training roles. As a result, effective selection requires both scalability and source-adaptive semantic

summary.core_problem: MIRA 解决的是 mid-training 数据选择中的一个实际难题：数据规模接近预训练，目标却是能力定向；数据来源既有 web/code/math/长文档，也有 instruction、reasoning trace、tool-use log、多轮 agent trajectory。单一困惑度、影响函数或全局质量分无法可靠判断这些异构源里的样本是否适合继续训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究有较高价值，原因是它把 mid-training 数据过滤从“给所有样本打一个统一质量分”改成“先为不同来源发现评价维度，再做可扩展打分”。这更符合现代基座模型训练流程：pretrain 之后的能力补强阶段已经不是普通语料清洗，也还不是最终 SFT/RL。贡献量级主要在数据工程和训练 recipe，而不是模型结构。它给出的关键信号是：语义质量判断可以被纳入 near-pretraining-scale 的数据选择，但需要 source-aware rubric、student scorer 和保留比例校准，否则 teacher judge 成本和全局阈值都会成为瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: MIRA 的核心设计是把 rubric discovery 和 scalable scoring 分开。第一步按内容 embedding 相似度把 21 个来源聚成若干 source group，使同组数据在能力角色和质量模式上更接近。第二步做 self-anchored rubric discovery：让 frontier teacher 在每组抽样记录上自由描述“什么维度决定质量”，再把这些维度级判断聚类成 group-specific anchor rubrics。这样避免把 code document、code-generation QA、tool-use trajectory 放进同一套固定标准。第三步用 anchor rubrics 生成结构化 teacher label，并蒸馏成每组独立的 lightweight student scorer，用于全量语料推理。第四步做 source-conditioned reliability aggregation：对不同维度估计可靠性，屏蔽不稳定维度，再用 source-aware retention threshold 做选择，而不是用一个全局 cutoff。与传统 perplexity/filtering 的区别是它显式定义了源内语义质量；与普通 LLM-as-judge 的区别是它不依赖固定全局 rubric，也不在全量数据上直接调用大 teacher。
summary.experiments: 实验选择 code-oriented mid-training，因为代码能力数据天然异构，包含代码文档、代码生成问答、agent/tool-use 记录等。数据侧覆盖 21 个 sources 和 5 个 source groups。MIRA 使用超过 200 万条 teacher-scored records 进行 rubric discovery 和 distillation，再把学生打分器应用到数千万条记录。训练比较使用 50B-token 级别 baselines，并在 9 个 benchmark 上聚合评估。结果显示，group-level MIRA 优于强 50B-token 基线；在只使用约一半 token 的情况下，整体结果还略高于未过滤全量语料训练。这说明收益主要来自更高的 token 质量和 source-level 校准，而不是简单增加训练量。消融重点在 group-level 设计、rubric anchoring、reliability aggregation 和 source-aware threshold：这些模块共同避免了全局质量分对异构来源的误伤。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的四个模块：source grouping、self-anchored rubric discovery、anchored judge distillation、source-conditioned aggregation/source-preserving selection。真正值得深挖的是 rubric 如何从 teacher 的自由描述变成可复用 anchor，student scorer 如何按组训练，以及可靠性估计如何影响最终保留阈值。实验部分重点看 21 sources 到 5 groups 的划分、超过 200 万 teacher labels 的成本结构、50B-token 训练设置、半 token 过滤集与全量集的对比，以及 ablation 中去掉 group/rubric/reliability 后的退化。若要复现到非代码 mid-training，最需要检查的是 source group 是否稳定、rubric 是否可解释、teacher label 噪声是否会被 student scorer 放大。

summary_en.core_problem: MIRA addresses data selection for mid-training, where the objective remains pretraining-like and large-scale, but the corpus is capability-oriented and highly heterogeneous. A single perplexity score, influence signal, or global quality rubric is not enough for mixtures that combine web/code/math documents, instruction examples, reasoning traces, tool-use logs, and multi-turn agent trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The paper is important for pretraining-oriented work because it treats mid-training data curation as its own problem, rather than as ordinary pretraining filtering or post-training judging. The main contribution is a scalable data-selection recipe: semantic quality criteria are discovered per source group, then distilled into lightweight scorers for corpus-scale filtering. This is a practical path for bringing LLM-judge supervision into near-pretraining-scale selection without paying teacher inference cost on the full corpus or forcing all sources into one global rubric.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIRA separates rubric discovery from scalable scoring. It first groups related sources using content-embedding similarity, so that each group has more consistent capability roles and quality patterns. It then performs self-anchored rubric discovery: a frontier teacher inspects sampled records and freely articulates quality dimensions; these dimension-level judgments are clustered into group-specific anchor rubrics. The anchors are used to obtain structured teacher labels, which are distilled into group-specific lightweight student scorers. Finally, MIRA aggregates scores with source-conditioned reliability estimates, masks unreliable dimensions, and applies source-aware retention thresholds instead of a single global cutoff. Compared with model-based pretraining filters, it exposes the semantic criteria behind quality. Compared with standard LLM-as-judge filtering, it avoids fixed rubrics and makes scoring feasible at corpus scale.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical setting is code-oriented mid-training, chosen because code data mixes documents, code-generation QA, and agent/tool-use records. The corpus spans 21 sources and 5 source groups. MIRA uses more than 2 million teacher-scored records for rubric discovery and distillation, then applies student scorers to tens of millions of records. The training comparison includes strong 50B-token baselines and evaluation over 9 benchmarks. The group-level variant outperforms the 50B-token baselines and slightly exceeds the unfiltered full-corpus run while using roughly half as many tokens. The result suggests that the gain comes from source-adaptive quality control and calibrated retention, not from simply increasing data volume. The key ablations to inspect are the effects of group-specific rubrics, anchored distillation, reliability-aware aggregation, and source-aware thresholds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the method sections carefully, especially source grouping, self-anchored rubric discovery, anchored judge distillation, and source-conditioned aggregation. The most useful details are how free-form teacher comments become stable anchor rubrics, how group-specific student scorers are trained, and how reliability estimates change the final keep/drop decision. In the experiments, focus on the 21-source to 5-group mapping, the cost and coverage of the 2M teacher-scored examples, the 50B-token training setup, the half-token comparison against the full corpus, and the ablations that remove grouping, rubric anchoring, or reliability aggregation. For applying the idea outside code, the main risks are unstable source grouping, noisy teacher dimensions, and student scorers overfitting source-specific artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 应读正文实验表；若 ablation 干净，source-specific rubric 会改变 mid-train 过滤不该只做全局质量分的先验。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental tables; if the ablations are clean, source-specific rubrics should weaken the prior that mid-training filtering is just global quality scoring.

paper.title: Recovering Diversity Without Losing Alignment: A DPO Recipe for Post-Trained LLMs
paper.abstract: Many open-ended instructions have multiple valid answers that users can benefit from seeing, but post-training often narrows an LLM's output space toward a small set of canonical responses. We introduce REDIPO, an offline DPO data-construction pipeline for recovering distinct valid answer modes while preserving the alignment benefits of the instruct model. For each prompt, REDIPO samples responses from both base and instruct models, rewrites base-model responses with the instruct model, filters

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：指令对齐后的 LLM 往往把开放式问题压缩成少数模板化答案，导致多样性下降，如何在不明显损伤对齐质量的前提下把输出空间重新打开。
summary.importance: 这是后训练配方工作，但对 pretrain 研究员也有接口价值。它针对 post-train 常见的 mode collapse 给出一个离线 DPO 数据构造方案，重点不是再训一个更强 reward model，而是重新设计 preference pair，让“多样但同样合格”的回答能进入偏好学习信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 REDIPO。对每个 prompt，同时从 base model 和 instruct model 采样；再用 instruct model 重写 base 响应，使其更符合指令风格；之后用安全性和 instruction-following 过滤候选；最后在 instruction reward 接近的候选之间，构造偏好多样答案的 DPO pair。关键点是把 diversity 作为 pair construction 的显式目标，而不是在 loss 上做软正则。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B、OLMo-3-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B。相对 instruct checkpoint，NoveltyBench distinct_k 分别提升 134%、33%、44%；而对比方法 DivPO 在同模型上多样性变化为 0%、-6%、-4%。同时 MTBench、IFEval、Arena-Hard 基本维持，且直接拒答/模板化回答减少。规模不大，但 setup 还算干净，说明数据构造比目标函数花活更关键。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mohit Iyyer，长期做 controllable generation、evaluation 与 alignment 相关研究。团队来自学术界，不是大厂大规模后训练报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a common post-training failure mode: instruction-tuned LLMs often collapse open-ended prompts into a narrow set of canonical answers. The goal is to recover diversity without noticeably hurting alignment quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training recipe paper with useful implications for pretraining researchers. It targets mode collapse after alignment and proposes an offline DPO data-construction pipeline, focusing on how preference pairs are built so that diverse yet equally valid responses survive the training signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, REDIPO, samples responses from both the base model and the instruct model for each prompt, rewrites base-model responses using the instruct model to improve instruction style, filters candidates for safety and instruction-following, and then constructs DPO preference pairs that favor more diverse responses among candidates with similar instruction-following reward. The key idea is to encode diversity in pair construction rather than only in the loss.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Qwen3-4B, OLMo-3-7B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B. Relative to the instruct checkpoints, NoveltyBench distinct_k improves by 134%, 33%, and 44%, while DivPO changes diversity by 0%, -6%, and -4% on the same models. MTBench, IFEval, and Arena-Hard are largely preserved, and direct refusals/template-like responses are reduced. The scale is modest, but the setup appears reasonably clean and suggests that data construction matters more than fancy objective tweaks here.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Mohit Iyyer, known for work on controllable generation, evaluation, and alignment-related topics. This is an academic paper rather than a large industrial post-training report.

recommendation.zh: 这是个典型“数据比 loss 更重要”的后训练例子；若你关心 alignment 如何反噬 pretrain 分布，只看 pair construction 和对比 DivPO 的表就够了。
recommendation.en: A good example of data construction beating loss tinkering; if you care about how alignment distorts the pretrained distribution, focus on the pair-construction recipe and the comparison against DivPO.

paper.title: AdaDPO: Self-Adaptive Direct Preference Optimization with Balanced Gradient Updates
paper.abstract: DPO has become a widely adopted alternative to RLHF for aligning LLMs with human preferences, eliminating the need for a separate reward model or RL loop. Recent theoretical analysis uncovers an asymmetric gradient behavior in DPO: the loss suppresses dispreferred responses substantially faster than it promotes preferred ones, causing the model to learn to avoid bad answers rather than to generate good ones. We propose AdaDPO, a Self-Adaptive variant of the DPO algorithm that introduces per-pref

summary.core_problem: DPO 的偏好对梯度存在结构性不平衡：训练越往后，loss 越倾向于快速压低 rejected response 的概率，而不是持续提高 chosen response 的概率。AdaDPO 试图在每个 preference pair 上动态平衡这两侧的更新强度。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座预训练本身，而在 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口。DPO、SimPO、ORPO 这类 pairwise preference loss 已经成为指令模型和 reasoning model 的常用后训练工具。AdaDPO 给出的观察比较具体：仅看 log-prob 梯度会掩盖 probability space 里的更新不对称。这个问题会影响模型是学会“少犯错”，还是学会“更主动地产生好答案”。对需要稳定做 preference tuning、RL-free alignment、数据退火后 DPO 的团队，有一定方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: AdaDPO 保留 DPO 的基本形式，但把原来共享的固定 beta 拆成 preference-pair 级别的 beta_w 和 beta_l。beta_l 仍设为原 DPO 的 beta，beta_w 则由当前 policy 对 chosen 和 rejected response 的生成概率比值计算，并通过 stop-gradient 固定该系数本身的反向传播路径。这样做的目标是让 preferred 与 dispreferred 概率的梯度幅度在每一步更接近，而不是像 DPO 那样用同一个系数同时乘在两个 log-ratio 上。实验中使用的是 length-normalized 版本，用 token 平均 log-prob 来避免长答案概率乘积过小，并加入数值 clipping 控制极端比例。方法的优点是改动很小，不需要额外 reward model，也不引入新的敏感超参。论文还说明同一思路可以套到 SimPO、R-DPO、IPO、CPO、ORPO：核心是把共享 margin 系数改成自适应的两侧系数，使 pairwise contrastive loss 的两侧更新更均衡。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上进行，训练数据为 UltraFeedback，设置基本对齐 SimPO 的实验 recipe。评价使用 AlpacaEval 2。AdaDPO 在 81% 的超参组合中取得比 DPO 更高的 length-controlled win rate；全局最好结果为 LC win rate 48.3%，raw win rate 46.1%。论文还报告 AdaDPO 在 88% 的组合中扩大了 LC-over-WR margin，作者将其解释为对长度偏置的缓解。实验规模不算大，主要支持的是 loss 修正有效，而不是证明一个完整 alignment recipe 的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的梯度平衡推导，尤其是作者为什么选择在 probability / probability-ratio space 里分析，而不是只看 log-prob 梯度。然后看 Section 5 的 AlpacaEval 2 结果和超参 sweep，判断改动是否稳定。Section 6 可以快速扫一遍，重点看 AdaDPO 如何迁移到 SimPO、ORPO 等 loss。若只关心工程落地，最值得保留的是 beta_w 的 stop-gradient 构造、length-normalization、clipping 这三个实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: DPO has a structural gradient imbalance at the preference-pair level: as training progresses, it tends to suppress the rejected response faster than it promotes the chosen response. AdaDPO targets this imbalance by adaptively balancing the two update directions for each pair.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to the pretrain-to-posttrain interface rather than base pretraining itself. Pairwise preference losses such as DPO, SimPO, and ORPO are now common tools for instruction tuning and reasoning-oriented alignment. The useful point is precise: gradients that look balanced in log-probability space can still be asymmetric in probability space. This affects whether a model mainly learns to avoid bad outputs or keeps learning to produce better preferred outputs. The method is therefore relevant for teams running DPO-style alignment after continued pretraining or annealing stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaDPO keeps the DPO objective structure but replaces the single shared beta with two pair-specific coefficients, beta_w and beta_l. beta_l is kept as the original DPO beta. beta_w is computed from the current policy’s generation probabilities for the chosen and rejected responses, with stop-gradient applied so that the coefficient serves as an adaptive balancing factor rather than another trainable path. The experimental variant uses length-normalized probabilities to avoid sequence-length artifacts and numerical clipping to control extreme ratios. The main design choice is to introduce a compensating asymmetry in log-probability space so that the update magnitudes in probability space become balanced. The same construction is presented as a drop-in modification for SimPO, R-DPO, IPO, CPO, and ORPO.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiment uses Llama-3-8B-Instruct trained on UltraFeedback, under a setup close to SimPO. Evaluation is performed on AlpacaEval 2. AdaDPO achieves higher length-controlled win rates than DPO in 81% of the tested hyperparameter combinations. The best reported result is 48.3% length-controlled win rate and 46.1% raw win rate. The paper also reports that the LC-over-WR margin increases in 88% of the combinations, which the authors interpret as reduced length bias. The evidence supports the proposed loss correction, but the experimental scope is still closer to a focused loss study than a full alignment recipe study.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. Section 3 is the key part: focus on the derivation of the equal-gradient condition and the distinction between log-probability gradients and probability-space dynamics. Section 5 is useful for checking whether the effect is stable across hyperparameters. Section 6 can be read quickly to see how the same balancing rule is applied to SimPO, ORPO, and related objectives. For implementation, the important details are the stop-gradient coefficient, length normalization, and clipping.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 loss 推导和梯度图；若结论成立，DPO ablation 应加一个梯度平衡 baseline。
recommendation.en: Skim the loss derivation and gradient plots; if the claim holds, DPO ablations should include a gradient-balanced baseline.

paper.title: Reasoning Matters: Mitigate Hallucination in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-Conditioned Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models introduce the reasoning paradigm, demonstrating strong capabilities on complex vision-language tasks. However, they still suffer from severe hallucinations.
