paper.title: TokenRatio: Principled Token-Level Preference Optimization via Ratio Matching
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used RL-free method for aligning language models from pairwise preferences, but it models preferences over full sequences even though generation is driven by per-token decisions. Existing token-level extensions typically decompose a sequence-level Bradley-Terry objective across timesteps, leaving per-prefix (state-wise) optimality implicit. We study how to recover token-level preference optimality using only standard sequence-level pairwise compar

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 preference optimization 里的粒度错配问题。DPO 这类方法用序列级偏好对整段回答建模，但自回归模型在推理时做的是逐 token 决策。已有 token-level 变体大多只是把序列级 Bradley–Terry 目标拆到时间步上，credit assignment 仍然是隐式的，没有真正定义“每个 prefix 下什么 token 更优”。作者想做的是：只用常见的序列级 pairwise preference 数据，也能恢复一个在状态—动作层面更接近最优的策略。
summary.importance: 对 post-training 方法研究，这篇文章的价值主要在理论建模和目标函数设计，而不是工程 recipe。它把 preference learning 从“整段回答谁更好”推进到“给定当前 prefix，下一个 token 的偏好比率应该怎样匹配”，这更贴近语言模型的生成机制。对预训练研究员的启发在于两点。第一，很多对齐目标之所以效率不高，不是数据不够，而是监督粒度和模型决策粒度不一致。第二，sequence-level preference 也许可以通过更好的 ratio matching 形式，间接恢复 token-level 最优性，这对未来把偏好信号并入 mid-training 或 reasoning-oriented continual training 有方法论意义。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 TBPO，Token-level Bregman Preference Optimization。核心不是简单的 token-wise DPO，而是先假设一个 token-level Bradley–Terry 偏好模型：在给定 prefix 状态 s_t 时，不同 next-token action 的相对偏好由某个 token-level score 决定。然后作者把学习问题写成密度比估计，也就是去拟合“偏好动作相对参考分布的 ratio”，并用 Bregman divergence 族来构造目标函数。这样做有两个结果。第一，logistic/DPO loss 只是这个更一般框架下的一个特例，而不是唯一选择。第二，在合适的 score parameterization 下，可以给出 token-level optimality 的理论刻画。

文中给了两个主要实例。TBPO-Q 用 state-action value Q 来定义 token-level score，更接近从局部动作价值出发建模偏好；TBPO-A 用 advantage A 来定义 score，更强调相对当前状态基线的增益。作者沿用 KL-regularized sequential decision 的视角，把 next-token generation 写成 token-level MDP，并借助参考策略下的闭式最优 Q/A 形式，把 sequence-level comparison 数据转成可训练的 token-level ratio matching 目标。与 TDPO、TISDPO 这类方法相比，差别不在于是否把 loss 分摊到 token，而在于它显式定义了 token-level 偏好模型，并证明最小化该目标时恢复的是 token-wise optimal policy，而不是仅仅改善序列级偏好概率。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主张有三类：一是 TBPO 在多个 benchmark、不同 backbone、不同任务上优于强基线；二是训练更稳定；三是相对基线更能保持 response diversity。你给出的全文片段没有包含具体表格和数值，因此不能可靠写出提升百分点、模型规模或数据规模。可以确认的是，作者把比较重点放在 DPO 及其 token-level 扩展上，而不是和 RLHF 做大规模算力对决；论文更像是在同等偏好数据条件下比较目标函数是否更贴近自回归决策。

从方法结构推断，最值得关注的实验应包括：TBPO-Q 与 TBPO-A 的对比，说明 Q-formulation 和 advantage-formulation 哪个更稳；不同 Bregman generator 对训练行为的影响，说明 logistic 不是唯一合理选择；以及长回答或长推理任务上的收益，因为 token-level credit assignment 的优势通常会在长 horizon 更明显。如果完整论文里有 calibration、entropy 或 distinct-n 之类的多样性指标，也应重点看，因为作者明确把“preserving response diversity”作为卖点之一。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓理论主线，不要一开始陷在公式细节里。先看 introduction 和 background，明确作者批评现有 token-level DPO 的点：它们仍然是 sequence-level BT 模型，只是把信号分配到 token。然后看 TBPO 的推导，重点盯三件事：token-level Bradley–Terry 假设是什么；密度比是相对谁定义的；Bregman divergence 为什么能导出一族可替换的 preference loss。接着看 theorem 和 optimality characterization，确认“恢复 token-level optimal policy”的条件是什么，是否依赖模型容量、参考策略支持集或偏好噪声假设。

如果只想判断值不值得后续复现，预计 30 分钟左右足够。若要深入，建议重点看 TBPO-Q/TBPO-A 的差别和实验中的稳定性曲线，因为这决定它更像一个漂亮的理论包装，还是一个真正可落地替代 DPO 的训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a granularity mismatch in preference optimization. DPO and related methods optimize sequence-level preferences over whole completions, while autoregressive language models act one token at a time conditioned on a prefix. Existing token-level variants usually redistribute a sequence-level Bradley–Terry objective across timesteps, but they do not explicitly define what token-level preference optimality should mean at each state. The paper asks whether one can recover a policy that is locally preference-optimal at the prefix level while using only standard sequence-level pairwise comparison data.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is conceptual and objective-level rather than recipe-level. The paper is useful because it reframes preference learning as a token-level density-ratio problem instead of a whole-sequence classification problem. That matters for anyone thinking about alignment signals as training targets: if the supervision granularity does not match the model’s decision granularity, optimization can be statistically and behaviorally inefficient. For pretraining-oriented readers, the broader lesson is that sequence-level supervision may still induce token-level optimal behavior if the ratio-matching objective is designed carefully enough. That idea could matter beyond DPO, including mid-training or reasoning-oriented continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed framework is Token-level Bregman Preference Optimization, or TBPO. The starting point is a token-level Bradley–Terry preference model defined over next-token actions conditioned on a prefix state. Instead of treating a completion as an indivisible object, the method assigns a token-level score to each state-action pair and learns the corresponding preference density ratio. The estimation objective is built from a Bregman divergence family, which makes standard logistic-style DPO only one special case rather than the default formulation.

The paper introduces two concrete parameterizations. TBPO-Q defines the token-level score through a state-action value function Q. TBPO-A defines it through an advantage function A, emphasizing relative improvement over the state baseline. The derivation is grounded in a KL-regularized sequential decision formulation of autoregressive generation. Using closed-form expressions for optimal Q or A under a reference policy, the authors derive a token-level ratio-matching loss that can be trained from ordinary sequence-level preference pairs. The claimed theoretical payoff is stronger than prior token-level DPO variants: under the token-level preference model, minimizing the TBPO objective recovers the desired token-wise optimal policy, rather than merely improving a decomposed sequence-level objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper claims three empirical benefits: better alignment than strong baselines across benchmarks and backbones, improved training stability, and better preservation of response diversity. The excerpt provided here does not include the full result tables, exact model sizes, dataset sizes, or numerical gains, so precise figures should not be fabricated. What is clear from the text is that the empirical comparison is centered on DPO-style baselines and token-level extensions such as TDPO and TISDPO, not on a large-scale RLHF comparison.

The most informative experiments to inspect in the full paper are likely these: TBPO-Q versus TBPO-A, to understand whether value-based or advantage-based scoring is more robust; ablations over different Bregman generators, to test whether the generalized objective family matters in practice; and long-generation settings, where token-level credit assignment should matter most. Diversity metrics are also important because the paper explicitly claims better diversity retention than baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a theory-and-objective paper first, not as an engineering recipe. Start with the introduction and background to understand the critique of prior token-level preference methods: they still inherit a sequence-level Bradley–Terry model and only redistribute the signal over time. Then move to the TBPO derivation and focus on three questions: what exactly is the token-level Bradley–Terry assumption, how is the density ratio defined, and why does a Bregman-divergence formulation produce a family of usable preference losses. After that, read the theorem and optimality characterization carefully. The key issue is under what assumptions the minimizer corresponds to a token-level optimal policy.

A quick read should take about 30 minutes. A deeper read should focus on the difference between TBPO-Q and TBPO-A and on the training-stability plots, because those determine whether the method is mainly a cleaner theoretical framing or a practical replacement for standard DPO.

recommendation.zh: 后训练对齐的增量改进，只需要看损失推导部分（§3）即可，无需全读
recommendation.en: This is an incremental improvement on DPO for alignment, only read the loss derivation section (§3), no need to go through full paper

paper.title: Spurious Correlation Learning in Preference Optimization: Mechanisms, Consequences, and Mitigation via Tie Training
paper.abstract: Preference learning methods such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) are known to induce reliance on spurious correlations, leading to sycophancy and length bias in today's language models and potentially severe goal misgeneralization in future systems. In this work, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of this phenomenon, characterizing the mechanisms of spurious learning, its consequences on deployment, and a provable mitigation strategy. Focusing on log-linear policies, we show that

summary.core_problem: 现有偏好优化方法（如DPO）会诱导模型依赖训练数据中的伪相关特征（如回复长度、礼貌程度等表面属性），导致分布偏移下的泛化失效，此前研究仅观测到现象，缺乏统一的理论机制分析和可证明的缓解方案。
summary.importance: 从理论层面解释了对齐阶段伪相关学习的结构性根源，为提升偏好优化的分布鲁棒性、减少对齐后的谄媚、长度偏见等问题提供了有理论依据的指导，同时打通了预训练与对齐阶段分布鲁棒性的研究链路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建log-linear DPO的理论分析框架，证明伪相关学习来自训练分布中的平均伪偏置、因果-伪特征相关泄漏两个结构性通道，且仅靠增加同分布训练数据无法消除分布偏移带来的误差；提出平局训练（Tie Training）数据增强策略，通过加入效用相同但伪特征不同的偏好对，选择性正则化伪参数而不影响因果特征的学习。
summary.experiments: 线性模型实验结果与理论推导定量吻合，神经网络和大语言模型实验验证了机制定性成立，平局训练可有效减少模型对伪相关的依赖，同时不降低同分布下的任务精度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的问题定义和核心贡献，第4-6章的核心理论结论，以及第7章的主要实验结果，预计阅读时间30-40分钟，无需深究理论证明细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing preference optimization methods such as DPO induce models to rely on spurious correlations in training data (e.g., response length, politeness), leading to generalization failure under distribution shift. Prior work only observed this phenomenon, lacking unified theoretical mechanism analysis and provable mitigation strategies.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically explains the structural root cause of spurious correlation learning during alignment, provides theoretically grounded guidance for improving the distributional robustness of preference optimization and reducing post-alignment issues such as sycophancy and length bias, and connects distributional robustness research across pretraining and alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first builds a theoretical analysis framework for log-linear DPO, proving that spurious correlation learning arises from two structural channels in the training distribution: mean spurious bias and causal-spurious correlation leakage, and that scaling in-distribution training data alone cannot eliminate error caused by distribution shift. It then proposes Tie Training, a data augmentation strategy that adds preference pairs with equal utility but different spurious features, to selectively regularize spurious parameters without impairing causal feature learning.
summary_en.experiments: Linear model experiments quantitatively match theoretical derivations, neural network and LLM experiments verify the qualitative mechanism holds, and Tie Training effectively reduces model reliance on spurious correlations without degrading in-distribution task accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition and core contributions in Chapter 1, key theoretical conclusions in Chapters 4-6, and main experimental results in Chapter 7. Estimated reading time is 30-40 minutes, no need to dive into detailed theoretical proofs.

recommendation.zh: DPO伪相关的机制推导扎实，tie训练思路可直接引入内部对齐pipeline做ablation，重点看§3的理论部分。
recommendation.en: The mechanism derivation of spurious correlation in DPO is rigorous; the tie training idea can be directly introduced to internal alignment pipelines for ablation, focus on §3 theoretical analysis.

paper.title: Confidence-Aware Alignment Makes Reasoning LLMs More Reliable
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models often reach correct answers through flawed intermediate steps, creating a gap between final accuracy and reasoning reliability. Existing alignment strategies address this with external verifiers or massive sampling, limiting scalability. In this work, we introduce CASPO (Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization), a framework that aligns token-level confidence with step-wise logical correctness through iterative Direct Preference Optimization, without training a s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作针对的是 reasoning LLM 里一个常见但经常被最终答案准确率掩盖的问题：模型可能通过错误的中间推理步骤得到正确答案，也就是 final-answer correctness 和 process reliability 脱节。现有方法要么在轨迹级别做偏好优化，要么依赖外部 verifier、树搜索和大规模采样来筛选推理路径，代价高，而且没有真正解决“模型自己的置信度为什么不能代表逻辑可靠性”这个问题。文章要处理的是：如何把 token/step-level confidence 校准到逻辑正确性上，让模型内部概率分布能更可信地反映推理步骤质量，并进一步在推理时用这个信号做低开销分支裁剪。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不如纯 pretrain 方法强，但它对 post-train 尤其是 reasoning alignment 有两个有价值的启发。第一，它把“推理可靠性”落到 step-wise calibration，而不是只看整条轨迹偏好，这对 process supervision 和 reward design 都有参考意义。第二，它尝试把训练阶段学到的置信度校准直接转化为 inference-time control signal，这种 train–test interface 的设计值得关注。若这个思路成立，未来可以延伸到更一般的 self-verification、adaptive compute、甚至 pretrain 阶段的 uncertainty-aware objective。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成训练和推理两部分。训练部分叫 CASPO，核心是 Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization。作者的出发点是：当前模型的 token probability 更多反映表面流畅性和模式频率，而不是逻辑有效性，所以需要显式对齐“高置信度”与“正确推理步骤”。具体做法是构造 step-wise preference pairs，对比两类步骤：一类是逻辑上正确但模型当前并不够自信的步骤，另一类是模型高置信但逻辑错误的步骤。然后通过 iterative DPO 反复优化，让模型把概率质量从 confidently wrong 的 step 挪到 logically valid 的 step 上。这样训练出来的分布，不只是更偏好正确步骤，也希望在熵层面更可校准：正确步骤应对应更集中、更低熵的分布。

推理部分叫 Confidence-aware Thought, CaT。它利用训练后更可信的 step-wise confidence，在 reasoning tree 中动态扩展高置信路径、裁剪低置信路径。作者强调其额外开销接近 O(V) 级别，意图是比外部 verifier 或复杂树搜索更轻。这里的关键不是简单用 token prob 做 beam search，而是依赖 CASPO 先把 confidence 变成与逻辑正确性更一致的信号，否则原始概率往往只会偏向流畅但未必正确的步骤。

与已有 step-wise preference 或 process reward 方法相比，CASPO 的区别在于它不训练单独 reward model，而是直接用 DPO 形式做迭代校准；与 self-consistency、tree search、rStar-Math 这类方法相比，它更强调内部不确定性的可用性，而不是靠外部搜索预算换性能。
summary.experiments:
摘要和正文给出的关键结果比较明确。实验覆盖 10 个 benchmark 和多个模型家族。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的平均准确率从 44.4% 提升到 50.6%，在加上 CaT 推理后达到 56.1%。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，作者声称在 AIME2024 和 AIME2025 上超过了 rStar-Math、Satori 等树搜索基线，而且不依赖 reward model data。

从已提供内容看，实验重点包括：1）训练后 token/step-level confidence 是否更好地对应逻辑正确性；2）CASPO 单独带来的准确率提升；3）CaT 在推理时进一步利用 calibrated confidence 做分支裁剪后的增益；4）与 search-heavy baselines 的效率和效果对比；5）数据和算力效率。正文片段没有给出完整消融细节，但按方法设计，最值得关注的消融应包括：是否必须 iterative DPO、step-wise pair 的构造方式、confidence 指标用 entropy 还是概率、以及 CaT 对不同深度/宽度搜索预算的敏感性。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只泛读，先抓住两个问题：模型原始 confidence 为什么不可靠；CASPO 如何把它变成可用信号。建议先看 Introduction 里对 miscalibration 的论证，再看 Method 中 CASPO 的 pair construction 和 iterative DPO 流程图。这里决定了方法是否只是换皮的 process preference optimization，还是确实在做 calibration。

然后看 CaT 的推理算法。重点不是“会不会剪枝”，而是它用什么累计置信度定义 path quality，如何避免过早剪掉低概率但正确的长推理路径。实验部分优先看 calibration 相关图表、Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-8B 的主结果表，以及与 rStar-Math / Satori 的对比。预计 30 分钟可以读完主线；若要判断方法是否扎实，建议额外检查 failure cases：高置信错误步骤是否真的显著减少，还是只是把模型变得更保守。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a reliability gap in reasoning LLMs: models can reach the correct final answer through flawed intermediate steps, so final-answer accuracy overstates the quality of the reasoning process. Existing alignment methods mostly operate at the trajectory level or rely on external verifiers, tree search, and heavy sampling. Those approaches are expensive and do not solve the deeper issue that a model’s own token-level confidence is poorly aligned with logical validity. The paper asks how to calibrate internal confidence at the step level so that it becomes a usable signal for both training and inference.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training alignment paper than a pretraining paper, but it has two useful implications for foundation-model research. First, it treats reasoning reliability as a calibration problem at the step level rather than a pure trajectory-preference problem, which is relevant to process supervision and reward design. Second, it explicitly turns a training-time calibration objective into an inference-time control signal. That train-test linkage is interesting for broader directions such as self-verification, adaptive compute, and potentially uncertainty-aware objectives earlier in the training stack.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has two parts. The training component, CASPO (Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization), aims to align token- or step-level confidence with logical correctness. The motivation is that raw token probabilities mostly reflect fluency and frequency, not deductive validity. To fix this, the method constructs step-wise preference pairs that contrast logically correct but under-confident steps against confidently wrong steps. These pairs are optimized with iterative DPO, pushing probability mass away from invalid but high-confidence continuations and toward valid reasoning steps. The intended outcome is not only better step selection, but better calibration: correct steps should correspond to lower-entropy, more concentrated predictive distributions.

The inference component, Confidence-aware Thought (CaT), uses this calibrated confidence to guide reasoning-tree exploration. High-confidence branches are expanded, while uncertain branches are pruned, with claimed overhead on the order of O(V). The key point is that this is not just beam search over raw token probabilities. CaT depends on CASPO having made confidence more semantically meaningful; otherwise token probabilities would still favor fluent but logically weak steps.

Relative to prior step-wise preference or process-reward methods, CASPO avoids training a separate reward model and instead performs iterative calibration directly through DPO-style optimization. Relative to search-heavy methods such as self-consistency, rStar-Math, or Satori, it tries to make the model’s own uncertainty usable rather than buying reliability through external search compute.
summary_en.experiments:
The main reported results are fairly clear from the provided text. Experiments cover ten benchmarks and multiple model families. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, average accuracy improves from 44.4% to 50.6% with CASPO, and further to 56.1% when combined with CaT at inference. On Qwen3-8B-Base, the method reportedly surpasses tree-search baselines such as rStar-Math and Satori on AIME2024 and AIME2025, without using reward-model data.

The experimental story appears to include: (1) whether token- or step-level confidence becomes better aligned with logical correctness after training; (2) the standalone gains from CASPO; (3) additional gains from CaT using calibrated confidence for branch pruning; (4) comparisons against search-heavy baselines in both quality and efficiency; and (5) data/compute efficiency claims. The provided excerpt does not include the full ablation tables, but the critical ablations to inspect are obvious: the necessity of iterative DPO, how step-wise preference pairs are constructed, whether entropy or probability is the better confidence signal, and how sensitive CaT is to search depth and branching budget.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on two questions: why raw model confidence is unreliable, and how CASPO makes it useful. Start with the introduction’s argument about miscalibration, then read the method section on preference-pair construction and iterative DPO. That is where the paper either becomes a genuine calibration method or collapses into a repackaged process-preference approach.

Next, inspect the CaT inference algorithm. The important issue is not pruning by itself, but how path quality is defined from cumulative confidence and how the method avoids pruning low-probability yet correct long-horizon reasoning paths too early. In the experiments, prioritize the calibration plots, the main tables for Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B, and the comparisons with rStar-Math and Satori. A 30-minute read should cover the main idea. For a more serious evaluation, check failure cases: does the method truly reduce confidently wrong steps, or does it mainly make the model more conservative?

recommendation.zh: 将置信度校准与DPO结合做推理对齐，无需单独RM是值得注意的方向；§3.2的token置信度与步骤正确性对齐机制值得参考，可在内部RL pipeline中尝试。
recommendation.en: Confidence calibration + DPO for reasoning alignment without a separate RM is a notable direction; §3.2's token-confidence-to-step-correctness alignment mechanism is worth referencing for internal RL pipelines.

paper.title: Beyond Pairs: Your Language Model is Secretly Optimizing a Preference Graph
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models using pairwise preference comparisons, offering a simple and effective alternative to Reinforcement Learning (RL) from human feedback. However, in many practical settings, training data consists of multiple rollouts per prompt, inducing rich preference structure that pairwise DPO fails to exploit. Collapsing such data into independent pairs discards transitivity, introduces redundant or conflicting supervision, and can lead to unstable

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多 rollout 偏好数据的训练目标问题：实际对齐数据常常是同一 prompt 下多个回答的排序、并列或部分可比关系，而标准 DPO 把它们拆成独立 pair，丢掉了全局结构，也会引入冗余和冲突监督。
summary.importance: 它更偏 post-train，但和基座研究的接口很近。当前推理、代码和数学训练大量依赖多次采样、验证器打分、候选排序和自举数据。如果训练目标只能看 pairwise comparison，就会浪费 rollout 结构，也可能放大噪声偏好。GraphDPO 的价值在于把偏好信号从“成对分类”提升为“图结构约束”，对研究 SFT/RL 数据质量、偏好目标稳定性、verified rollout 利用方式有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GraphDPO 为每个 prompt 的多个候选回答构造有向无环偏好图。节点是 responses，边表示 dominance relation；并列回答被放进 equivalence classes，不强行制造严格顺序。目标函数借鉴 Plackett-Luce ranking，但不要求完整全序排列。每个较优回答只和它支配的更差回答集合做 groupwise 对比，通过 log-sum-exp 聚合 dominated samples。pairwise DPO 可以看作单边图的特例，严格 listwise ranking 可以看作分层 DAG 的特例。在线性复杂度的 layered DAG 构造下，它避免枚举 O(K^2) pairwise comparisons，也不需要对所有排列做归一化。对于存在标准答案或验证解的任务，方法还支持 oracle anchoring：把 oracle response 作为支配节点加入图中，并使用 annealed schedule，训练早期增强锚定信号，后期逐步降低权重。
summary.experiments: 论文在 GSM8K、MATH 和 APPS 上评估，覆盖数学推理和程序合成。给出的描述是 GraphDPO 相比 pairwise DPO、listwise baselines 和 rollout-based alignment methods 表现更稳定，并且在多 rollout 训练设置下有更好的 scaling behavior。提供的全文片段没有包含具体表格数值、模型尺寸、rollout 数量或提升幅度，因此不适合补写精确数字。可确认的实验信息是：任务选择强调可验证或可排序输出，正好对应 GraphDPO 的 preference DAG 和 oracle anchoring 设计。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 objective derivation、preference DAG 构造、ties/partial order 的处理方式，以及 oracle anchoring 的退火策略。实验部分优先看不同 rollout 数量下的曲线、和 DPO/listwise 方法的对比、以及是否有关于 preference noise 或 tie handling 的消融。如果只关心预训练，可跳过常规 benchmark 描述，重点吸收它对训练信号结构化建模的思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in preference optimization. In many alignment pipelines, each prompt has multiple rollouts with rankings, ties, or partial comparability. Standard DPO reduces this structure to independent pairs, losing transitivity and introducing redundant or conflicting supervision.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers through the training-signal interface. Reasoning, code, and math pipelines increasingly rely on multiple rollouts, verifiers, and ranked candidate sets. A pairwise objective may underuse that structure and amplify noisy comparisons. GraphDPO treats preference data as a graph rather than as isolated binary labels, which is a useful direction for thinking about data quality, reward-free alignment, verified rollouts, and stable preference learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each prompt, GraphDPO constructs a directed acyclic preference graph over candidate responses. Edges encode dominance relations, while ties are represented as equivalence classes instead of being forced into an artificial total order. The objective is inspired by Plackett-Luce ranking, but it operates over dominated neighborhoods rather than full permutations. Each response is contrasted against the set of strictly worse responses it dominates, using a log-sum-exp aggregation. Pairwise DPO becomes a single-edge special case, and strict listwise ranking becomes a layered-DAG special case. Under the equivalence-class layered construction, the objective has linear complexity in the number of responses and avoids enumerating O(K^2) pairs. When verified or oracle solutions are available, the method adds them as dominant nodes and uses an annealed anchoring schedule: strong oracle supervision early in training, then weaker anchoring later to preserve flexibility.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates GraphDPO on GSM8K, MATH, and APPS, covering mathematical reasoning and program synthesis. The provided content reports consistent gains and more robust scaling compared with pairwise DPO, listwise baselines, and rollout-based alignment methods. Exact numbers, model sizes, rollout counts, and ablation tables are not present in the supplied full-text excerpt, so they should be checked directly in the experimental section. The task selection is well matched to the method because these domains naturally produce verifiable, ranked, or partially ordered candidate responses.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 45 minutes. Focus on the preference-DAG construction, the derivation of the graph-structured objective, handling of ties and partial orders, and the annealed oracle anchoring mechanism. In the experiments, prioritize curves over the number of rollouts, comparisons against DPO and listwise objectives, and ablations on tie handling or anchoring. Readers focused on pretraining can skip routine benchmark discussion and retain the idea of modeling supervision as structured constraints rather than independent pairs.

recommendation.zh: 值得看目标函数推导；如果内部偏好数据本来是 ranked rollout，pairwise DPO 可能浪费了结构信号。
recommendation.en: Read the objective derivation; if your preference data starts as ranked rollouts, pairwise DPO is likely throwing away usable structure.

paper.title: Arena as Offline Reward: Efficient Fine-Grained Preference Optimization for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) effectively promotes preference alignment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. To improve computational efficiency, direct preference optimization (DPO), which avoids explicit reward modeling, has been widely studied. However, its reliance on binary feedback limits it to coarse-grained modeling on chosen-rejected pairs, resulting in suboptimal optimization. In this paper, we propose ArenaPO, which leverages Arena scores as offline rewards to

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像扩散模型直接偏好优化依赖二元反馈、建模粒度粗导致优化效果不佳的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将Arena排名得分作为离线奖励引入扩散模型偏好优化，结合RLHF细粒度反馈优势与DPO效率优势
summary.technical_approach: 提出ArenaPO，构建模型竞技场将每个模型能力建模为高斯分布，通过成对偏好标注推断模型能力，将输出图像作为对应能力分布的样本得到细粒度离线奖励，无需显式训练奖励模型
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上效果优于基线DPO方法，具体提升幅度未在提供摘要中明确
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所、UC伯克利、UC圣巴巴拉

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation of coarse-grained binary feedback in DPO for text-to-image diffusion model preference alignment, which leads to suboptimal optimization results
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first introduces Arena ranking scores as offline rewards for diffusion model preference optimization, combining fine-grained feedback advantage of RLHF and efficiency of DPO
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ArenaPO, constructs a model arena where each model's capability is modeled as Gaussian distribution, infers capabilities via pairwise preference annotations, treats output images as samples from corresponding capability distributions to get fine-grained offline rewards without explicit reward model training
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms baseline DPO method on text-to-image generation preference alignment tasks, specific improvement metrics are not specified in the given abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Institute of Automation CAS, UC Berkeley, UC Santa Barbara

recommendation.zh: 细粒度偏好优化思路可迁移至LLM DPO改进，仅需看方法核心逻辑，无需深入CV实验细节

paper.title: Towards General Preference Alignment: Diffusion Models at Nash Equilibrium
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has been popular for aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences. As a mainstream branch of RLHF, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) offers a computationally efficient alternative that avoids explicit reward modeling and has been widely adopted in diffusion alignment. However, existing preference-based methods for diffusion alignment still rely on reward-induced preference signals and typically assume that human prefere

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图扩散模型偏好对齐方法依赖Bradley-Terry偏好假设，无法完整捕捉复杂人类偏好

paper.title: Efficient Preference Poisoning Attack on Offline RLHF
paper.abstract: Offline Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) train on a pre-collected preference dataset, which makes them vulnerable to preference poisoning attack. We study label flip attacks against log-linear DPO. We first illustrate that flipping one preference label induces a parameter-independent shift in the DPO gradient. Using this key property, we can then convert the targeted poisoning problem into a structured binary sparse approxim

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 offline RLHF 中最现实也最难分析的一类数据攻击：只翻转已有偏好对的标签，而不注入新数据。核心问题不是“标签翻转会不会有害”，而是：在 DPO 的 log-linear 设定下，攻击者能否用很少的翻转，把训练方向系统性地推向一个指定目标策略；以及这种攻击何时可解、何时无效。论文把这个问题从策略空间拉回到梯度空间，给出一个可计算的 targeted poisoning 形式化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于 DPO 本身，而在于它揭示了 post-train 偏好数据的一个结构性脆弱点：当训练目标对单个样本标签的梯度响应具有可加、且与当前参数弱耦合时，数据污染就可能被转化为稀疏组合问题，从而被高效求解。这对 DPO、IPO 一类离线偏好优化方法的鲁棒性分析很有启发，也会反过来影响 pretrain↔post-train 接口设计，比如偏好数据审计、样本重加权、鲁棒目标和数据采集流程。
summary.technical_approach:
技术主线很清楚。第一步，作者在 log-linear policy 下分析 DPO 梯度，证明翻转一个 preference label 会带来一个与当前参数无关的固定梯度位移向量。这个结论很关键，因为它把原本依赖训练轨迹的 poisoning 问题，化成了从一组“字典原子”里选若干列，使其和尽量逼近目标向量的组合优化问题。这里每个原子对应一个样本被翻转后对梯度造成的 shift。

第二步，作者证明控制这个梯度残差可以作为攻击成功的充分代理，也就是不必直接在策略空间求解最优攻击，而可以在梯度空间做近似匹配。这一步把 targeted poisoning 进一步规约成 structured binary sparse approximation：系数只能取 0/1，因为一个样本只能翻或不翻；目标是最少翻转或在预算 K 内尽量逼近目标。

第三步，针对两个攻击场景给出两套算法。BAL-A 面向 minimum-flip 目标。它把二元选择问题嵌入一个带惩罚项的 lattice 中，同时惩罚残差和非二元整数系数，然后用 LLL reduction 和 Babai nearest-plane 找到一个整数解，再解释为翻转模式。论文分析了嵌入惩罚参数的作用：惩罚足够大时，会压制非 0/1 系数；在 separation condition 下，能恢复真实最小翻转解。BMP-A 面向给定翻转预算 K 的稀疏攻击。它改造自 Binary Matching Pursuit，用归一化相关性做贪心选择，以处理字典列范数不一致的问题，并给出基于 coherence 的恢复保证。

第四步，作者还给出简单的 robustness certificate：当字典几何结构满足某些条件时，可以证明不存在任何 K-flip 攻击能成功。这一点比单纯给攻击算法更完整，因为它开始触及防御侧可验证条件。
summary.experiments:
实验分两部分。合成字典实验主要用来验证理论条件，而不是追求任务分数。这里重点看两件事：一是 BAL-A 对嵌入惩罚参数非常敏感，只有落在理论预测的有效区间时，才能稳定恢复正确的最小翻转模式；二是 BMP-A 的恢复效果与字典 coherence 强相关，coherence 降低后成功率明显提升，这和匹配追踪类方法的经典理论一致。

真实数据部分基于 Stanford Human Preferences (SHP) 构造字典。论文没有把重点放在训练大模型后的最终对话质量，而是考察从真实偏好对提取的 flip-induced gradient dictionary 是否仍保留理论预言的几何性质。结果显示，BAL-A 在 SHP 上同样呈现明显的 penalty phase transition；BMP-A 在经过降低字典相关性的处理后，攻击成功率显著改善。对于这类工作，最重要的实验结论不是“攻击多强”，而是“理论规约在真实偏好数据上是否仍成立”。这一点论文给出了较扎实的支持。

从摘要和正文可见，实验规模更偏向中小规模、可解析 setting，而不是完整 LLM 级 DPO 训练。这个取舍是合理的：作者要验证的是几何机制和算法可恢复性，而不是做端到端红队 benchmark。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓三部分。

第一，先看 problem formulation 和 log-linear DPO 梯度推导，确认“单个标签翻转对应参数无关的固定梯度位移”到底是怎么来的。这是全文最值得记住的点。

第二，看 BAL-A 和 BMP-A 两节，不必一开始陷入 lattice 细节。先理解为什么一个适合 minimum-flip，一个适合 fixed-budget sparse attack；再看它们各自依赖什么几何条件。若对离散优化或压缩感知熟悉，BMP-A 会更容易进入；若关心精确恢复与整数约束，BAL-A 更值得细看。

第三，看实验里关于 penalty region、coherence 和 robustness certificate 的图表。这些结果决定了方法是不是只在纸面上成立。

预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。若只关心对齐鲁棒性的启发，读引言、主定理、算法描述和实验图即可；若关心理论完整性，再补证明部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the most practical yet theoretically difficult poisoning setting in offline RLHF: flipping labels in an existing preference dataset, without injecting new samples. The real question is not whether label flips hurt DPO, but whether a small number of flips can steer training toward a chosen target policy, and under what conditions this targeted attack is computationally tractable or impossible. The paper gives a gradient-space formulation of this problem for log-linear DPO.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is indirect but real. It exposes a structural weakness of offline preference optimization: if the training objective responds to label corruption through additive, parameter-independent gradient shifts, poisoning can be reduced to a sparse combinatorial approximation problem and solved efficiently. That matters for robustness analysis of DPO-like alignment pipelines, and for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface more broadly: preference data auditing, robust weighting, objective design, and data collection protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical story has four steps. First, under a log-linear policy class, the authors show that flipping a single preference label induces a fixed shift in the DPO gradient that does not depend on the current parameter. This is the key simplification. It turns poisoning from a trajectory-dependent optimization in policy space into a subset-selection problem in gradient space, where each example contributes one dictionary atom corresponding to its flip-induced gradient shift.

Second, they show that controlling the residual in this gradient-space approximation is a sufficient surrogate for attack success in policy space. This reduces targeted poisoning to a structured binary sparse approximation problem: coefficients are binary because each label is either flipped or not; the goal is either to minimize the number of flips or to find the best attack under a budget K.

Third, they propose two algorithms. BAL-A targets the minimum-flip setting. It embeds the binary selection problem into a lattice with penalties for both approximation error and non-binary integer coefficients, then applies LLL basis reduction and Babai’s nearest-plane algorithm to recover an integer solution interpretable as a flip pattern. The paper analyzes how the embedding penalty controls the solution and gives a separation condition under which the true minimum-flip attack is recovered. BMP-A targets the sparse fixed-budget setting. It adapts Binary Matching Pursuit, using normalized correlations to handle non-uniform column norms in the gradient dictionary, and derives coherence-based recovery guarantees.

Fourth, the paper also provides simple robustness certificates: under certain geometric conditions on the dictionary, no K-flip attack can succeed. This is useful because it goes beyond attack construction and starts to characterize verifiable safety conditions.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate the geometry and recovery theory rather than to maximize downstream task scores. Synthetic-dictionary experiments test two main claims. First, BAL-A is sharply sensitive to the lattice penalty, and successful recovery occurs only in the theoretically predicted penalty regime. Second, BMP-A behaves as expected from sparse recovery theory: lower dictionary coherence leads to substantially better attack recovery.

The real-data experiments build dictionaries from the Stanford Human Preferences (SHP) dataset. The point is not to run a full large-scale LLM DPO pipeline, but to test whether the gradient-space reduction remains meaningful on realistic preference data. The answer is largely yes. BAL-A shows a clear phase transition with respect to the penalty parameter on SHP, and BMP-A improves markedly when dictionary coherence is reduced. For this kind of paper, the important empirical result is not simply attack strength, but whether the theoretical reduction survives contact with real preference datasets. The experiments support that claim reasonably well.

The scale is intentionally modest and analytically controlled, which fits the paper’s goal: understanding the mechanism of label-flip poisoning rather than building an end-to-end red-teaming benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, read the problem setup and the gradient derivation for log-linear DPO. The single most important takeaway is why one flipped label produces a parameter-independent gradient shift.

Second, read the BAL-A and BMP-A sections with the use case in mind. BAL-A is for minimum-flip attacks; BMP-A is for sparse attacks under a flip budget. You do not need every lattice detail on the first pass. What matters is why each algorithm matches its regime and what geometric assumptions each one needs.

Third, inspect the experimental figures around penalty regions, coherence, and robustness certificates. Those figures tell you whether the theory is merely formal or actually predictive.

Estimated reading time is 30–45 minutes. If your interest is alignment robustness rather than the full proofs, the introduction, main propositions, algorithm sections, and experiment plots are enough for a solid pass.

recommendation.zh: 把DPO投毒写成“参数无关的梯度偏移+二元稀疏选择”这一步很干净；建议只读推导与攻击构造，顺手想清楚你们的偏好数据审计/鲁棒训练缺口。
recommendation.en: The key move—DPO label flips as a parameter-independent gradient shift plus binary sparse selection—is clean; read the derivation/attack construction and map it to your preference-data auditing and robustness gaps.

paper.title: Iterative Finetuning is Mostly Idempotent
paper.abstract: If a model has some behavioral tendency, such as sycophancy or misalignment, and it is trained on its own outputs, will the tendency be amplified in the next generation of models? We study this question by training a series of models where each model is finetuned on data generated by its predecessor, and the initial model is seeded with some persona or belief. We test three settings: supervised finetuning (SFT) on instruct models, synthetic document finetuning (SDF) on base models, and direct pr

summary.core_problem: 互联网上LLM生成内容占比持续提升，未来预训练数据将包含大量前代模型输出，需要明确在模型自身输出上迭代微调是否会放大已有行为倾向（如谄媚、错位）。
summary.importance: 明确了不同微调范式下迭代自训练的特质演化规律，为预训练数据过滤、对齐阶段的风险防控提供了实证依据，也为持续学习的安全边界提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造7类不同特质（包括错位、厌世、谄媚等）的种子数据集，分别在有监督微调（SFT）、合成文档微调（SDF）、直接偏好优化（DPO）三种范式下开展多轮迭代自训练实验，每轮用当前模型生成的合成数据训练下一代模型，用LLM-as-judge评估特质强度与输出连贯性的变化。
summary.experiments: SFT与SDF场景下特质放大非常罕见，对超参数高度敏感，仅在极少量配置下出现，且放大伴随输出连贯性的显著下降；DPO场景下持续训练（不重新初始化模型）可稳定出现特质放大，若每轮重新初始化模型则特质保持或衰减；特质放大的阈值定义为连续4轮后特质得分较种子模型上升≥15分（满分100）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看实验设计与三类微调范式的结果对比部分，不需要深究单组实验的超参数细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The proportion of LLM-generated content on the internet keeps rising, so future pretraining corpora will include large volumes of outputs from predecessor models. It is necessary to clarify whether iterative fine-tuning on a model's own outputs will amplify existing behavioral tendencies such as sycophancy and misalignment.
summary_en.importance: It specifies the trait evolution rules of iterative self-training under different fine-tuning paradigms, provides empirical evidence for pretraining data filtering and risk control during alignment, and offers reference for the safety boundary of continual learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Seed datasets for 7 different traits (including misalignment, misanthropy, sycophancy, etc.) are constructed, and multi-round iterative self-training experiments are conducted under three paradigms: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Synthetic Document Fine-Tuning (SDF) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). For each round, synthetic data generated by the current model is used to train the next-generation model. LLM-as-judge is used to evaluate changes in trait strength and output coherence.
summary_en.experiments: Trait amplification is extremely rare in SFT and SDF scenarios, highly sensitive to hyperparameters, only occurs under very few configurations, and is accompanied by a significant drop in output coherence. In DPO scenarios, trait amplification occurs stably under continual training (without model reinitialization), while traits persist or decay if the model is reinitialized each round. Trait amplification is defined as a trait score increase of ≥15 points (out of 100) compared to the seed model after 4 consecutive cycles.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the experiment design section and result comparison across three fine-tuning paradigms. No need to dive into hyperparameter details of individual experiments. Expected reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验矩阵和 DPO 重置对照；它修正了“自举微调必然放大偏见”这个常见先验，但规模需打折。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental grid and the DPO reinitialization control; it usefully weakens the naive prior that self-training always amplifies traits.

paper.title: Gradient-Gated DPO: Stabilizing Preference Optimization in Language Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimization has become a central paradigm for aligning large language models with human feedback. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies reinforcement learning from human feedback by directly optimizing pairwise preferences, removing the need for reward modeling and policy optimization. However, recent work shows that DPO exhibits a squeezing effect, where negative gradients applied to rejected responses concentrate probability mass on high-confidence predictions while suppr

summary.core_problem: 直接偏好优化（DPO）在训练过程中存在“挤压效应”（squeezing effect）：对拒绝响应施加的负梯度会导致概率质量集中在高置信度预测上，同时抑制其他响应（包括首选响应），最终导致概率分布崩溃。
summary.importance: 揭示了 DPO 训练不稳定的根本原因在于 Softmax 归一化下的负梯度动态，并提出了一种简单有效的梯度门控机制（Gate-DPO），在不改变 DPO 核心目标的前提下，稳定了偏好学习过程，对 RLHF 预训练/后训练阶段的稳定性优化有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出梯度门控偏好优化（Gate-DPO）。核心思想是根据模型概率几何动态调节拒绝响应的梯度：当更新目标处于低概率“低谷”时，门控机制会衰减破坏性梯度；否则，恢复标准 DPO 行为。这相当于一种概率感知的学习率机制，既保留了偏好优化，又防止了概率崩溃。
summary.experiments: 在 Pythia-410M、Qwen-0.5B、LLaMA-7B 等架构和 Anthropic-HH、UltraFeedback 数据集上验证。Gate-DPO 持续减少了挤压效应，提高了首选响应的似然性。质量动态分析显示了更健康的优化行为，初步的成对胜率评估表明这些改进转化为更受偏好的输出。此外，门控 Pythia-410M 模型比未门控的 LLaMA-7B 模型表现出更大的首选响应提升，表明控制梯度动态可以减少对大模型的依赖。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Background and Motivation 中对 DPO 梯度结构的分析（公式 6 及其推论），以及 Gate-DPO 的具体门控机制设计。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) suffers from a 'squeezing effect' during training: negative gradients applied to rejected responses concentrate probability mass on high-confidence predictions while suppressing other responses (including preferred ones), leading to probability collapse.
summary_en.importance: Reveals that the root cause of DPO instability lies in negative gradient dynamics under Softmax normalization. Proposes a simple yet effective gradient gating mechanism (Gate-DPO) that stabilizes preference learning without altering the core DPO objective, offering direct insights for stabilizing RLHF pre-training/post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gradient-Gated Preference Optimization (Gate-DPO). The core idea is to dynamically modulate rejected-response gradients based on the model's probability geometry: when updates target low-probability 'valleys', the gate attenuates destructive gradients; otherwise, it recovers standard DPO behavior. This acts as a probability-aware learning-rate mechanism, preserving preference optimization while preventing collapse.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across architectures (Pythia-410M, Qwen-0.5B, LLaMA-7B) and datasets (Anthropic-HH, UltraFeedback). Gate-DPO consistently reduces squeezing and improves chosen-response likelihood. Mass-dynamics analysis shows healthier optimization, and preliminary pairwise win-rate evaluation indicates these improvements translate to more preferred outputs. Notably, gated Pythia-410M models exhibit larger chosen-response improvements than ungated LLaMA-7B models, suggesting controlled gradient dynamics can reduce reliance on large models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of DPO's gradient structure in 'Background and Motivation' (Equation 6 and its implications) and the specific design of the Gate-DPO mechanism. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和梯度分析即可；如果实验干净，它会修正“rejected 梯度总是有益”的 DPO 直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the method and gradient analysis; if the setup is clean, it weakens the usual intuition that rejected-sample gradients in DPO are always helpful.

paper.title: TUR-DPO: Topology- and Uncertainty-Aware Direct Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences is commonly done via reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) or, more simply, via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). While DPO is stable and RL-free, it treats preferences as flat winner vs. loser signals and is sensitive to noisy or brittle preferences arising from fragile chains of thought. We propose TUR-DPO, a topology- and uncertainty-aware variant of DPO that rewards how answer

summary.core_problem: 缓解 DPO 对噪声偏好和脆弱推理链的敏感性，让偏好优化不仅看答案输赢，也考虑推理过程质量与不确定性。
summary.importance: 属于后训练目标的小幅扩展。价值在于把 preference learning 从平面 winner/loser 信号扩展到带不确定性的结构化信号，但从摘要看更像稳健性增强，而不是改变对齐范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TUR-DPO，在 DPO 中引入 topology- and uncertainty-aware 设计：先诱导轻量级 reasoning topology，再结合 semantic faithfulness、utility 和 topology quality 构造校准后的 uncertainty signal；随后用一个可学习的小 reward 模块对这些信号做因子化建模，并进入 uncertainty-weighted DPO 目标。整个过程保持 RL-free，可使用固定或移动 reference policy。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖开放 7B-8B 模型，任务包括数学推理、事实问答、摘要等。摘要声称相较标准 DPO 有改进，但未给出关键基线、数据规模、偏好数据来源和提升幅度。就现有信息看，结论更适合作为后训练目标设计的弱信号，而非强 prior 更新。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce DPO's sensitivity to noisy preferences and brittle chains of thought by optimizing not only answer preference but also process quality and uncertainty.
summary_en.importance: This is a modest post-training objective extension. Its value lies in moving preference learning beyond flat winner/loser labels toward uncertainty-aware structured signals, but it does not appear to change the alignment paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: TUR-DPO adds topology- and uncertainty-aware components to DPO: it elicits lightweight reasoning topologies, combines semantic faithfulness, utility, and topology quality into a calibrated uncertainty signal, and feeds these into an uncertainty-weighted DPO objective through a small factorized reward module. The method remains RL-free and can use either a fixed or moving reference policy.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover open 7B-8B models on math reasoning, factual QA, and summarization. The abstract claims gains over standard DPO, but does not provide key baselines, preference data details, or effect sizes. Based on the abstract alone, this is better treated as a weak signal for objective design than a strong update to prior beliefs.

recommendation.zh: 典型 DPO 变体，想法不差但大概率吃标注与打分器质量；看目标函数和 ablation 即可，别先入为主地把它当成对齐新范式。
recommendation.en: A reasonable DPO variant, but likely bottlenecked by annotation and scorer quality; read the objective and ablations, not as a paradigm shift but as a robustness tweak.

paper.title: DynamicPO: Dynamic Preference Optimization for Recommendation
paper.abstract: In large language model (LLM)-based recommendation systems, direct preference optimization (DPO) effectively aligns recommendations with user preferences, requiring multi-negative objective functions to leverage abundant implicit-feedback negatives and sharpen preference boundaries. However, our empirical analyses reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon, preference optimization collapse, where increasing the number of negative samples can lead to performance degradation despite a continuously decre

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 推荐系统的 DPO 训练中，解释为什么增加负样本数量会出现 loss 下降但推荐效果变差的 preference optimization collapse。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练目标分析与推荐场景方法改进。虽然任务是推荐系统，但它触及 DPO/偏好优化中的一个通用问题：多负样本不一定提供更强训练信号，容易被简单负例主导。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DynamicPO，一个轻量 plug-and-play 框架。摘要只透露它包含两个自适应组件，动机是缓解 easy negatives 对梯度的压制，让 boundary-critical negatives 获得更多优化权重。理论部分把 collapse 归因于易区分负例支配目标，导致真正定义偏好边界的样本训练不足。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明作者做了经验分析和理论证明，但未给出数据集名称、模型规模、baseline、指标或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Science and Technology of China 和 Shanghai Innovation Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why DPO-style training for LLM-based recommendation can suffer preference optimization collapse: training loss keeps decreasing while recommendation quality drops as more negatives are added.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training objective analysis in a recommender setting. Its broader relevance is the warning that multi-negative preference optimization can overweight easy negatives and weaken the actual decision boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach: DynamicPO is presented as a lightweight plug-and-play framework with two adaptive components. The central analysis attributes collapse to gradient suppression: easily discriminable negatives dominate the objective, while boundary-critical negatives receive insufficient optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions empirical analyses and theoretical support, but gives no dataset names, model sizes, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include University of Science and Technology of China and Shanghai Innovation Institute.

recommendation.zh: 推荐场景较窄，但“更多负例压低 loss 却伤边界”的梯度分析可作 DPO 采样策略的弱信号。
recommendation.en: The recommender setup is narrow, but the loss-down/performance-down negative-sampling analysis is a useful weak signal for DPO design.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Mind the Gap: Structure-Aware Consistency in Preference Learning
paper.abstract: Preference learning has become the foundation of aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. Popular methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), minimize surrogate losses as proxies for the intractable pairwise ranking loss. However, we demonstrate that for the equicontinuous hypothesis sets typical of neural networks, these standard surrogates are theoretically inconsistent, yielding vacuous generalization guarantees. To resolve this, we formulate LLM alignment within a

summary.core_problem: 现有DPO等偏好学习方法使用的代理损失与真实 pairwise 排序目标理论上不一致，神经网络的等连续特性会导致模型通过压缩得分差而非学习正确排序来最小化代理损失，无法保障真实排序效果
summary.importance: 为偏好对齐的损失设计提供了严格的理论支撑，解释了SimPO等带margin的DPO变体效果更优的底层原因，也为后续RL预训练、SFT对齐的损失优化提供了明确的理论方向
summary.technical_approach: 提出结构感知的H一致性框架，首先证明固定margin是保障代理损失与真实排序目标一致性的必要条件，进一步提出SA-DPO目标，根据两个偏好响应的语义距离动态调整margin，语义越接近的响应对要求的margin越小，避免强制无差异响应分离带来的幻觉和训练不稳定
summary.experiments: 理论层面推导了等连续假设集下无约束代理损失的一致性边界为空，证明了margin-shifted代理损失的一致性边界，以及结构感知margin的最优性；提出Margin-Capacity Profile指标量化一致性与模型容量的权衡，证明立方hinge损失等重尾损失比DPO使用的逻辑损失在有限容量下的一致性表现更优
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点看第3节核心理论结论、第5节SA-DPO的设计思路，无需深入啃复杂的定理证明，预计阅读时间20分钟；其中margin动态调整的逻辑可复用至现有DPO对齐流程优化
summary.authors_note: Google Research纽约分部 + 纽约大学柯朗数学科学研究所，通讯作者为Mehryar Mohri、Yutao Zhong

summary_en.core_problem: Surrogate losses used in existing preference learning methods such as DPO are theoretically inconsistent with the true pairwise ranking objective. The equicontinuity property of neural networks allows models to minimize surrogate loss by shrinking score differences instead of learning correct ranking order, leading to no guarantee on real ranking performance
summary_en.importance: Provides rigorous theoretical support for loss design in preference alignment, explains the underlying reason for performance gains of margin-augmented DPO variants such as SimPO, and offers clear theoretical guidance for loss optimization in RL pretraining and SFT alignment
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a structure-aware H-consistency framework. First proves that a fixed margin is a necessary condition to ensure consistency between surrogate loss and true ranking objective. Further introduces the SA-DPO objective, which dynamically adjusts the margin based on the semantic distance between two paired responses: the smaller the semantic distance, the smaller the required margin, avoiding hallucination and training instability caused by forced separation of interchangeable responses
summary_en.experiments: Theoretically derives that consistency bounds of unconstrained surrogate loss are vacuous under equicontinuous hypothesis sets, proves the consistency bounds of margin-shifted surrogates and the optimality of structure-aware margin. Proposes the Margin-Capacity Profile metric to quantify the trade-off between consistency and model capacity, and verifies that heavy-tailed losses such as cubic hinge loss outperform the logistic loss used in DPO in bounded-capacity regimes
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 (core theoretical conclusions) and Section 5 (SA-DPO design), no need to dive into complex theorem proofs, estimated reading time 20 minutes. The dynamic margin adjustment logic can be reused to optimize existing DPO alignment pipelines
summary_en.authors_note: Google Research, New York; Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York University. Corresponding authors: Mehryar Mohri, Yutao Zhong

recommendation.zh: DPO理论一致性的扎实工作，SA-DPO的自适应间隔设计可直接用于内部对齐实验ablation，只看§3推导和§4目标定义即可。
recommendation.en: Solid work on DPO consistency, the adaptive margin design of SA-DPO can be directly tested in internal alignment ablations, only read §3 derivation and §4 objective definition.

institutions: New York University Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences

paper.title: ViPO: Visual Preference Optimization at Scale
paper.abstract: While preference optimization is crucial for improving visual generative models, how to effectively scale this paradigm remains largely unexplored. Current open-source preference datasets contain conflicting preference patterns, where winners excel in some dimensions but underperform in others. Naively optimizing on such noisy datasets fails to learn preferences, hindering effective scaling. To enhance robustness against noise, we propose Poly-DPO, which extends the DPO objective with an additio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“怎么再做一个视觉偏好优化算法”，而是一个更具体的扩展性问题：当偏好数据规模变大时，为什么现有 Diffusion-DPO 一类离线偏好学习方法并没有稳定变好，甚至会很快饱和。全文给出的答案是，现有开源视觉偏好数据里存在大量冲突型偏好样本：胜者图像可能在审美上更好，但在文本对齐、结构完整性、细节保真等维度更差。DPO 把这类二元偏好当成单一、干净、可传递的监督信号来学，会把互相矛盾的梯度混在一起，结果是随着数据增加，模型并没有学到更清晰的偏好边界。作者进一步指出，问题不只在算法，也在数据：旧数据集分辨率低、prompt 覆盖窄、类别分布不平衡，而且很多样本来自较早期生成模型，偏好信号本身就不够稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一层是方法论上的：偏好优化能否扩展，瓶颈往往不是“loss 形式不够复杂”，而是监督信号是否单调、是否可学习。这和语言模型里的 preference data 质量、reward noise、合成偏好冲突是同一类问题。第二层是数据工程上的：作者用实验把“高质量偏好数据比复杂算法更关键”这件事讲得比较清楚。Poly-DPO 在脏数据上有用，但在高质量 ViPO-Image-1M 上会自然退化回标准 DPO，说明当数据足够干净时，额外鲁棒项不再重要。这个结论对 RLHF / DPO / RLAIF 乃至 post-train 数据构造都有参考价值。就 LLM 基座研究而言，它不是直接的文本预训练论文，但对‘偏好学习如何随数据规模扩展’这个问题有实质信息增益。
summary.technical_approach: 技术上有两部分。第一部分是 Poly-DPO。它建立在 Diffusion-DPO 之上，在原有偏好目标外加入一个多项式项，用来按样本置信度动态调节训练权重。直观上，标准 DPO 会对“模型已经很确定”或“标签本身带冲突”的样本继续施加强梯度，容易造成过置信和错误放大；Poly-DPO 通过一个由超参数 α 控制的多项式修正，让不同置信区间的样本贡献不同。作者强调它同时处理两类问题：一类是冲突偏好样本，此时需要降低错误监督对更新方向的破坏；另一类是过于简单的样本，此时需要抑制模型在 trivially separable pair 上继续变得更极端。这个设计和分类里的 focal-style reweighting 有相似精神，但这里不是按类别不平衡，而是按偏好学习中的置信度与数据噪声结构来调节。第二部分是 ViPO 数据集。作者没有沿用已有开源偏好集，而是重新构建了大规模高分辨率视觉偏好数据：图像部分 100 万对、1024px，覆盖五类；视频部分 30 万对、720p+，覆盖三类。数据由较新的生成模型产生，包括 FLUX、Qwen-Image、WanVideo，并通过系统化类别设计与平衡采样来减少分布偏斜。论文的一个关键论点是，算法鲁棒性和数据质量不是替代关系，而是互补关系：脏数据需要 Poly-DPO，干净数据则让标准 DPO 已经足够。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是单点榜单，而是几个趋势。第一，在噪声较重的 Pick-a-Pic V2 上，Poly-DPO 明显优于标准 Diffusion-DPO，说明它确实能从冲突偏好中提取更稳定的学习信号。摘要和引言没有给出完整表格数字，但全文结论很明确：标准 DPO 随数据规模扩展会出现收益饱和，而 Poly-DPO 能延缓这种饱和。第二，在作者构建的 ViPO 数据上，数据质量带来的收益比旧数据集更显著。用 ViPO 训练时，SD1.5 的结果显著超过基于现有偏好数据训练的版本；对 SD3.5-Medium 也带来较全面的生成质量提升。第三，α 的消融很关键：在 ViPO-Image-1M 上，最优 α 会收敛到 0 附近，而且在 0 周围一段范围内性能都稳定，这说明高质量数据下 Poly-DPO 会自动退化为标准 DPO，不需要精细调参。这个现象是全文最有信息量的实验之一，因为它把“算法改进”和“数据改进”区分开了。第四，论文还通过图 1 和表 1 说明旧数据集的几个结构性缺陷：低分辨率、prompt 多样性不足、随机采样导致分布失衡、生成器过旧。这些不是附带背景，而是解释为什么偏好扩展失败的直接证据链。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 里的 Figure 1 和 Table 1，先建立作者的问题定义：不是偏好优化没用，而是现有数据让它学不到稳定信号。然后看方法部分里 Poly-DPO 相对 Diffusion-DPO 的目标函数变化，重点理解“多项式项到底在调什么、为什么能同时处理冲突样本和过简单样本”。如果时间有限，不必过度停留在公式推导细节，更值得看的是 α 的角色和不同数据质量下最优 α 的变化。实验部分优先看三类内容：一是 noisy dataset 上 Poly-DPO 对标准 DPO 的提升；二是 ViPO 相对已有数据集的收益；三是 α 消融，尤其是高质量数据上 α→0 的结果。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。真正值得深挖的点有两个：其一，冲突偏好是否可以显式分解成多维偏好标签，而不是只靠 reweighting；其二，这种“高质量数据使复杂对齐目标退化为简单目标”的现象，是否也会在文本 DPO / RLAIF 中出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a scaling failure in visual preference optimization rather than proposing yet another preference objective in isolation. The central question is: why do off-policy methods such as Diffusion-DPO stop improving when preference data scale increases? The answer developed in the full text is that existing open visual preference datasets contain many conflicting pairwise labels. The preferred image may be better on one axis, such as aesthetics, but worse on another, such as prompt faithfulness or structural correctness. Standard DPO treats these pairs as clean scalar preference supervision, so contradictory gradients accumulate and scaling saturates. The authors also argue that the bottleneck is partly data-side: older datasets are low-resolution, narrow in prompt coverage, distributionally imbalanced, and generated by outdated image models, which makes the preference signal itself unstable.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is less about diffusion image alignment per se and more about a general lesson for scalable preference learning. The paper makes a concrete case that scaling failures often come from supervision quality, not only from the objective. That maps well to LLM post-training settings with noisy preference labels, reward inconsistency, and synthetic preference conflicts. A second useful point is the separation between algorithmic robustness and data quality. Poly-DPO helps on noisy datasets, but on the cleaner ViPO-Image-1M benchmark it collapses back to standard DPO with the best alpha near zero. That is a meaningful result: once the data are sufficiently clean, extra robustness machinery becomes unnecessary. This is relevant to RLHF, DPO, RLAIF, and any pipeline where one might otherwise keep adding objective complexity to compensate for poor data.
summary_en.technical_approach: There are two main components. First, Poly-DPO extends Diffusion-DPO with an additional polynomial term that reweights samples according to model confidence. The motivation is that vanilla DPO keeps applying strong updates both to mislabeled or conflict-heavy pairs and to trivially separable pairs, which can amplify noise and induce overconfidence. Poly-DPO introduces a confidence-dependent correction, controlled by a hyperparameter alpha, so that samples contribute differently across confidence regimes. The intended effect is twofold: reduce the damage from contradictory preference labels and avoid wasting optimization on overly easy pairs. The idea is reminiscent of confidence-aware reweighting in classification, but here the target is the noise structure specific to pairwise preference learning. Second, the paper builds ViPO, a large-scale high-quality preference dataset: 1M image pairs at 1024px across five categories and 300K video pairs at 720p+ across three categories. The data are generated with newer models such as FLUX, Qwen-Image, and WanVideo, then curated with more systematic category design and balancing. A key claim throughout the paper is that robust optimization and better data are complementary rather than interchangeable: Poly-DPO is needed for imperfect data, while clean data make standard DPO sufficient.
summary_en.experiments: The most important findings are trend-level rather than a single benchmark number. On noisy datasets such as Pick-a-Pic V2, Poly-DPO consistently outperforms standard Diffusion-DPO, supporting the claim that confidence-aware reweighting can extract more stable learning signals from conflicting preferences. The paper also shows that vanilla DPO saturates as more noisy preference data are added, whereas Poly-DPO delays that saturation. On the newly constructed ViPO data, the gains from data quality are larger than what prior open datasets provide. Training SD1.5 on ViPO yields results clearly beyond models trained on existing preference datasets, and SD3.5-Medium also improves broadly. The most informative ablation is on alpha: on ViPO-Image-1M, the best alpha moves toward zero, and performance remains stable in a neighborhood around zero. That means Poly-DPO effectively reduces to standard DPO on high-quality data, which is strong evidence that the algorithm is compensating for data defects rather than replacing good data. The paper also documents structural issues in prior datasets, including low resolution, limited prompt diversity, random-collection imbalance, and outdated generators; these observations are part of the causal story for why preference scaling had stalled.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figure 1 and Table 1 in the introduction. They define the paper’s real claim: preference optimization does not fail because the paradigm is weak, but because current datasets do not provide stable preference supervision. Then read the method section with one question in mind: what exactly does the polynomial term change relative to Diffusion-DPO, and why should that help both conflict-heavy and trivially easy pairs? If time is limited, do not overinvest in the derivation details. The more useful part is understanding the role of alpha and how its optimal value changes with dataset quality. In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: the noisy-dataset comparison against vanilla DPO, the gains from ViPO over prior datasets, and the alpha ablation showing alpha approaching zero on clean data. This is a 20–30 minute skim if the goal is to extract the main idea. Two follow-up questions are worth deeper thought: whether conflicting visual preferences should be modeled explicitly as multi-attribute labels rather than only reweighted, and whether the same 'clean data simplify the alignment objective' pattern also appears in text DPO or RLAIF.

recommendation.zh: 重点看Poly-DPO的损失设计思路，可迁移到文本LLM的噪声偏好对齐场景，读§3损失设计即可
recommendation.en: Focus on Poly-DPO loss design, which can be migrated to text LLM noisy preference alignment, only reading §3 is sufficient

However, existing datasets provide only single, holistic annotations, resulting in severe label noise: images that excel in some dimensions but are deficient in others are simply marked as winner or loser. summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型DPO训练将多维度人类视觉偏好压缩为二元标签，产生严重标签噪声与冲突梯度，误导模型训练

summary.authors_note: 中佛罗里达大学团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion DPO training compresses multi-dimensional human visual preferences into binary labels, resulting in severe label noise and conflicting gradients that mislead model training
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a semi-supervised DPO framework to solve label noise problem caused by multi-dimensional preferences
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Semi-DPO, which divides preference pairs into consistent clean labeled set and conflicting unlabeled noisy set, first train initial model on clean set, then use this model to generate pseudo labels for iterative optimization of noisy set

summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Central Florida

recommendation.zh: 仅可作为DPO处理标签噪声思路的补充参考，无需读正文

paper.title: Intrinsic Mutual Information as a Modulator for Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Offline preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), offer significant advantages in aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values. However, achieving optimal performance with these methods typically involves additional hyperparameter tuning, resulting in substantial time overhead. Although prior work has proposed a range of improvements, these methods remain limited in effectiveness and have not fully eliminated reliance on hyperparameter tuning. In t

summary.core_problem: 在离线偏好优化（DPO/IPO/KTO/SimPO）里，性能对超参（尤其是 margin/温度类超参）很敏感，导致需要反复调参。论文试图用一种“实例级自适应”的方式，减少或替代人工调参，同时保持训练开销接近原方法。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train（偏好对齐）范畴，但对“pretrain↔posttrain 接口”有现实意义：如果能把偏好信号强度按样本自适应调制，就能降低对齐阶段的工程试错成本，并可能减少因固定超参导致的过拟合/偏好漂移问题。对预训练研究的启发主要在于：把‘样本信息量’显式引入优化权重/边际，作为训练动态的调制信号，而不是把所有样本用同一强度的偏好约束硬推。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 RMiPO：用“response-level intrinsic mutual information（响应级内禀互信息）”来动态调制偏好优化里的关键超参，主打对 SimPO/DPO 这类 BT（Bradley–Terry）式目标中的 margin 超参 γ 做实例级自适应。
- 论文先分析多种离线偏好优化目标里各超参的作用，结论是 γ（奖励边际/偏好间隔）对优化行为更“主导”。
- 然后引入响应的内禀互信息作为调制依据：直觉上，某些回答对提示更“信息性/更确定”，偏好信号更可信或更该被放大；信息量低或不确定的样本则降低边际强度，避免噪声偏好把模型推偏。
- 实现上强调 lightweight：不引入额外 reward model 或复杂监控模块，而是在训练时为每个样本计算一个调制量，用它更新/缩放 γ，从而“decouple preference contributions”。
（注：你提供的全文片段在方法细节处截断在 SimPO 目标附近，互信息的精确定义、估计方式、以及 γ 的具体调制公式未完整出现；若要严格复现级分析，需要补齐方法与算法框。）
summary.experiments:
作者声称在 AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench 等评测上，RMiPO 相比强基线取得更好效果，并把训练成本降低约 15–20%（相对 DPO/或相对需要调参的设置）。
从片段可确认的实验信息主要是：对比对象包含 DPO、IPO、KTO、SimPO；目标是减少调参与训练开销。
（具体：基座模型、偏好数据规模、超参搜索范围、以及在各 benchmark 上的分数提升幅度，片段未给出。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看理论/分析部分：他们如何论证 γ 是主导超参，以及互信息为何能作为调制信号。
- 再看算法框/伪代码：互信息如何估计（是否用模型自身概率、是否做长度归一、是否需要额外采样），以及 γ 的更新是连续值还是分段策略。
- 最后扫实验表：重点看“免调参”是否真的成立（是否仍需选一个全局尺度/上限下限），以及在不同偏好数据噪声水平下是否更稳。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可判断是否值得复现；要落地需要把互信息估计与训练稳定性细节读透。

summary_en.core_problem: Offline preference optimization (DPO/IPO/KTO/SimPO) often remains hyperparameter-sensitive—especially to margin/temperature-like knobs—so practitioners pay a large tuning cost. The paper aims to reduce that cost by making the key hyperparameter instance-adaptive while keeping the training pipeline lightweight.
summary_en.importance: This is post-training work, but it matters to the pretrain–posttrain loop operationally: if preference strength can be modulated per example based on an intrinsic signal, alignment runs become less brittle and less dependent on expensive sweeps. The transferable idea for pretraining research is the use of an explicit “example information” measure to scale learning pressure, instead of applying a uniform constraint across heterogeneous samples.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose RMiPO, which uses response-level intrinsic mutual information to modulate the dominant hyperparameter in BT-style preference objectives—arguing that the margin parameter γ largely governs optimization behavior.
- The paper first analyzes the roles of hyperparameters in common offline preference objectives and identifies γ (reward margin / preference gap) as the key driver.
- It then uses intrinsic mutual information of responses as a principled per-instance signal: high-information (more prompt-dependent / more certain) responses get stronger preference enforcement; low-information ones get weaker margins to avoid amplifying noisy comparisons.
- The design goal is “lightweight”: no reward model and no heavy control module; just compute a modulation factor and adapt γ during training to decouple preference contributions.
(The provided excerpt cuts off before the full definition/estimation of mutual information and the exact γ-modulation rule, so a reproduction-grade understanding requires the missing method/algorithm section.)
summary_en.experiments:
They report evaluations on AlpacaEval 2 and MT-Bench, claiming clearer gains over strong baselines and ~15–20% training cost reduction (relative to DPO and/or tuning-heavy setups). Baselines mentioned include DPO, IPO, KTO, and SimPO.
(The excerpt does not include model sizes, dataset sizes, or the exact score deltas.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Start with the analysis section that motivates why γ is the dominant knob and why mutual information is the right modulator.
- Then read the algorithm box carefully: how MI is estimated (from model probabilities? length normalization? extra sampling?) and how γ is updated (continuous vs. clipped schedule).
- Finally, check the experiment tables for whether “no tuning” truly holds (often there is still a global scale or bounds) and whether robustness improves under preference noise/drift.
Time: ~20–30 minutes to decide relevance; longer if you plan to implement the MI estimator and verify stability.

recommendation.zh: DPO的轻量增量改进，无范式突破，仅看§3方法部分和实验结果表即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to DPO with no paradigm breakthrough, only read §3 method section and experiment tables

paper.title: When Prompts Override Vision: Prompt-Induced Hallucinations in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Despite impressive progress in capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), these systems remain vulnerable to hallucinations, i.e., outputs that are not grounded in the visual input. Prior work has attributed hallucinations in LVLMs to factors such as limitations of the vision backbone or the dominance of the language component, yet the relative importance of these factors remains unclear. To resolve this ambiguity, We propose HalluScope, a benchmark to better understand the extent to

summary.core_problem: 在现代 LVLM 中，视觉幻觉到底主要来自哪里：视觉感知失败、语义共现先验（language prior），还是指令文本里“预设”(presupposition) 强行带入的事实？论文要把这三类来源拆开测清楚，并给出一个专门针对“指令预设诱导幻觉”的可操作缓解方案。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的直接价值不在“又一个幻觉 benchmark”，而在于把幻觉来源从“感知 vs 语言”进一步细分到“指令预设”这一更贴近对齐/后训练信号的问题：当视觉 backbone 足够强时，错误更多是跨模态对齐与指令遵循机制的副作用。对做 VLM 预训练/中后期训练的人，这提供了两个可落地的抓手：
1) 评测侧：用可控问题族把 hallucination 归因到不同机制，而不是用单一分数混在一起；
2) 训练侧：用偏好优化把模型从“顺着问题编”拉回到“先验证图像再回答”，本质是改写 instruction-following 的优先级。
summary.technical_approach:
1) HalluScope 诊断集设计：围绕同一批图像构造不同“诱因”的问题族，分别测：
- Positive Object Recognition：问图中确实存在的物体，测基本感知/识别是否可靠。
- Random Object Recognition：问与场景无关且不存在的随机物体，测无根据的“乱答 yes”。
- Adversarial Object Recognition：问语义上很合理、与场景共现概率高但实际不存在的物体（例如桌子旁的椅子），用来量化模型对共现先验的依赖。
- Adversarial Presupposition Attribute：更进一步，把“物体存在”作为问题预设，再问属性（颜色/材质等），例如“椅子是什么颜色？”在图里没有椅子时会诱导模型编造一个椅子并给出颜色；这一组专门测 instruction presupposition 的支配力。
数据构造上，作者先从 COCO 里用 caption embedding + k-center greedy 选语义覆盖更广的子集，减少评测被少数场景分布主导。

2) 结论性发现（机制层面）：在不少现代 LVLM 上，感知题（Positive/Random）表现并不差，但在“共现诱导”与尤其“预设诱导”题上错误显著增多，说明主要问题不是看不见，而是语言侧（指令与先验）在冲突时压过了视觉证据。

3) HalluVL-DPO 缓解：用偏好优化（DPO 类）做定向微调，目标是让“ grounded answer（承认看不到/否认预设）”在偏好上压过“顺着预设编造的回答”。关键点是 sample-informativeness：不是均匀用所有偏好对，而是更强调那些更能暴露预设诱导幻觉、梯度更有效的样本（论文表述为基于信息量的变体）。训练数据来自大规模生成的偏好对，偏好准则围绕“是否基于图像证据、是否拒绝不成立的预设”。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的核心实验结构是：
- 诊断：在 HalluScope 四类问题上对多种 LVLM 做分项评测，展示“预设诱导”子集最能拉开差距，并且与纯感知错误弱相关，从而支持归因。
- 缓解：用 HalluVL-DPO 微调后，在 HalluScope 的目标子集（尤其 Adversarial Presupposition Attribute）幻觉显著下降；同时在通用多模态能力上尽量保持（作者声称“maintain strong general multimodal performance”）。
- 泛化：在既有 hallucination benchmark（文中点名 POPE/CHAIR/SHR/MMHAL-Bench 等）上也有一致改进。

你给的全文片段未包含具体表格数字（模型规模、训练偏好对数量、各 benchmark 提升幅度）。如果需要把“提升了多少”写成可复现的精确数字，需要补齐实验章节/表格页。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看 HalluScope 的四类问题定义与构造流程：重点是 Adversarial Object vs Adversarial Presupposition Attribute 的差别，它决定了归因是否站得住。
2) 看主结果表：不要只看总分，按四个子集对比“感知正确但仍幻觉”的比例，这是论文最有信息量的部分。
3) 看 HalluVL-DPO 的数据生成与偏好准则：偏好标签如何定义“grounded”，以及 sample-informativeness 的具体实现（是基于不确定性、margin、还是梯度信号）。
4) 最后看保持通用能力的实验：确认是否出现“更谨慎但更拒答”的副作用（例如过度否认）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise attribution question for LVLM hallucinations: when a model produces ungrounded outputs, how much is due to (i) visual perception failures, (ii) learned semantic/co-occurrence priors, or (iii) presuppositions injected by the instruction itself? It then targets the instruction-presupposition failure mode with a preference-optimization fine-tuning recipe.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution for foundation-model researchers is the reframing: as vision backbones get stronger, a large fraction of hallucinations look less like perception errors and more like a modality-alignment / instruction-following priority issue. HalluScope operationalizes this by separating co-occurrence bias from instruction presupposition, which is often conflated in prior benchmarks. On the mitigation side, the work is a concrete example of using preference optimization to reweight the model’s internal trade-off between “comply with the question” and “verify against visual evidence,” which is directly relevant to post-training signals that feed back into pretraining objectives and data design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) HalluScope benchmark: for each image, construct controlled question families to isolate different causes.
- Positive Object Recognition: query objects truly present (checks basic visual recognition).
- Random Object Recognition: query unrelated absent objects (checks spurious ‘yes’ behavior).
- Adversarial Object Recognition: query plausible-but-absent objects that commonly co-occur with the scene (measures reliance on semantic priors over pixels).
- Adversarial Presupposition Attribute: ask for an attribute of an adversarial object while presupposing its existence (e.g., “What color is the chair?” when no chair exists), explicitly probing instruction-induced presupposition.
The image pool is selected from COCO with caption-embedding diversity (k-center greedy) to avoid narrow scene bias.

2) Diagnosis claim: many LVLMs are reasonably accurate on perception checks yet fail heavily on adversarial/presupposition subsets, indicating that language-side priors and instruction presuppositions can override visual evidence.

3) HalluVL-DPO: a DPO-style preference optimization fine-tuning that prefers grounded responses (deny/abstain when the presupposition is false) over hallucinated compliance. A key tweak is sample informativeness weighting—training emphasizes preference pairs that are more diagnostic/effective for correcting presupposition-driven hallucinations. The preference dataset is large-scale and generated to stress these failure cases.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental narrative has two pillars:
- Factorized evaluation: report per-subset performance on HalluScope across multiple LVLMs, showing the presupposition subset as the dominant failure mode and weakly correlated with pure perception errors.
- Targeted mitigation: HalluVL-DPO reduces hallucinations on the presupposition-driven subset and yields consistent gains on established hallucination benchmarks (e.g., POPE/CHAIR/SHR/MMHAL-Bench), while aiming to preserve general multimodal capability.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (model sizes, preference data scale, exact deltas). Precise quantitative reporting requires the results section/tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 min):
1) Read the HalluScope task definitions carefully; the key is the separation between adversarial co-occurrence questions and presupposition-attribute questions.
2) Inspect the main results table by subset (not just aggregate scores) to validate the attribution argument.
3) Focus on how the preference pairs are constructed and what counts as “grounded”; then check how sample-informativeness is computed.
4) Verify the “capability retention” evaluations to see whether improvements come from over-refusal or generic hedging.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 benchmark 设计和 DPO 配方，不必把结论上升到“视觉 backbone 不重要”；它更像是在提醒你，多模态训练里 instruction prior 可能比想象中更强，先读任务构造再看结果。
recommendation.en: Read it for the benchmark design and the DPO setup, not for a grand claim about vision backbones; the useful signal is that instruction priors may dominate multimodal behavior more than many training recipes assume.

paper.title: HiPO: Hierarchical Preference Optimization for Adaptive Reasoning in LLMs
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is an effective framework for aligning large language models with human preferences, but it struggles with complex reasoning tasks. DPO optimizes for the likelihood of generating preferred over dispreferred responses in their entirety and lacks the granularity to provide feedback on subsections of many-step solutions typical of reasoning tasks. Existing methods excel at either stable preference learning (e.g., DPO variants like KTO and RSO) or structured reas

summary.core_problem: DPO 把“整段回答”当作一个不可分的优化单元，导致在多步推理任务里无法对不同能力短板（问题澄清/推理过程/最终作答）分别施加偏好信号，也就难以做“按任务需求自适应地强化某一段能力”的对齐训练。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线的直接贡献有限，更偏 post-train/对齐范式：它提供了一种把偏好学习从 response-level 拆到 segment-level 的思路，能在不引入 RLHF/PPO 成本的前提下，给复杂推理提供更细粒度的训练控制旋钮。对“训练信号质量/粒度如何影响推理能力”这类问题有启发，但需要警惕它对推理能力提升是否来自真实能力增长，还是来自格式/分段诱导与标注偏差。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把每个候选回答分解为三段：①问题复述与上下文澄清（query clarification & context），②推理步骤（reasoning steps），③最终答案（final answer）。在偏好数据上，不再只对整段回答做 DPO 的 pairwise 对比，而是把偏好得分/损失分解为“整段 + 各段辅助项”的加权多目标：
- 仍保留标准 DPO 对 (chosen, rejected) 的整体对比，保证全局偏好一致性。
- 额外对每个 segment 构造类似 DPO 的对比项（或等价的对数似然差分项），用权重控制每段的训练强度。
- 训练与推理保持单模型、单次前向（作者声称保持 DPO 的效率优势），不需要多 agent rollout 或树搜索。
关键取舍在于：分段带来更强的可控性，但也引入了“分段边界如何定义/如何自动切分/偏好标签如何对齐到段”的数据工程与噪声问题；如果分段依赖模型自生成或启发式规则，训练信号可能被格式化偏好污染。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段未包含实验设置、基座模型、数据规模、评测基准与具体数值，也未看到消融（例如：只加 reasoning 段 vs 只加 clarification 段、不同权重策略、不同切分策略）与稳定性分析（loss/梯度、KL 漂移等）。因此无法基于“全文”复述关键数字与结论。若论文后半部分提供了：
- 在 GSM8K/MATH/BBH 等推理集上的提升幅度；
- 与 DPO/KTO/RSO 的对比；
- segment 权重扫描与分段噪声鲁棒性；
这些将是判断其是否真提升推理而非仅改善表达的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1) 直接看方法定义处：分段后的目标函数写法、chosen/rejected 如何在 segment 级对齐、权重如何进入梯度。
2) 看数据构造：分段是人工标注、规则切分还是模型切分；偏好标签是否对每段单独标，还是从整体偏好“继承”。
3) 看消融：不同 segment 权重、去掉整体项/去掉某段辅助项、不同切分策略对结果与稳定性的影响。
4) 看失败案例：是否出现“更会写推理但答案不更对”、或“澄清段变长导致 token budget 挤压推理”。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard DPO treats an entire response as a single optimization unit, which makes preference feedback too coarse for multi-step reasoning: it cannot separately train query understanding, structured reasoning, and final answer formulation, nor adapt training emphasis to task-specific reasoning demands.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training/alignment contribution rather than a pretraining one. The main value is a concrete recipe to increase the granularity of preference optimization while keeping DPO’s single-model, single-pass efficiency. It is relevant to pretraining researchers insofar as it probes how supervision granularity and objective decomposition affect reasoning behaviors, but it needs strong evidence to rule out gains coming from formatting/segmentation artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiPO decomposes each response into three segments (clarification/context, reasoning steps, final answer) and extends DPO into a weighted multi-objective: keep the original response-level DPO term for global preference consistency, and add auxiliary DPO-like pairwise terms at the segment level. Segment weights act as knobs to prioritize specific competencies (e.g., heavier weight on clarification for ambiguous prompts, heavier weight on reasoning for multi-step tasks). The claimed advantage is maintaining DPO’s computational profile (no PPO, no multi-agent rollouts, no tree search) while enabling targeted optimization. The main technical risk is data/label alignment: how segments are defined and how preference signals are assigned to segments can introduce noise and bias.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section, so model sizes, datasets, benchmarks, and quantitative results cannot be verified here. The key experiments to look for (and that determine credibility) are: comparisons vs DPO/KTO/RSO on reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K/MATH/BBH), ablations over segment weights and segmentation strategies, and analyses showing improvements in answer correctness rather than merely longer/better-looking rationales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (~20–30 minutes): focus on (1) the exact objective formulation and how chosen/rejected pairs are aligned at the segment level; (2) dataset augmentation/segmentation procedure and whether segment-level labels are real or inherited; (3) ablations on weights and segmentation noise; (4) qualitative failure cases where reasoning verbosity increases without accuracy gains.

recommendation.zh: 分段加权DPO的思路可在内部推理对齐 ablation 中尝试，重点看损失函数定义部分即可。
recommendation.en: The segment-weighted DPO idea can be tested in internal reasoning alignment ablations, only the loss function definition section needs to be focused on.

paper.title: MGDA-Decoupled: Geometry-Aware Multi-Objective Optimisation for DPO-based LLM Alignment
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to desirable human values requires balancing multiple, potentially conflicting objectives such as helpfulness, truthfulness, and harmlessness, which presents a multi-objective optimisation challenge.
